--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 수신관 제로스(xellos) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('RoleXellosBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
	activate_special_option = nil,
	--- 특수 능력 버프 정보
	special_buff_info = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 옵션 관련 데이터 가져옴
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	if activate_option then
		--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
		self.activate_special_option = true

		--- 대시 스피드
		self.dash_speed = self.dash_speed * (1 + cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'MoveDistScale'))

		--- 특수 능력 버프 정보
		self.special_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param)
	end
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- play action sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'action')

	--- instantiate blink effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'blink', character_util.get_position(self.owner))

	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'blink')

	--- set alpha fade
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 0, 0.03)

	local dynamic_dash_duration = battle_util.get_dash_duration_until_wall(self.owner, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dir_vector)

	battle_util.melee_short_dash(
		self.cs_action, nil, self.dir_vector,
		0, dynamic_dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
		CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, nil, 0
	)

	--- 특수 능력이 발동 되었는지
	if self.activate_special_option then
		--- 특수 능력 버프 적용
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.special_buff_info)
	end

	--- 카메라 연출
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.03, self.action_duration)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- instantiate blink effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'blink', character_util.get_position(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0.03)

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	role_util.setup_role_action(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 역할 액션이 available하고 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return battle_util.role_is_available(self.cs_action) and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state.activate_cwp_option
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(_)
	return true
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	if not battle_util.is_ai(self.cs_action) then
		--- 조작 방향을 가져옴
		local dir_vector = battle_util.get_stick_direction(self.cs_action)

		--- 조작 방향 입력이 없다면 보는 방향으로 대시
		if vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector) == 0 then
			dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
		end

		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	else
		local _, dir_vector = battle_util.get_closest_target_simple(
			self.cs_action, battle_constants.default_search_range
		)

		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, -dir_vector)
	end

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	if self.dash_timing > self.current_time_passed and self.current_time_passed < self.action_end_timing then
		self:instantiate_end_fx()
	end
	self:dispose_dash_fx()
	buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.super_armor_buff_info.name)
	buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.rush_buff_info.name)


	--- 스파인 이벤트 콜백 할당
	self.skeleton_animation.state:Event('-', self.on_spine_event_func)

	--- 루프 사운드 fade out
	if self.dash_loop then
		sfx_util.fade_out(self.dash_loop, 0.3)
		self.dash_loop = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function action_state_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then return end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dash then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		self:dispose_dash_fx()
		--- 대시 상태 버프 제거
		buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.rush_buff_info.name)

		--- 루프 사운드 fade out
		if self.dash_loop then
			sfx_util.fade_out(self.dash_loop, 0.3)
			self.dash_loop = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dash_end then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		self:dispose_dash_end_fx()
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true
		--- 연출 오른쪽보고 돌진 준비
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

		--- 돌진 상태 표시 버프
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.rush_buff_info)

		--- 공격 준비 이벤트 브로드 캐스트
		local custom_event = CS.Oak.MoneyShotEvent.Create(self.owner, CS.Oak.MoneyShotEventType.ActionStart)
		message_system:Publish(custom_event)

	elseif next_state == self.state.dash then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true
		--- 돌진 연출
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'loop')
		--- 사운드 재생
		self.dash_loop = battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, 'loop')
		battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, 'booster')

		self.screen_controller:shake(0.1, self.dash_duration - 0.4)
		self:instantiate_booster_fx()

		--- 돌지 시작 위치 및 종료 위치 세팅
		self.dash_start_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
		self.dash_end_pos = self.dash_start_pos + self.dir_vector * self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5
		--- 대쉬 중 딱 다음 이동할 diff 값만 계산하기 위한 캐싱값
		self.old_pos = self.dash_start_pos

	elseif next_state == self.state.dash_end then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'end')
		battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, self.attack_sfx_key[random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)])

		self:instantiate_end_fx()

		self.hit_timing = self.current_time_passed + 0.1
	else

	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then return end

	self:dash_fx_update()

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.super_armor_timing) then
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.super_armor_buff_info)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
			self:change_state(self.state.dash)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dash then
		self:dash_pos_update(time_passed)
		--self:dash_fx_update()

		--- 대시 유지시간 만료로 중단 후 펀치
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_stop_timing) then
			self:change_state(self.state.dash_end)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dash_end then

		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
		end

		--- 판정 체크
		if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
			self:check_hit_box(dt)
		end
	end

	--- 액션 시간 만료로 종료 처리
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_end_timing) then
		self:change_state(self.state.none)
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end

end

function action_state_class:dash_pos_update(time_passed)
	--- 진행도
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(math.min(time_passed - self.dash_timing, self.dash_duration) / self.dash_duration, 0, 1, 1)
	--local progress = math.min(time_passed - self.dash_timing / self.dash_duration, 1)
	--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
	local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.dash_start_pos, self.dash_end_pos, progress)
	--- 앞으로 전진 할 거리만큼의 거리만 계산
	local diff = new_pos - self.old_pos
	self.old_pos = self.old_pos + diff

	--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
	if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) then
		--- 이동 요청
		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff.normalized, diff.magnitude, CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreSlope)
	end
end

function action_state_class:dash_fx_update()
	if self.booster_left_follower ~= nil and self.booster_left_follower.SkeletonRenderer ~= self.spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation then
		self.booster_left_follower.SkeletonRenderer = self.spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation
	end

	if self.booster_right_follower ~= nil and self.booster_right_follower.SkeletonRenderer ~= self.spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation then
		self.booster_right_follower.SkeletonRenderer = self.spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation
	end
end

function action_state_class:instantiate_booster_fx()
	--- 부스터 이펙트를 본 팔로워에 부착한다.
	if self.booster_left_fx == nil then
		self.booster_left_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'loop_L',
			character_util.get_position(self.owner),
			nil,
			character_util.get_transform(self.owner),
			parent_follow_flag.none
		)

		--- 광폭화 지속 이펙트가 생성되었을때
		if self.booster_left_fx then
			--- 본 팔로워 컴포넌트 (PooledUnityObject의 GetComponentInChildren는 캐싱)
			local bone_follower = self.booster_left_fx:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
			self.booster_left_follower = bone_follower
			bone_follower.ApplyViewportScaler = false

			--- 본 팔로워 컴포넌트가 있는 경우
			if bone_follower then
				--- 본 팔로워가 따라갈 스켈레톤 설정
				bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = self.spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation
				--- 본팔로워의 본 설정
				bone_follower:SetBone('boostL_eff')
				--- 본 팔로워가 본의 로테이션을 따라가지 않도록 설정
				bone_follower.followBoneRotation = true
				--- 본 팔로워가 본의 flip에 의해 scale이 반전되지 않도록 설정
				bone_follower.followSkeletonFlip = false
			end
		end

	end
	if self.booster_right_fx == nil then
		self.booster_right_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'loop_R',
			character_util.get_position(self.owner),
			nil,
			character_util.get_transform(self.owner),
			parent_follow_flag.none
		)

		--- 광폭화 지속 이펙트가 생성되었을때
		if self.booster_right_fx then
			--- 본 팔로워 컴포넌트 (PooledUnityObject의 GetComponentInChildren는 캐싱)
			local bone_follower = self.booster_right_fx:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))

			bone_follower.ApplyViewportScaler = false

			--- 본 팔로워 컴포넌트가 있는 경우
			if bone_follower then
				--- 본 팔로워가 따라갈 스켈레톤 설정
				bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = self.spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation
				--- 본팔로워의 본 설정
				bone_follower:SetBone('boostR_eff')
				--- 본 팔로워가 본의 로테이션을 따라가지 않도록 설정
				bone_follower.followBoneRotation = true
				--- 본 팔로워가 본의 flip에 의해 scale이 반전되지 않도록 설정
				bone_follower.followSkeletonFlip = false
			end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, send_shake)
	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	--target.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(false)
	target.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false

	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreOptions | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.damage = self.damage
	damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.EmptyHitEffect.Instance
	damage_info.not_mortal = true

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.FactorNormal
	damage_info.stun_duration = self.stun_duration

	damage_info.knock_back_dir = self.dir_vector
	damage_info.knock_back_force = self.knock_back_force
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.knock_back_factor

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행 및 결과 정보 받아옴
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	target.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true

	local custom_event = CS.Oak.MoneyShotEvent.Create(
		self.owner,
		CS.Oak.MoneyShotEventType.Damage,
		CS.Oak.MoneyShotAttackTag.HeavyAttack,
		self.damage,
		self.stun_duration,
		self.knock_back_distance,
		self.knock_back_duration,
		self.hit_height,
		send_shake and self.magnitude or 0,
		send_shake and self.shake_duration or 0
	)
	message_system:Send(target, custom_event)
end

function action_state_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.cs_action.IsActive == false then return end

	--- 대쉬 이벤트 중일 때만
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) and self.current_state == self.state.dash then
		--- 대시 유지 최소 시간을 지나지 않았다면, 광클해도 바로 멈추지 않느다.
		if self.min_dash_duration + self.dash_timing >= self.current_time_passed then return end
		--- 대시 중 키를 다시한번 누름
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.TouchEventType, CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SpecialFunction2TouchDown) then
			local diff = self.dash_stop_timing - self.current_time_passed
			self.action_end_timing = self.action_duration - diff
			self:change_state(self.state.dash_end)
		end
	end
	return false
end

function action_state_class:check_hit_box(dt)

	--- 중심 위치
	local target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.dir_vector

	--- 충돌체 위치 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, target_pos)
	--- 충돌체 방향 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)

	local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)
	--- 판정한 대상이 없다면 생략함
	if #hit_targets > 0 then
		for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
			self:apply_damage(target, hit_targets[1] == target)
		end
		-- 랜덤 'hit' 사운드 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, self.hit_sfx_key[random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)])
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기가 종료된 시점
	if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
		--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_spine_event(entry, event)
	--- 이벤트 키 검증
	if event.Data.Name == 'sfx' then
		battle_util.play_sfx_for_camera_fx(self.action, 'sfx')
	end
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

end

function local_class:dispose()

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.action_state:dispose()

		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4,
	}

	self.sync_type = {
		attack_range = 1,
		explosion = 2,
	}

	self.current_state = self.state.none
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.spawn_table = {}

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 0.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 0.3)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

	self.attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackRadius', 1.5)
	self.damage_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageRatio', 0.2)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackForce', 1)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, self.attack_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local dist = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, target.Position)

	return dist <= self.attack_radius
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	--enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('bomb_loop',CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))

		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
		--- 싱크 타입 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.sync_type.attack_range)
		--- 오너 위치
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.character.Position)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('bomb_end',CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false))

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
		--- 싱크 타입 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.sync_type.explosion)
		--- 오너 위치
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.character.Position)
		--- 타겟 위치
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.target.Position)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)

	else
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0

end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if not self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	local sync_state = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	if sync_state == self.sync_type.attack_range then
		--- 어택레인지 싱크
		local range_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		--- 어택레인지
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, range_pos)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration + self.action_duration)

	elseif sync_state == self.sync_type.explosion then
		--- 폭발 싱크
		local owner_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
		local target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 1)

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self:do_explosion(owner_pos, target_pos)
		self:do_suicide()
	end
end

function local_class:do_explosion(owner_pos, target_pos)

	local dist = vector_util.distance(owner_pos, target_pos)

	if dist <= self.attack_radius then
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = self.target
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(self.target.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_ratio)
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force
		damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_light_02')
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end

end

function local_class:do_suicide()
	local self_damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	self_damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
	self_damage_info.sender = self.character
	self_damage_info.target = self.character
	self_damage_info.damage = CS.Oak.DamageConstants.InstantKillDamage
	command_util.publish_damage(self_damage_info)

	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast', self.character.Position)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed > self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.attack_range:Hide()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil

end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,

local local_class = newclass('SummonBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4,
	}

	self.sync_type = {
		spawn_monster = 1,
	}

	self.current_state = self.state.none
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.spawn_table = {}

	self.spawn_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SpawnWidth', 5)
	self.spawn_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SpawnHeight', 5)

	self.spawn_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(self.spawn_width, 5, self.spawn_height))
	self.spawn_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'SpawnCount', 5)
	self.spawn_between = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'SpawnBetween', 0.5)

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 1.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

	self.spawn_effect_offset = CS.Utils.GetVector3FromDictionary(params, 'SpawnEffectOffset', unity_class.vector3(0, 1, 0))

	self.on_stage_loaded_func = function(e)
		self:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	end

	self.on_destroyed_event = function(e)
		self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	end

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_destroyed_event)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_func)
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	self:assign_monsters()

	self:set_monster_no_drop()

end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.FieldObject) then
		return
	end

	local battle_group = battle_manager:GetBattleGroup(self.character)

	if battle_group == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.spawn_table do
		local table = self.spawn_table[i]
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(table.monster, e.FieldObject) then
			table.spawned = false
			battle_group:Remove(table.monster)
			break;
		end
	end

end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	if self:get_available_spawn_count() == 0 then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:assign_monsters()
	local prefix = self.character.name.."_spawn_"
	local index = 1

	while true do

		local target_name = prefix..tostring(index)

		local monster = get_character(target_name)
		if monster == nil then
			break
		end

		local spawn_item = {
			spawned = false,
			monster = monster,
		}

		table.insert(self.spawn_table, spawn_item)
		index = index + 1
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if self.fx_loop ~= nil then
			self.fx_loop:Dispose()
			self.fx_loop = nil
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	--enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast_loop')
		self.fx_loop = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast', self.character.Position + self.spawn_effect_offset)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:sync_spawn_monsters()
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('spawn')
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('summon', self.character.Position + self.spawn_effect_offset)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0

end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if not self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	local sync_state = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	--enter
	if sync_state == self.sync_type.spawn_monster then
		self:spawn_monsters(info)
	end
end

function local_class:set_monster_no_drop()

	local battle_group = battle_manager:GetBattleGroup(self.character)

	if battle_group == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.spawn_table do
		local monster = self.spawn_table[i].monster

		if not is_unity_null(monster) then
			monster.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

			battle_group:Remove(monster)

			stage.DropManager:AddToNoDrop(monster)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed > self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:create_random_positions()

	local position_table = {}

	for i = 1, self.spawn_count do

		while true do

			local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(-self.spawn_zone_bound.extents.x, self.spawn_zone_bound.extents.x)
			local rand_z = unity_class.random.Range(-self.spawn_zone_bound.extents.z, self.spawn_zone_bound.extents.z)

			local position = vector(rand_x, 0, rand_z) + self.spawn_zone_bound.center
			local has_value = true

			for _, comp in ipairs(position_table) do
				local dist = vector_util.sqr_xz_distance(comp, position)
				if dist <= self.spawn_between then
					has_value = false
					break
				end
			end

			if has_value then
				table.insert(position_table, position)
				break
			end
		end
	end

	return position_table
end

function local_class:get_opposite_direction_by_vector(position)

	local dir = position - self.character.Position

	return dir:GetX0z():ToDirection(dir)
end

function local_class:get_available_spawn_count()
	local current_spawn_count = 0

	for _, table in ipairs(self.spawn_table) do
		if current_spawn_count >= self.spawn_count then
			break
		end

		if table.spawned == false then
			current_spawn_count = current_spawn_count + 1
		end
	end

	return current_spawn_count;
end

function local_class:spawn_monsters(info)

	local battle_group = battle_manager:GetBattleGroup(self.character)

	if battle_group == nil then
		return
	end

	for idx = 1, self.spawn_count do repeat
		--- info 에 인덱스가 1번부터 저장되어 있을 것
		local table_idx = info:GetIntegerAt(idx, -1)

		if table_idx < 0 then
			break
		end

		local table = self.spawn_table[table_idx]

		--- 이미 스폰되어있다?
		if table.spawned == true then
			return
		end

		--- 인덱스에 맞는 포지션 들고옴
		local position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, idx - 1)

		table.monster.Position = position
		table.monster.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		table.monster.Direction = self:get_opposite_direction_by_vector(position)

		-- 힐
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
		heal_info.heal = table.monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.sender = self.character
		heal_info.target = table.monster
		heal_info.skipEffect = true

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

		battle_group:AddToCurrentWave(table.monster)

		-- 몬스터 노티스 이벤트를 쏴준다
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(table.monster, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
		message_system:Send(table.monster.FieldObjectController,
			CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(table.monster, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGroupWaveFieldObjectSpawnedEvent.Create(table.monster))
		table.spawned = true
	until true end
end

--- 스폰 필요한 녀석들만 골라서 싱크를 쏜다.
function local_class:sync_spawn_monsters()

	local current_spawn_count = 1

	local position_table = self:create_random_positions()

	local battle_group = battle_manager:GetBattleGroup(self.character)

	if battle_group == nil then
		return
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
	--- 싱크 타입 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.sync_type.spawn_monster)

	--- 현재 스폰테이블 보고 가능한 애들만 담아서 따로 싱크를 통해 스폰한다.
	for idx = 1, self.spawn_count do repeat
		if self.spawn_table[idx].monster.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
			break
		end

		--- 스폰 인덱스 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, idx)
		--- 스폰 위치
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, position_table[idx])
	until true end

	--- 싱크 배포
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--- spawn_table 해제
	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.spawn_table)
	self.spawn_table = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_destroyed_event)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_func)

end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('TargetingTargetConstantShieldBattleAction')

--========================================
-- 1.  공용 State 베이스 & 간단 FSM
--========================================
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.__index = simple_state_machine

function simple_state_machine:new(initial_state)
	return setmetatable({state = initial_state}, self)
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	if self.state and self.state.exit then
		self.state:exit()
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if new_state and new_state.enter then
		new_state.time_passed = 0
		new_state:enter()
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self.state and self.state.update then
		self.state.ctx.action_time_passed = self.state.ctx.action_time_passed + dt  -- action 공통 time

		local old_state_time_passed = self.state.time_passed
		self.state.time_passed = self.state.time_passed + dt 						-- state 개별 time
		if self.state.update then
			self.state:update(old_state_time_passed, self.state.time_passed, dt)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {}               -- 모든 스테이트의 뼈대
state_base.__index = state_base

function state_base:new(ctx)        -- ctx = 액션 공용 데이터(Owner, 파라미터 등)
	return setmetatable({ctx = ctx, time_passed = 0}, self)
end

local prewait_state = setmetatable({}, state_base)
prewait_state.__index = prewait_state

local cast_state = setmetatable({}, state_base)
cast_state.__index = cast_state

local casting_state = setmetatable({}, state_base)
casting_state.__index = casting_state

local done_state = setmetatable({}, state_base)
done_state.__index = done_state

--========================================
-- 2-1.  PreWaitState (시전 대기)
--========================================
function prewait_state:new(ctx) return state_base.new(self, ctx) end

function prewait_state:enter()
	--battle_util.set_anim(self.ctx.action, self.ctx.cs_action, 'idle')
	self.ctx.cs_action.IsActive = true
	self.ctx.action_time_passed = 0
end

function prewait_state:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.ctx.predelay) then
		self.ctx.machine:change(self.ctx.states.cast)
	end
end

function prewait_state:exit() end

--========================================
-- 2-2. CastState (타겟 탐색 & 캐스팅)
--========================================
function cast_state:new(ctx) return state_base.new(self, ctx) end

function cast_state:enter()
	local targets = battle_manager_util.get_closet_friendly_targets(self.ctx.owner, self.ctx.search_range, self.ctx.target_counts)
	if #targets >0 then               -- 실패 시 즉시 종료
		self.ctx.machine:change(self.ctx.states.casting)
	else
		self.ctx.action:cancel()
	end
end

function cast_state:exit() end

--========================================
-- 2-3. CastingState (타겟 탐색 & 캐스팅)c
--========================================
function casting_state:new(ctx) return state_base.new(self, ctx) end

function casting_state:enter()
	battle_util.set_anim(self.ctx.action, self.ctx.cs_action, 'cast')
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.ctx.action, 'cast')
	attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.ctx.owner, self.ctx.prepare_time)

end

function casting_state:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.ctx.prepare_time) then
		-- 보스일 경우 취소하기 위해 +1
		local targets = battle_manager_util.get_closet_friendly_targets(self.ctx.owner, self.ctx.search_range, self.ctx.target_counts+1)
		if not targets then               -- 실패 시 즉시 종료
			self.ctx.machine:change(self.ctx.states.prewait)
		else
			local count = 0
			for _, target in pairs(targets) do
				if count == self.ctx.target_counts then
					break
				end

				if stage.BattleManager:IsBoss(target) then
					-- 보스 적용 체크
					if self.ctx.is_boss then
						self:apply_buff(target)
						count = count + 1
					end
				-- 일반 몬스터 바로 적용
				else
					self:apply_buff(target)
					count = count + 1
				end
			end
			self.ctx.machine:change(self.ctx.states.done)
		end
	end
end

function casting_state:exit()
	battle_util.set_anim(self.ctx.action, self.ctx.cs_action, 'attack')
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.ctx.owner)
end

function casting_state:apply_buff(target)
	-- 특수 보호막 버프
	buff_util.apply_buff(self.ctx.owner, target, self.ctx.buff_name, 0 )

	-- 중복 된다면 추가 버프
	if self.ctx.additional_buff_names then
		for _, name in pairs(self.ctx.additional_buff_names) do
			buff_util.apply_buff(self.ctx.owner, target, name, 0)
		end
	end
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.ctx.action, 'buff')
end

--========================================
-- 2-3. DoneState (타겟 탐색 & 캐스팅)
--========================================
function done_state:new(ctx) return state_base.new(self, ctx) end

function done_state:enter()

end

function done_state:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.25) then
		self.ctx.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

function done_state:exit()
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.ctx.cs_action)
	self.ctx.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--========================================
-- .  액션 공용 컨텍스트(파라미터 묶음)
--========================================
local function new_action_context(local_class, params)
	-- 기존 init 안에서 하던 파싱 그대로 유지
	return {
		owner          = local_class.owner,
		cs_action      = local_class.cs_action,
		action 		   = local_class,
		-- state 공용 Time
		action_time_passed = 0,

		--- 버프 파싱
		buff_name 		= cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'BuffName'),
		additional_buff_names = cs_util.get_string_table_from_dictionary(params, 'AdditionalBuffNames'),
		--- BattleAction Param
		predelay       = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'PreDelay'),
		prepare_time   = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'PrepareTime'),
		search_range   = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange'),
		target_counts  = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'TargetCounts'),
		is_boss			= cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(params, 'IsBoss'),
		machine        = nil,
	}
end

--========================================
-- .  main class
--========================================

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)
	self.fx_buff_list = {}
	-- 컨텍스트 생성
	self.ctx = new_action_context(self, params)

	self.ctx.states = {
		prewait = prewait_state:new(self.ctx),
		cast     = cast_state:new(self.ctx),
		casting  = casting_state:new(self.ctx),
		done     = done_state:new(self.ctx),
	}

	--- FSM & States
	self.ctx.machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil)
	self.state_machine = self.ctx.machine

	self.on_buff_expired_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_buff_expired_evnet(e)
	end

	self.on_buff_add_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_buff_add_event(e)
	end

	message_system_util.subscribe(typeof(event_type.buff_expired), self.on_buff_expired_event_func)
	message_system_util.subscribe(typeof(event_type.buff_add), self.on_buff_add_event_func)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(typeof(event_type.buff_expired), self.on_buff_expired_event_func)
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(typeof(event_type.buff_add), self.on_buff_add_event_func)

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.ctx = nil
	self.fx_buff_list = nil
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:trigger()
	--- 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지 판단
	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.ctx.cs_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.ctx.owner, self.ctx.cs_action, info)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	self.state_machine:change(self.ctx.states.prewait)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end
	-- 1) FSM 종료(현재 state exit 실행)
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	-- 2) 공유 컨텍스트 초기화
	self.ctx.action_time_passed = 0
	self.ctx.cs_action.IsActive = false
	message_system_util.publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
function local_class:sync(_)
end

function local_class:on_buff_expired_evnet(e)
	--- 걸어주는 버프가 expired 되었을때 이펙트를 해지 (버프 Expired전에 같은 버프가 걸렸을 경우 Effect 해지되지 않음)
	if not character_util.has_active_buff(e.Target, self.ctx.buff_name) then
		local buff_spec = buff_util.get_buff_spec_from_name(self.ctx.buff_name)
		if  buff_util.is_buff_expired(buff_spec.Id, e) then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_buff_list[e.Target])
			local effect = battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(self, 'break', e.Target, bounds_util.get_center(e.Target), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(e.Target), parent_follow_flag.position)
			local size = bounds_util.get_size(e.Target)
			effect.transform.localScale = self:get_clamp_bounds(size)

			for _, buffName in pairs(self.ctx.additional_buff_names) do
				self.ctx.action.sfx_info['break'].playPosition = e.Target.Position
				battle_util.play_sfx(self.ctx.action, 'break')
				buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner,e.Target,buffName)
			end
			-- sfx_util.fade_out(self.buff_audio_holder, 1.5)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_buff_add_event(e)
	--- 추가된 버프
	local buff = e.Buff

	if buff.BuffSpec.Name ~= self.ctx.buff_name then return end
	--- 버프를 보낸 객체 체크
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, buff.Sender) then return end

	--- 버프를 받은 객체 체크
	if character_util.has_active_buff(get_character(buff.Target.Name), self.ctx.buff_name) then

		-- 특수 보호막 이펙트
		local effect = battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(self.ctx.action,'buff', buff.Target, bounds_util.get_center(buff.Target), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(buff.Target), parent_follow_flag.position)
		local size = bounds_util.get_size(buff.Target)
		effect.transform.localScale = self:get_clamp_bounds(size)

		self.fx_buff_list[buff.Target] = effect
	end
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부

	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지

	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)

function local_class:on_event(e)

end

function local_class:bounds_clamp(x, z)
	-- 기준 길이: 가장 긴 쪽
	local maxSize = math.max(x, z)
	local minSize = math.min(x, z)

	-- 너무 찌그러지는 걸 방지하는 최소 비율
	local minRatio = 0.25

	-- 실제 비율 구하기
	local ratio = minSize / maxSize

	-- 보정된 길이
	local correctedX = x
	local correctedZ = z

	if ratio < minRatio then
		if x < z then
			correctedX = z * minRatio
		else
			correctedZ = x * minRatio
		end
	end

	return correctedX, correctedZ
end

function local_class:get_clamp_bounds(size)
	-- 1보다 작으면 무조건 1로 설정
	local rawX = math.max(1.25, math.min(3, size.x))
	local rawY = math.max(1.25, math.min(5, size.y))
	local rawZ = math.max(1.25, math.min(3, size.z))

	local x, z = self:bounds_clamp(rawX, rawZ)

	-- x와 z의 차이가 1 이상이면 보정
	if math.abs(x - z) > 1 then
		if x > z then
			z = x - 1
		else
			x = z - 1
		end
	end

	return CS.UnityEngine.Vector3(
			x,
			rawY,
			z
	)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('TentacleSwingBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 1.6)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 0.6)
	self.attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackRadius", 3)
	local attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDelay", 0)
	local attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDuration", 0.5)
	local max_hit = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "MaxHit", 0)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.0)

	-- 공격 계산기 (최대 1히트 하도록 DamageTerm 및 maxHit 설정
	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Radius = self.attack_radius
	info.Duration = attack_duration
	info.Height = 3
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, attack_delay, max_hit)

	-- 공격 범위 표시
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_radius)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	self.target = nil

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.prepare_key = 'prepare'
	self.action_key = 'action'
	self.post_key = 'post'
	self.down_key = 'down'
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.attack_radius
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.character.CrashBehaviour = nil
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
	self.character.CrashBehaviour = nil
	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		self.attack_range:Hide(0)
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.target_dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.character.Position)
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir_vector
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.action_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.down_key, self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.down_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.post_key)
		self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	else
		if self.current_state and self.current_state ~= self.state.none and self.disposing ~= true then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = self.character
			damage_info.damage = CS.Oak.DamageConstants.InstantKillDamage

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
		self.character.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:update_action(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_action(dt)
	-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) and self:is_hittable(fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction
			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.disposing = true
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.attack_radius = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil

	self.target_direction = nil
	self.target_dir_vector = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil

	self.disposing = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

--- 몬스터 배틀액션
--- 영역 전개 몬스터 (wall_area) 기술
local local_class = newclass('WallAreaBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--- 이 액션의 싱크 유형들
local sync_types = {
	refresh_targeting = 1,
	to_teleport = 2,
	to_end = 3,
	cancel_field = 4
}

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 준비 시간
	prepare_duration = nil,
	--- 타겟팅 시간
	target_search_duration = nil,
	--- 어택 레인지
	attack_range = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 준비 시간
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration')
	--- 타겟팅 시간
	self.target_search_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TargetSearchDuration')

	--- 폭
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 길이
	local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	--- 어택 레인지
	self.attack_range = battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(width, length), attack_range_show_type.overlay_outward)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 목표 위치 (그럴일은 없지만 대상이 없다면 내 위치로 처리한다.)
	local target_pos = self.target and character_util.get_position(self.target) or character_util.get_position(self.owner)
	--- 마지막으로 캐싱한 위치 지면으로 클리핑
	self.last_position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(target_pos)

	--- 타겟팅 되었음을 배포
	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.owner, self.target)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니 세팅
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- 방향 설정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 위치 갱신
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.last_position)
	--- 어택 레인지 활성화
	battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration)
	--- 어택레인지 정보 갱신
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range)

	-- 캐스팅 게이지 활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.prepare_duration)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
	battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
	--- 어택레인지 정보 해제
	battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range)

	-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)
end

function action_state_class:dispose()
	battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 싱크 주체인가
	local is_usable_routine = battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner)
	--- 준비 상태 완료하여 싱크 보낼 예정인가
	local prepare_ready = is_usable_routine and time_passed >= self.prepare_duration
	--- 이번 프레임에 싱크를 진행할 수 있는가 (로컬인 경우에만 허용한다)
	local can_sync_now = is_usable_routine and not prepare_ready

	-- GT-392로 인해 매 프레임 대상을 탐색하도록 변경
	self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTargetWithCharacter(self.owner, self.target, nil, true))

	-- 준비하는 동안 대상을 바라봄
	if self.target and old_time_passed <= self.prepare_duration then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

		-- 대상이 유효한 경우 어택레인지 위치 등을 갱신한다.
		if self.target then
			--- 일단 착지 가능할 위치를 기준으로 어택레인지가 나오게 하였음
			self.last_position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.target))
			--- 위치 갱신
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.last_position)
			--- 어택레인지 정보 갱신
			battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range)

		-- 대상이 유효하지 않으면서 본인은 로컬 객체인 경우 별도 처리를 한다.
		elseif can_sync_now then
			-- target search duration 동안만 대상을 재탐색한다.
			-- GT-392로 인해 매 프레임 대상을 탐색하도록 변경 - 재탐색 필요없음
			self:target_sync_routine()

			-- 싱크를 하지 않도록 변경한다.
			can_sync_now = false
		end
	end

	-- 탐색 시간이 지나면 싱크를 먹여버린다.
	if can_sync_now and battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.target_search_duration) then
		self:target_sync_routine(self.target)
		-- 싱크를 하지 않도록 변경한다.
		can_sync_now = false
	end

	-- 준비가 완료되면 즉시 싱크
	if prepare_ready then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 싱크 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, sync_types.to_teleport)
		--- 주 대상 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
		--- 목표 위치 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.last_position)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

function action_state_class:target_sync_routine(target)
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	--- 싱크 플래그 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, sync_types.refresh_targeting)

	-- 대상이 있는 경우
	if target then
		--- 목표 위치 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	else
		--- 목표 위치 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.last_position)
	end

	--- 싱크 배포
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	if trigger_info_util.contains_target(info) then
		--- 대상 싱크
		self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
		--- 위치 가져옴
		self.last_position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.target))
	else
		--- 위치 싱크
		self.last_position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	end

	--- 위치 갱신
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.last_position)
	--- 어택레인지 정보 갱신
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range)

	-- 타겟 표시용 UI를 위해서 타겟이 변경되면 이벤트 배포
	-- 어택레인지 등은 어처피 다음번에 위치 갱신될것이고, 이미 지났다면 비저비터를 놓친 것
	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.owner, self.target)
end

function action_state_class:change_target(target)
	-- 타겟팅 시간 체크
	if self.current_time_passed >= self.target_search_duration then
		return
	end

	--존이 있을 경우 존 체크
	if self.action.zone ~= nil and target and not self.action.zone:Contains(target.Position) then
		target = nil
	end

	-- 대상이 같다면 생략함
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	-- 타겟 표시용 UI를 위해서 타겟이 변경되면 이벤트 배포
	-- 어택레인지 등은 어처피 다음번에 위치 갱신될것이고, 이미 지났다면 비저비터를 놓친 것
	coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.owner, self.target)
end

--endregion

--region teleport state

local teleport_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 대기 시간
	teleport_duration = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
teleport_state_class.mt = { __index = teleport_state_class }

--- create action state
function teleport_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function teleport_state_class:init(param)
	--- 텔레포트 시간
	self.teleport_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TeleportDuration')
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function teleport_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 목표 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
end

--- teleport state enter
function teleport_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 순간이동 시작 위치
	local blink_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)

	-- 블링크 이펙트 출력
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'blink', blink_pos)
	-- 블링크 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.action, 'blink', blink_pos)

	-- 방향 설정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	-- 필드에서 제외함
	character_util.set_active_state(self.owner, 'disabled')
	-- 무적 처리
	buff_util.apply_buff(self.owner, self.owner, 800014, 9999)
	-- attach crash behaviour
	battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance)
	-- set crash behaviour
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

function teleport_state_class:exit(_)
	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	-- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	-- 필드에서 제외함
	character_util.set_active_state(self.owner, 'enabled')
	-- 무적 해제 처리
	buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, 800014)
	-- set crash behaviour
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = nil
	-- detach crash behaviour
	battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function teleport_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 다음 시퀀스로 이동
	if battle_util.is_usable_routine(self.owner) and time_passed >= self.teleport_duration then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 싱크 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, sync_types.to_end)

		-- 타겟이 유효한 경우의 처리
		if not is_unity_null(self.target) and not character_util.is_dead(self.target) then
			--- 최종 확정하기 전에 마지막으로 위치를 세팅
			self.target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.target))
			--- 방향도 갱신
			self.dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, self.target)

			--- 대상 정보 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)
		end

		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
		--- 목표 위치 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.target_pos)
		--- 워프 위치 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self:calculate_target_pos(self.target_pos))
		--- 유니크 id 세팅
		local unique_key = self.action.field_state.unique_key and self.action.field_state.unique_key % 10 or 0
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, unique_key + 1)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

function teleport_state_class:calculate_target_pos(estimate_dest)
	return CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetAvoidObstaclePosition(self.owner, character_util.get_position(self.owner), estimate_dest, false)
end

--endregion

	--- 오너

	--- CS 클래스

	current_time_passed = 0,

--- create action state
function post_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner

---- parsing battle action data

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)

	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 목표 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 1)

--- post state enter
function post_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니 세팅
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'stomp')
	-- 방향 설정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	-- 위치 설정

	--- 애니 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	-- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function post_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.post_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너

	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type

	--- atk modifier

	--- 넉백 강도 배율
	knock_back_scale = nil,
	--- 장벽 넉백 강도 배율
	area_knock_back_scale = nil,

	--- 판정계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 안전지대 min
	safe_area_min = nil,
	--- 안전지대 max
	safe_area_max = nil,

	--- 캔슬 영역 max
	cancel_area_max = nil,
	--- 캔슬 영역 min
	cancel_area_min = nil,

	--- 캔슬 인증 시간

	--- 필드 이펙트 크기
	field_effect_size = nil,
	--- line 이펙트 크기
	line_effect_size = nil,
	--- 현재 동작중인 선 fx들

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
