---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackFactor')
	--- 넉백 강도 배율
	self.knock_back_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockBackScale')
	--- 장벽 넉백 강도 배율
	self.area_knock_back_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AreaKnockBackScale')

	--- 폭
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 길이
	local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	--- 높이
	local height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Height')
	--- 크기
	local size = vector(width, height, length)
	--- 판정 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size)
	--- 판정계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 폭 * 0.5
	local half_width = width * 0.5
	--- 길이 * 0.5
	local half_length = length * 0.5
	--- 안전지대 max
	self.safe_area_max = vector(half_width, height * 0.5, half_length)
	--- 안전지대 min
	self.safe_area_min = -self.safe_area_max

	--- 캔슬 영역 크기
	local cancel_area = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CancelArea')
	--- 캔슬 영역 max
	self.cancel_area_max = self.safe_area_max + vector(cancel_area, 0, cancel_area)
	--- 캔슬 영역 min
	self.cancel_area_min = -self.cancel_area_max
	--- 캔슬에 걸리는 시간
	self.cancel_require_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CancelRequireTime')
	--- 캔슬 인증 시간
	self.cancel_time_passed = 0

	--- 필드 이펙트 크기
	self.field_effect_size = vector(
		width / cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'FieldEffectWidth'),
		1,
		length / cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'FieldEffectLength')
	)
	--- line 이펙트 기본 크기
	self.line_effect_size = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LineEffectLength')
	--- 현재 동작중인 선 fx들
	self.line_fxs = {}
	--- 선 fx 오프셋
	local line_fx_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LineEffectOffset')
	--- 선 x 위치
	local line_x = half_width - line_fx_offset
	--- 선 z 위치
	local line_z = half_length - line_fx_offset
	--- 선 fx 위치
	self.line_fx_positions = {
		vector(line_x, 0, line_z),
		vector(-line_x, 0, line_z),
		vector(-line_x, 0, -line_z),
		vector(line_x, 0, -line_z)
	}

	--- 영역 지속시간
	self.area_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AreaDuration')
	--- 판정 간격
	self.area_knock_back_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AreaKnockBackTerm')
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 목표 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 캔슬 처리 식별을 위한 키
	self.unique_key = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, 1)
	-- 대상이 변경되었음을 커맨드로 공유
	command_util.publish_change_target(self.owner, self.target)
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 이펙트 발생
	self.field_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'field', self.target_pos)
	--- 효과음 발생
	battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.action, 'field', self.target_pos)

	--- 판정 쿨타임 초기화
	self.next_hit_timing = nil
	--- 지난 시간 초기화
	self.cancel_time_passed = 0

	--- 첫 판정 처리
	for _, fo in pairs(area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)) do
		self:apply_damage(fo, self.atk_modifier, self.knock_back_scale)

		--- 주 대상이 맞은 경우 쿨타임을 부여한다.
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.target) then
			self.next_hit_timing = self.area_knock_back_term
		end
	end

	-- 대상이 유효하지 않은 경우 어처피 바로 사라질 것이니 생략한다.
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then
		for idx = 1, #self.line_fx_positions do
			local pos, dir, size = self:calculate_line_toward(idx)
			local fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'line', pos, dir)
			fx.transform.localScale = size
			table.insert(self.line_fxs, fx)
		end
	end
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 해제되기 전에 이펙트 위치 가져옴
	local effect_pos = self.field_fx.transform.localPosition
	-- 이펙트 해제
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.field_fx)
	-- 해제 이펙트 발생
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'fieldend', effect_pos)

	for _ = #self.line_fxs, 1, -1 do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(table.remove(self.line_fxs))
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 때릴 수 없는 상태가 되었다면 바로 종료한다.
	if not self:validate_field_status(dt) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 싱크 플래그 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, sync_types.cancel_field)
		--- 캔슬 싱크를 인정하기 위한 unique id 지정
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.unique_key)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		-- 더 이상의 처리는 불필요하니 바로 리턴한다.
		return
	end

	for idx = 1, #self.line_fxs do
		local pos, dir, size = self:calculate_line_toward(idx)
		local fx = self.line_fxs[idx]
		effect_util.update_object(fx, pos, dir)
		fx.transform.localScale = size
	end

	if not self.next_hit_timing or time_passed >= self.next_hit_timing then
		-- 범위 내 인지 체크
		local target_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(self.target)
		local min = target_bounds.min
		local max = target_bounds.max

		local current_safe_min = self.target_pos + self.safe_area_min
		local current_safe_max = self.target_pos + self.safe_area_max

		if current_safe_max.x < max.x or current_safe_max.z < max.z or current_safe_min.x > min.x or current_safe_min.z > min.z then
			self:apply_damage(self.target, nil, self.area_knock_back_scale)
			self.next_hit_timing = time_passed + self.area_knock_back_term
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.area_duration) then
		--- 상태 머신 리셋
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

function field_state_class:validate_field_status(dt)
	--- 더이상 공격할 수 있는 상태가 아니라면
	if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then return false end

	-- 범위 내 인지 체크
	local target_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(self.target)
	local min = target_bounds.min
	local max = target_bounds.max

	local current_cancel_min = self.target_pos + self.cancel_area_min
	local current_cancel_max = self.target_pos + self.cancel_area_max

	-- 영역 체크
	if current_cancel_max.x < max.x or current_cancel_max.z < max.z or current_cancel_min.x > min.x or current_cancel_min.z > min.z then
		self.cancel_time_passed = self.cancel_time_passed + dt
		-- 시간이 지나기 전이면 참
		return self.cancel_time_passed < self.cancel_require_time
	end

	-- 영역 안이면 시간 초기화 & 참
	self.cancel_time_passed = 0
	return true
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, knock_back_scale)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.damage_type = modifier and self.damage_type or damage_attribute_type.none
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 방향 계산
	local diff = self.target_pos - character_util.get_position(target)
	local dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(diff))

	if vector_util.is_almost_zero(dir) then
		dir = vector_util.right
	end

	--- 주 대상 여부에 따라 방향 분기
	damage_info.knock_back_dir = lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.target) and dir or -dir
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * knock_back_scale

	--- 대미지 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function field_state_class:calculate_line_toward(idx)
	local target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
	local start_pos = self.target_pos + self.line_fx_positions[idx]
	local xz_diff = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - start_pos)
	local size = vector(vector_util.magnitude(xz_diff) / self.line_effect_size, 1, 1)

	return start_pos, vector_util.normalized(xz_diff), size
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- teleport state
	self.teleport_state = teleport_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- post state
	self.post_state = post_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- field state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- field state machine
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	-- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.teleport_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.post_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine

	self:init_message_system()

	self:set_battle_zone()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.action_state, self.teleport_state, self.post_state, self.field_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.post_state = nil
		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	if not self.state_machine or not self.state_machine:is_nil_state() then
		return false
	end

	--- 이 패턴의 경우 장판이 깔려있어도 사용하지 못한다.
	return self.field_machine and self.field_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then
		return false
	end

	--존이 있을 경우 존 체크
	if self.zone ~= nil and not self.zone:Contains(character_util.get_position(target)) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	-- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	local sync_value = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	if sync_value == sync_types.to_teleport then
		self.teleport_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.teleport_state)

		return
	elseif sync_value == sync_types.to_end then
		self.post_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.post_state)
		self.field_state:sync(info)
		self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)

		return

	elseif sync_value == sync_types.cancel_field then
		-- field_machine에 상태가 붙어있는 경우에만 떨어질 것
		if self.field_machine:is_nil_state() then
			return
		end

		-- 만약 붙어있더라도 unique_key가 동일한 것에 대해서만 반응할 것
		if self.field_state.unique_key ~= trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, 1) then
			return
		end

		-- 장판 철거
		self.field_machine:change(nil)

		return
	end

	-- 액션 스테이트가 붙어있는 경우만 폴백 처리를 진행한다.
	if self.state_machine.state == self.action_state then
		self.action_state:sync(info)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 장판 강제 해제
	self.field_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.field_machine then self.field_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
	--- 소환수 역소환 이벤트 처리 함수 할당
	self.on_unsummon_summonable_func = function(e) self:on_unsummon_summonable(e) end

	-- 소환수 역소환 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.unsummon_summonable, self.on_unsummon_summonable_func)
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
	-- 소환수 역소환 이벤트 구독 취소
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.unsummon_summonable, self.on_unsummon_summonable_func)
	--- 소환수 역소환 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_unsummon_summonable_func = nil
end

function local_class:on_unsummon_summonable(e)
	-- 장판 머신이 유효하지 않다면 생략
	if not self.field_machine or self.field_machine:is_nil_state() then return end

	--- 역소환된 소환수
	local summonable = e.Character
	-- 유효하지 않은 소환수인 경우 생략함
	if not summonable then
		return
	end

	-- 장판 대상이랑 같지 않으면 생략
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(summonable, self.field_state.target) then
		return
	end

	-- 대상이 역소환되었다면 장판이 해제되도록 강제 캔슬을 유발한다.
	self:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	-- 장판 머신이 유효하지 않다면 생략
	if not self.field_machine or self.field_machine:is_nil_state() then return end

	-- 상태이상 이벤트만 체크
	if not ailment_util.is_ailment_event(e) then
		return
	end

	-- 걸린 대상이 자신인지 체크
	-- (on_event로 오면 당연히 본인이겠지만 크로스 체크)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.owner, ailment_util.get_target_from_event(e)) then
		return
	end

	-- 장판이 해제되도록 강제 캔슬을 유발한다.
	self:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone()
	self.zone = field:GetZone(self.owner.FieldObjectController.Zone)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end
}

function local_class:init(cs_battle_add_on, param)

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	local color = CS.Oak.RogueChessSummonerSpellSystem.SpellRangeColor
	local fail_color = CS.Oak.RogueChessSummonerSpellSystem.UnavailableRangeColor
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero,

	self.unavailable_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero,
			self.radius, fail_color, fail_color, fail_color, fail_color,
			CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

end

	return true
end

-- 버프 대상인지
function local_class:is_buff_applicable(fo)
	return CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsPlayer(fo.EntityGroup)
			and not fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and fo.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
end

-- 전투 시작 했는지
function local_class:is_battle_started()
	return self.battle_zone ~= nil
end

function local_class:on_battle_start(_)
	-- 현재 서브 시스템 로그체스
	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()
	-- 전투 시작하면 zone 받아옴
	self.battle_zone = field:GetZone(self.rc_sub_system.Control.CurrentBattleZoneName)
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(_)
	-- 버프 종료
	self:deactivate()
	self.battle_zone = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.rc_sub_system and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.RogueChessSummonerSpellEvent) then
		self:on_summoner_spell_event(e)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_summoner_spell_event(e)
	local button_up = e.IsButtonUp
	local pos = e.TargetPos

	local pos_contained = rogue_chess_util.handle_summoner_spell_range(
			self.battle_zone, pos, self.attack_range, self.unavailable_range)

	if button_up then
		-- 포지션 배틀존 바운드 내에 있지 않으면 실행하지 않음
		if pos_contained then
			self:apply_effect(pos)
			rogue_chess_util.on_summoner_spell_use_result(true)
			self.attack_range:Hide()
		else
			rogue_chess_util.on_summoner_spell_use_result(false)
			self.unavailable_range:Hide()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:apply_effect(pos)
	-- 범위 내에 버프 적용
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.radius)
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		if self:is_buff_applicable(fo) then
			self:apply_buff(fo)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:apply_buff(fo)
	-- 기존 버프가 있으면 제거하고 다시 적용
	if character_util.has_active_buff(fo, self.buff_id) then
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(fo, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, self.buff_id)
	end
	buff_manager:AddBuff(fo, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, self.buff_id, self.buff_level, false, false)
end

function local_class:deactivate()
end

function local_class:force_stop()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:reset()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:deactivate()
	self.battle_zone = nil

	if self.attack_range then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.attack_range = nil
	end
	if self.unavailable_range then
		self.unavailable_range:Hide()
		self.unavailable_range = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(cs_battle_add_on, param)
		return local_class(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	end
}

--- 로그체스 지원 포격(적군을 향한)
local local_class = newclass('RogueChessArtilleryFireBattleAddOn')

local bomb_class = {
	parent = nil,
	owner = nil,
	cs_battle_add_on = nil,

	range = nil,
	calculator = nil,
	damage = nil,
	elemental_type = nil,

	start_pos = nil,
	target_pos = nil,
	fall_duration = nil,

	time_passed = nil,
	is_active = nil
}
bomb_class.mt = { __index = bomb_class }

function bomb_class:new(parent, calculator, range, start_pos, target_pos)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.parent = parent
	obj.owner = parent.owner
	obj.cs_battle_add_on = parent.cs_battle_add_on

	obj.range = range
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, target_pos)
	range:Show(parent.fall_duration);
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(parent.owner, range))

	obj.calculator = calculator
	obj.damage = parent.damage
	obj.elemental_type = parent.elemental_type

	obj.start_pos = start_pos
	obj.target_pos = target_pos
	obj.fall_duration = parent.fall_duration
	obj.position = start_pos

	obj.time_passed = 0
	obj.is_active = true

	local projectile = obj.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('projectile', start_pos)
	obj.projectile = projectile

	return obj
end

function bomb_class:update_position(dt)
	if self.is_active == false then
		return false
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
		self.projectile.transform.position = self.target_pos
		self:process_damage(self.target_pos)
		self:play_explosion_fx()
		self.range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.owner, self.range))
		self:dispose()
		return true
	end

	self.projectile.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(
			self.start_pos, self.target_pos,
			unity_class.mathf.Pow(self.time_passed / self.fall_duration, 2))
end

function bomb_class:play_explosion_fx()
	self.explosion = self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('explosion', self.target_pos)
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('explosion', self.target_pos)
end

function bomb_class:process_damage(pos)
	local calculator = self.calculator
	area_collision_util.start(calculator)
	area_collision_util.set_position(calculator, pos)

	local targets = area_collision_util.update(calculator, 0)
	for _, target in pairs(targets) do
		if target ~= nil  then
			local knockback_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - pos).normalized

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = self.owner
			damage_info.target = target
			damage_info.direction = knockback_dir
			damage_info.damage = self.damage

			if self.elemental_type ~= nil then
				damage_info.convertAttackTo = self.elemental_type
			end

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	targets:Dispose()
	area_collision_util.calc_end(calculator)
end

function bomb_class:dispose()
	self.owner = nil
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.is_active = false
	self.range = nil
	self.calculator = nil

	if self.projectile ~= nil then
		self.projectile:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:init(cs_battle_add_on, param)

	self.cs_battle_add_on = cs_battle_add_on

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		init_delay = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		shoot = 3
	}
	self.current_state = self.state.none
	self.activated = false

	self.owner = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
	self.owner.Owner = CS.Oak.Player.Local
	self.owner.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player0

	local damage_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'DamageRateBase', 0.0)
			+ CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'DamageRateAdd', 0.05) * self.cs_battle_add_on.Level
	self.shoot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'ShootInterval', 0.2)

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration', 2)
	self.barrage_num = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'ShootAtOnce', 4)
	self.start_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'StartDelay', 2)
	self.fall_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'FallDuration', 2)
	self.explosion_sfx_handle_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(param, 'ExplosionSfx', '02_explosion_01')
	self.explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'ExplosionRadius', 1)
	self.scatter = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'Scatter', 1.5)
	self.elemental_type = nil

	local elemental_type_string = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(param, 'Elemental')
	if elemental_type_string ~= nil and elemental_type_string ~= '' then
		self.elemental_type = CS.Oak.ElementalTypeExtensions.GetFromString(elemental_type_string)
	end

	self.fall_height = 20

	self.bombs = {}

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.shoot_count = 0
	self.theta = 0.0
	self.target_pos_cache = vector_util.zero

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent), 'on_global_timer_alarm')

	self.light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(121, 43, 244, 76)
	self.dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(101, 65, 253, 153)
	self.overlay_light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(101, 65, 253, 128)
	self.overlay_dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 53, 53, 0)

	self.deck_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem().Deck
	local roaster_count = self.deck_system.Rosters.Count
	local total_dps = 0
	for i = 0, roaster_count - 1 do repeat
		local member = self.deck_system.Rosters[i].Character
		local dps = character_util.get_dps(member)
		total_dps = total_dps + dps
	until true end

	self.damage = math.floor(total_dps * damage_rate)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_battle_start(_)
	self.activated = true
	self:change_state(self.state.init_delay)
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(_)
	self:reset()
end

function local_class:on_global_timer_alarm(e)
	--- 타이머 알림은 두번온다. 타임아웃에 의한 만료일때만 중단시켜준다.
	if e.IsComplete == true then
		self:deactivate()
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.shoot_count = 0
		self.theta = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, math.pi - 2)

		local zone = CS.Oak.RogueChessSystem.Instance.Wave.CurrentZone

		local random_x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(zone.Bounds.min.x, zone.Bounds.max.x)
		local random_z = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(zone.Bounds.min.z, zone.Bounds.max.z)

		self.target_pos_cache = vector(random_x, 0, random_z)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_bombs(dt)

	if self.activated == false then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state ~= self.state.shoot and not self:is_anyone_playing() then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.shoot_count < self.barrage_num then
			if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_count * self.shoot_interval then
				self:shoot()
			end
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.init_delay then
		if self.time_passed > self.start_delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_bombs(dt)
	for index = #self.bombs, 1, -1 do
		if self.bombs[index]:update_position(dt) == true then
			table.remove(self.bombs, index)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_anyone_playing()
	local roaster_count = self.deck_system.Rosters.Count
	for i = 0, roaster_count - 1 do repeat
		local roaster = self.deck_system.Rosters[i]
		if not roaster.IsPlaying then
			break
		end

		return true
	until true end

	return false
end

function local_class:shoot()
	self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1

	-- 처음에만 발사음 출력
	if self.shoot_count == 1 then
		self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('prepare')
	end

	local offset = vector_util.zero
	if self.shoot_count > 1 then
		local rot = 2 * math.pi / (self.barrage_num - 1)
		local rand = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-rot, rot) * 0.3
		local value = self.theta + rand + rot * self.shoot_count
		offset = vector(math.cos(value), 0, math.sin(value) * self.scatter)
	end

	self:shoot_bomb(self.target_pos_cache + offset)
end

function local_class:shoot_bomb(target_pos)
	--투사체 공격 계산기 생성
	local collision_info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	collision_info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	collision_info.DamageTerm = 1
	collision_info.Radius = self.explosion_radius
	collision_info.Duration = 1
	collision_info.Height = 1.5

	local calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.owner, collision_info)

	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(
			target_pos,
			self.explosion_radius,
			self.light_color,
			self.dark_color,
			self.overlay_light_color,
			self.overlay_dark_color,
			CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

	attack_range:Hide()

	--발사음
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('shoot', target_pos)

	local start_pos = self.target_pos_cache + vector_util.up * self.fall_height
	local bomb = bomb_class:new(self, calculator, attack_range, start_pos, target_pos)

	table.insert(self.bombs, bomb)
end

function local_class:deactivate()
	self.activated = false
	self.shoot_count = 0
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:reset()
	self.activated = false
	self.shoot_count = 0
	self.time_passed = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:deactivate()

	if self.fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
	end
	self.fx = nil

	self.owner = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.cs_battle_add_on = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))
end

return {
	create = function(cs_battle_add_on, param)
		return local_class(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	end,
}

		local character = rosters[i].Character
		total_dps = total_dps + character_util.get_dps(character)
	end

	self.base_obj = self.rc_sub_system.EndCondition.BaseObject
	for _ = 1, self.damage_self_amount do
		self:damage_self()
	end

	self.actual_shoot_term = self.shoot_term
	self.total_dps = total_dps
	self.projectile_table = {}
	self.elemental_type_count_table = {}
	self.target_elemental_type = nil
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.is_active = true
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(_)
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:update_shoot_term()
	self.actual_shoot_term = math.max(self.shoot_term - self:get_highest_count() * self.reduce_term, 0.1)
end

function local_class:get_highest_count()
	if self.target_elemental_type == nil or self.elemental_type_count_table[self.target_elemental_type] == nil then
		return 0
	end
	return self.elemental_type_count_table[self.target_elemental_type]
end

function local_class:on_play_rc_deck_event(e)
	if self.elemental_type_count_table == nil then
		return false
	end

	local fo = e.CardInfo.Character

	local elemental_type = fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ElementalType
	if self.elemental_type_count_table[elemental_type] then
		self.elemental_type_count_table[elemental_type] = self.elemental_type_count_table[elemental_type] + 1
	else
		self.elemental_type_count_table[elemental_type] = 1
	end

	if self:get_highest_count() < self.elemental_type_count_table[elemental_type] then
		self.target_elemental_type = elemental_type
	end

	self:update_shoot_term()

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_leave_event(e)
	if self.rc_sub_system == nil or self.elemental_type_count_table == nil then
		return false
	end

	local fo = e.FieldObject
	if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsFriendlyTo(CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player, fo.EntityGroup) then
		return false
	end

	local is_player = false
	local rosters = self.rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do
		local roster = rosters[i]
		local character = roster.Character

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(character, fo) then
			is_player = true
			break
		end
	end

	if not is_player then
		return false
	end

	local elemental_type = fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ElementalType
	if self.elemental_type_count_table[elemental_type] == nil then
		return false
	end

	if self.elemental_type_count_table[elemental_type] <= 1 then
		self.elemental_type_count_table[elemental_type] = nil
	else
		self.elemental_type_count_table[elemental_type] = self.elemental_type_count_table[elemental_type] - 1
	end

	if elemental_type == self.target_elemental_type then
		local highest_value = -1
		local highest_type = nil
		for type, count in pairs(self.elemental_type_count_table) do
			if highest_value < count then
				highest_value = self.elemental_type_count_table[type]
				highest_type = type
			end
		end
		self.target_elemental_type = highest_type
	end

	self:update_shoot_term()

	return false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.is_active then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self:update_projectile(dt)

	if self.time_passed >= self.actual_shoot_term then
		if is_unity_null(self.target) or character_util.is_dead(self.target) then
			self:search_target()
			if self.target == nil then
				return
			end
		end

		self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.actual_shoot_term
		self:shoot()
	end
end

function local_class:update_projectile(dt)
	if self.projectile_table == nil then
		return
	end
	for i = #self.projectile_table, 1, -1 do repeat
		local target = self.projectile_table[i].target
		if is_unity_null(target) or character_util.is_dead(target) then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.projectile_table[i].proj_fx)
			table.remove(self.projectile_table, i)
			break
		end

		self.projectile_table[i].time_passed = self.projectile_table[i].time_passed + dt
		local progress = self.projectile_table[i].time_passed / self.projectile_table[i].hit_time
		progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
		if progress >= 1 then
			--- hit
			self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect(self.shoot_key, target.Position)
			--- sfx
			self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx(self.shoot_key)

			local damage = self.total_dps * self.damage_rate
			damage = math.floor(damage)

			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = target
			damage_info.target = target
			damage_info.damage = damage

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.projectile_table[i].proj_fx)
			table.remove(self.projectile_table, i)
		else
			local fx_pos = self.projectile_table[i].start_pos * (1 - progress) + target.Position * progress
			effect_util.update_object(self.projectile_table[i].proj_fx, fx_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end
	until true end
end

function local_class:search_target()
	self.target = stage.BattleManager:GetClosestTargetInBattle(self.base_obj,
			unity_class.vector3.right, self.shoot_range_dist, 360);
end

function local_class:shoot()
	local fx_offset = unity_class.vector3.up
	local shoot_pos = self.base_obj.Position + fx_offset

	--- shoot
	self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect(self.shoot_key, shoot_pos)
	--- sfx
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx(self.shoot_key)

	local proj_fx = self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect(self.projectile_key, shoot_pos)
	local dist = vector_util.magnitude(self.target.Position - shoot_pos)
	local hit_time = math.max(dist / self.projectile_speed, 0.1)
	table.insert(self.projectile_table, {proj_fx = proj_fx, time_passed = 0, hit_time = hit_time,
										 start_pos = shoot_pos, target = self.target})
end

function local_class:damage_self()
	--- 자기 자신에게 데미지
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
	damage_info.sender = self.base_obj
	damage_info.target = self.base_obj
	damage_info.damage = 1

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function local_class:deactivate()
	if self.projectile_table then
		for _,info in ipairs(self.projectile_table) do
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(info.proj_fx)
		end
	end
	self.projectile_table = nil

	self.elemental_type_count_table = nil
	self.target_elemental_type = nil

	self.base_obj = nil
	self.is_active = false
end

function local_class:force_stop()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:reset()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:deactivate()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.RogueChessPlayCharacterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleLeaveEvent))

	self.shoot_key = nil
	self.projectile_key = nil
	self.hit_key = nil

	self.projectile_table = nil
	self.rc_sub_system = nil

	self.cs_battle_add_on = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_battle_add_on, param)
		return local_class(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	end
}

function local_class:on_battle_start(_)

	-- 로스터 캐릭터 속성 카운트
	local _, highest_value = rogue_chess_util.count_elemental_type_in_rosters()

	self.base_obj = self.rc_sub_system.EndCondition.BaseObject
	local offset = vector(0, self.base_obj.Bounds.size.y + 2, 0)

	local max_shield = self.base_obj.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	local shield_amount = math.floor(math.min(highest_value * self.shield_multiplier, max_shield))
	buff_manager:AddBuff(self.base_obj, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.base_obj, self.buff_id, shield_amount - 1, false, false)

			:Instantiate(self.base_obj.Position + offset, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.base_obj.Transform)

	if self.count_ui ~= nil then
		self.count_ui:Init(self.base_obj)
		self.count_ui:Show();
		self.count_ui:SetAtlas(self.icon_bundle_name, self.icon_asset_name, self.icon_name);
		self.count_ui.Count = shield_amount
	end

	end

	self.count_ui.Count = self.base_obj.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Shield - 1

	return false

			if self.elemental_type_count_table[type] == nil then

local local_class = newclass('RogueChessBlessBattleAddOn')

function local_class:init(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	self.cs_battle_add_on = cs_battle_add_on

	local level = cs_battle_add_on.Level
	self.bless_level_multiplier = level

	local buff_ids = CS.Utils.GetIntListFromDictionary(param, 'BuffIds')
	self.buff_table = {}
	if buff_ids then
		for i = 0, buff_ids.Count - 1 do
			table.insert(self.buff_table, buff_ids[i])
		end
	else
		local idx = 0
		while(true) do
			idx = idx + 1
			local buff_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'BuffId_' .. idx, -1)
			if buff_id < 0 then
				break
			else
				table.insert(self.buff_table, buff_id)
			end
		end
	end

	self.bless_fx_preset_name = 'bless'

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEnterEvent), 'on_battle_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.RogueChessStateChangeEvent), 'on_rc_state_change_event')
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_buff_applicable(fo)
	return CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsPlayer(fo.EntityGroup)
end

function local_class:on_rc_state_change_event(e)
	local new_state = e.State
	if new_state ~= CS.Oak.IRogueChessSystem.State.Play then
		return
	end

	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()

	-- 로스터 축복 Count 캐싱
	local rosters = self.rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	local bless_level_count = 0
	for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do
		local roster = rosters[i]
		local character = roster.Character
		bless_level_count = bless_level_count + character.CharacterInfo.BlessLevel
	end
	self.bless_level = bless_level_count * self.bless_level_multiplier

	-- 베이스에 축복 이펙트
	local base_obj = self.rc_sub_system.EndCondition.BaseObject

	-- fx
	self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect(self.bless_fx_preset_name, base_obj.Position)
	--- sfx
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx(self.bless_fx_preset_name)
end

function local_class:on_battle_enter_event(e)
	if self.rc_sub_system == nil then
		return false
	end

	local target = e.FieldObject
	if not self:is_buff_applicable(target) then
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, #self.buff_table do
		local buff_id = self.buff_table[i]
		self:apply_buff(target, buff_id)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:apply_buff(fo, buff_id)
	if not character_util.has_active_buff(fo, buff_id) then
		buff_manager:AddBuff(fo, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, buff_id, self.bless_level, false, false)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_buff(fo, buff_id)
	if character_util.has_active_buff(fo, buff_id) then
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(fo, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, buff_id)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_all_buff(fo)
	for i = 1, #self.buff_table do
		local buff_id = self.buff_table[i]
		self:remove_buff(fo, buff_id)
	end
end

function local_class:deactivate()
	if self.rc_sub_system == nil then
		return
	end

	local rosters = self.rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do
		local roster = rosters[i]
		local character = roster.Character
		self:remove_all_buff(character)
	end
end

function local_class:force_stop()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:reset()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.RogueChessStateChangeEvent))

	self:deactivate()
	self.rc_sub_system = nil

	self.buff_table = nil
	self.bless_fx_preset_name = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_battle_add_on, param)
		return local_class(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('RogueChessBlessEssenceBattleAddOn')

function local_class:init(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	self.cs_battle_add_on = cs_battle_add_on

	local level = cs_battle_add_on.Level

	self.owner = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
	self.owner.Owner = CS.Oak.Player.Local
	self.owner.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player0

	local damage_base = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'DamageBase', 10000)
	local damage_add = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'DamageAdd', 10000)
	self.boss_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "BossDamageModifier", 0.2)

	self.base_damage = damage_base + damage_add * level

	self.damage_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'DamageDelay', 1)
	self.damage_delay = 3
	self.duration = math.max(CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'Duration'), self.damage_delay)

	self.light_fx_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'LightFxHeight', 2)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_start(e)
	-- 현재 서브 시스템 로그체스
	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()

	local rosters = self.rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	local bless_level_count = 0
	for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do
		local roster = rosters[i]
		local character = roster.Character
		bless_level_count = bless_level_count + character.CharacterInfo.BlessLevel
	end

	-- activate
	self.current_battle = e.StartedBattle
	self.damage_amount = math.max(self.base_damage * bless_level_count,1)
	self.base_obj = self.rc_sub_system.EndCondition.BaseObject
	self.battle_zone = field:GetZone(self.rc_sub_system.Control.CurrentBattleZoneName)
	self.boss = self.rc_sub_system.Wave:GetCurrentBossMonster()
	self.triggered = false
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(_)
	-- 버프 종료
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.rc_sub_system and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.RogueChessSummonerSpellEvent) then
		self:on_summoner_spell_event(e)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_summoner_spell_event(_)
	if self.is_triggered then
		rogue_chess_util.on_summoner_spell_use_result(false)
	end

	self.is_triggered = true
	self.time_passed = 0

	local pos = self.base_obj.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * self.light_fx_height
	self.light_fx = self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('light', pos)
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('light')

	rogue_chess_util.on_summoner_spell_use_result(true)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.is_triggered then
		return
	end

	local prev_time_passed = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.damage_delay and prev_time_passed < self.damage_delay then
		-- damage
		self:attack()
	end

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		self.is_triggered = false
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.light_fx)
	end
end

function local_class:attack()
	for enemy_index = 0, self.current_battle.Enemies.Count - 1 do repeat
		local status = self.current_battle.Enemies[enemy_index]
		if not status.IsActive then
			break
		end

		local fo = status.Character
		local in_zone = self.battle_zone.IntersectsFieldObjects:Contains(fo)
		if not in_zone then
			break
		end

		local damage = self.damage_amount
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.boss) then
			damage = damage * self.boss_damage_modifier
		end

		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
		damage_info.sender = fo
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.damage = damage

		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	until true end

	--- explosion
	local pos = self.base_obj.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * self.light_fx_height
	self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('attack', pos)
	--- sfx
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('attack')
end

function local_class:deactivate()
	self.rc_sub_system = nil
	self.current_battle = nil
	self.battle_zone = nil
	self.boss = nil
	self.is_triggered = false
	self.base_obj = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.light_fx) then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.light_fx, true)
	end
	self.light_fx = nil
end

function local_class:force_stop()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:reset()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:deactivate()

	self.owner:Dispose()
	self.owner = nil

	self.cs_battle_add_on = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_battle_add_on, param)
		return local_class(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	end
}

	self:apply_effect()

function local_class:apply_effect()
	local cast_pos = self.base_obj.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * self.light_fx_height

	local count = 0
	local rosters = self.rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do repeat
		local roster = rosters[i]

		-- 필드 위에 있는지

			break
		end

		self:add_buff(roster.Character)
		count = count + 1

	until true end

	if count > 0 then
		self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('cast', cast_pos)
		self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('cast')

local local_class = newclass('RogueChessChampionBattleAddOn')

function local_class:init(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	self.cs_battle_add_on = cs_battle_add_on

	local level = cs_battle_add_on.Level
	self.voice_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'VoiceId', 110)
	self.attack_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'AttackModifierBase', 1)
			+ CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'AttackModifierAdd', 0) * level
	self.defense_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'DefenseModifierBase', 1)
			+ CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'DefenseModifierAdd', 0) * level
	self.hp_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'HpModifierBase', 1)
			+ CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'HpModifierAdd', 0) * level

	self.base_character_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'BaseCharacterId', 900047)
	self.giant_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'GiantFactor', 1.5)

	self.heal_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'HealRateBase', 0.3)
			+ CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'HealRateAdd', 0) * level
	self.damage_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "Radius", 1.5)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "DamageModifierBase", 1) +
			CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "DamageModifierAdd", 0.01) * level

	self.champion_key = 'spell_champion'
	if stage.StageLoaded then
		self:load_champion()
	else
		-- 스테이지 로드되지 않았으면 대기 후 캐릭터 로드
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleLeaveEvent), 'on_battle_leave_event')

	--TODO: 이펙트 관리가 필요하면 추가
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return not self.is_loading
end

function local_class:on_battle_start(_)
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(_)
	-- 버프 종료
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(_)
	self:load_champion()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_leave_event(e)
	if not self.is_champion_on_field then
		return
	end

	local left_fo = e.FieldObject
	local champion = self.rc_sub_system.Deck:GetRegisteredFo(self.champion_key)

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(champion, left_fo) then
		return false
	end

	if CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem() ~= nil and CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem().SummonerSpell ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem().SummonerSpell.SummonerSpellCoolTime = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem().SummonerSpell.SummonerSpellCoolTime + 3
	end

	self.is_champion_on_field = false

	return false
end

function local_class:load_champion()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.load_champion_routine, self))
end

function local_class:load_champion_routine()
	self.is_loading = true

	-- 현재 서브 시스템 로그체스
	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()
	self.is_champion_on_field = false

	-- 현재 로스터 전사 스펙 확인
	local rosters = self.rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	local total_hp = 0
	local total_attack = 0
	local total_defense = 0
	local melee_count = 0
	for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do repeat
		local roster = rosters[i]
		local character = roster.Character
		if CS.Oak.CharacterExtensions.GetCharacterSpec(character).CoopClass ~= CS.Oak.CoopClass.Melee then
			break
		end

		total_attack = total_attack + self:get_total_attack(character)
		total_defense = total_defense + CS.Oak.StatCalculator.GetFinalDefense(character)
		total_hp = total_hp + CS.Oak.StatCalculator.GetFinalHp(character)
		melee_count = melee_count + 1
	until true end

	-- 베이스 캐릭터 스펙 딥클론해서 변경후 사용
	local ref_spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('Characters'):GetSpec(self.base_character_id)
	local spec = ref_spec:DeepClone()
	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.RogueChessCharacterGenerator():GenerateAllyCharacterRoutine(
			spec, 1, self.champion_key,
			total_attack ~= 0 and total_attack * self.attack_modifier or -1,
			total_defense ~= 0 and total_defense * self.defense_modifier or -1,
			total_hp ~= 0 and total_hp * self.hp_modifier or -1))

	local fo = self.rc_sub_system.Deck:GetRegisteredFo(self.champion_key)
	fo:SetGiantFactor(self.champion_key, self.giant_factor)

	self.is_loading = nil
end

-- 총 공격력
function local_class:get_total_attack(character)
	local elemental_types = CS.Oak.ElementalTypeExtensions.ElementalTypes
	local total_attack = 0
	for i = 0, elemental_types.Length - 1 do
		local type = elemental_types[i]
		total_attack = total_attack + CS.Oak.StatCalculator.GetFinalElementalAttack(character, type)
	end
	return total_attack
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.RogueChessSummonerSpellEvent) then
		self:on_summoner_spell_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_summoner_spell_event(e)
	if e.IsButtonUp then
		return
	end

	local fo = self.rc_sub_system.Deck:GetRegisteredFo(self.champion_key)
	if is_unity_null(fo) then
		self:on_use_fail()
		return
	end

	if self.is_champion_on_field then
		self:on_use_with_champion_on_field(fo)
		self:on_use_succeed()
		return
	end

	-- 클릭 위치와 무관하게 무조건 발동
	local is_success = self:apply_effect()
	if is_success then
		self:on_use_succeed()

		--레벨 표기만 100으로 변경
		local stat_ui = stage.FieldUIManager:GetUI(fo)[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats]
		if stat_ui ~= nil then
			stat_ui:SetLevel(99, true)
		end
	else
		self:on_use_fail()
	end
end

function local_class:on_use_succeed()
	rogue_chess_util.on_summoner_spell_use_result(true)

	if not self.is_champion_on_field then
		-- 보이스
		music_player:PlayVoice(self.voice_id, nil, 0, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.CoopBelieve)
		self.is_champion_on_field = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('explosion')
	end
end

function local_class:on_use_fail()
	rogue_chess_util.on_summoner_spell_use_result(false)
end

function local_class:on_use_with_champion_on_field(champion)
	if self.heal_rate > 0 then
		-- heal
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = champion
		heal_info.target = champion
		heal_info.heal = math.floor(champion.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.heal_rate)

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
	end

	if self.damage_modifier > 0 then
		local hit_pos = champion.Position
		--- explosion
		self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('explosion', hit_pos)

		--- 판정 시작
		local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(hit_pos, self.damage_radius)
		for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
			local fo = fo_list[i]
			--몬스터만 타격하도록
			if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy) ~= CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None and not fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
				damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = champion
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier

				command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
			end
		end
		fo_list:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:apply_effect()
	--todo : c# 프리즈로 인한 임시처리
	if CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem() ~= nil
			and CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem().Deck ~= nil
			and CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem().CurState == CS.Oak.IRogueChessSystem.State.Play then
		local champion = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem().Deck:GetRegisteredFo(self.champion_key)

			message_system:SendSync(champion.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour, CS.Oak.ManaRecoverUsableEvent.Create(true));

		return
	end

	if is_unity_null(fo) then

	end

	local battle_instance = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleFor(fo)
	if battle_instance then

function local_class:init(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	self.cs_battle_add_on = cs_battle_add_on

	self.radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "Radius", 1.5)

	local color = CS.Oak.RogueChessSummonerSpellSystem.SpellRangeColor
	local fail_color = CS.Oak.RogueChessSummonerSpellSystem.UnavailableRangeColor

			self.radius, color, color, color, color, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.unavailable_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero,
			self.radius, fail_color, fail_color, fail_color, fail_color,
			CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()
	self.unavailable_range:Hide()
end

	return true
end

-- 효과 적용 대상인 지
function local_class:is_applicable(fo)
	return CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsPlayer(fo.EntityGroup) and fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil
			and not fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and fo.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
end

-- 전투 시작 되었는 지
function local_class:is_battle_started()
	return self.battle_zone ~= nil
end

function local_class:on_battle_start(_)
	-- 현재 서브 시스템 로그체스
	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()
	-- 전투 시작할 때 배틀 존 지정
	self.battle_zone = field:GetZone(self.rc_sub_system.Control.CurrentBattleZoneName)
end

	-- 버프 종료
	self:deactivate()
	self.battle_zone = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.rc_sub_system and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.RogueChessSummonerSpellEvent) then
		self:on_summoner_spell_event(e)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_summoner_spell_event(e)
	local button_up = e.IsButtonUp
	local pos = e.TargetPos

	local pos_contained = rogue_chess_util.handle_summoner_spell_range(
			self.battle_zone, pos, self.attack_range, self.unavailable_range)

	if button_up then
		-- 포지션 배틀존 바운드 내에 있지 않으면 실행하지 않음
		if pos_contained then
			self:apply_effect(pos)
			rogue_chess_util.on_summoner_spell_use_result(true)
			self.attack_range:Hide()
		else
			rogue_chess_util.on_summoner_spell_use_result(false)
			self.unavailable_range:Hide()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:apply_effect(pos)
	self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('apply', pos)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.radius)
	local result = false
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		if self:is_applicable(fo) then repeat
			if fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour and fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour.ManaFill == 1 then
				break
			end
			-- 마나 최대로
			fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Mana = CS.System.Single.MaxValue
			-- 한명이라도 효과가 적용되면 성공 판정
			result = true
		until true end
	end
	return result
end

function local_class:deactivate()
end

function local_class:force_stop()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:reset()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:deactivate()
	self.battle_zone = nil

	if self.attack_range then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.attack_range = nil
	end
	if self.unavailable_range then
		self.unavailable_range:Hide()
		self.unavailable_range = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(cs_battle_add_on, param)
		return local_class(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('RogueChessMeteorBattleAddOn')

--region meteor_class
local meteor_class = {
	addon = nil,

	proj_fx = nil,
	trail_fx = nil,

	init_pos = nil,
	target_pos = nil,

	hit_timing = nil,
	dispose_timing = nil,
	time_passed = 0,
}
meteor_class.mt = { __index = meteor_class }

function meteor_class:new(parent_class, proj_fx, trail_fx, init_pos, target_pos, hit_timing)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.addon = parent_class

	obj.proj_fx = proj_fx
	obj.trail_fx = trail_fx

	obj.init_pos = init_pos
	obj.target_pos = target_pos

	obj.hit_timing = hit_timing
	obj.dispose_timing = hit_timing + 1
	obj.time_passed = 0

	obj.is_active = true

	return obj
end

function meteor_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.is_active then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed < self.hit_timing then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.hit_timing)
		local move_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.init_pos, self.target_pos, progress)
		effect_util.update_object(self.proj_fx, move_pos)
		effect_util.update_object(self.trail_fx, move_pos)
	else
		if old_time_passed < self.hit_timing then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_fx)
			self.proj_fx = nil

			self.addon:on_meteor_hit(self.target_pos)
		end

		if self.time_passed > self.dispose_timing then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
			self.trail_fx = nil

			self.is_active = false
		end
	end
end

function meteor_class:dispose()
	self.is_active = nil

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_fx)
	self.proj_fx = nil
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
	self.trail_fx = nil

	self.init_pos = nil
	self.target_pos = nil

	self.addon = nil
end
--endregion

function local_class:init(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	self.cs_battle_add_on = cs_battle_add_on

	self.owner = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
	self.owner.Owner = CS.Oak.Player.Local
	self.owner.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player0

	self.damage_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "Radius", 1.5)
	--self.damage_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, "DamageBase", 10000) +
	--		CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, "DamageAdd", 10000) * cs_battle_add_on.Level
	self.damage_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "DamageRateBase", 0.1) +
					CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "DamageRateAdd", 0.005) * cs_battle_add_on.Level
	self.boss_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "BossDamageModifier", 0.1)

	self.fall_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "FallHeight", 15)
	self.fall_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "FallDuration", 3)
	self.use_max_hp = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(param, "UseMaxHp", false)

	self.meteor_table = {}

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	local color = CS.Oak.RogueChessSummonerSpellSystem.SpellRangeColor
	local fail_color = CS.Oak.RogueChessSummonerSpellSystem.UnavailableRangeColor
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero,
			self.damage_radius, color, color, color, color, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.unavailable_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero,
			self.damage_radius, fail_color, fail_color, fail_color, fail_color,
			CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()
	self.unavailable_range:Hide()
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_start(_)
	-- 현재 서브 시스템 로그체스
	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()
	self.boss = self.rc_sub_system.Wave:GetCurrentBossMonster()
	self.battle_zone = field:GetZone(self.rc_sub_system.Control.CurrentBattleZoneName)
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(_)
	-- 버프 종료
	self:deactivate()
	self.boss = nil
	self.battle_zone = nil
end

function local_class:on_meteor_hit(hit_pos)
	--- explosion
	self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('explosion', hit_pos)
	--- sfx
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('explosion')

	--- 사운드 재생

	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(user_party.Leader, 0.3, 0.6)

	--- 판정 시작
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(hit_pos, self.damage_radius)
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		--몬스터만 타격하도록
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy) ~= CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None and not fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			local damage = self.damage_rate
			if self.use_max_hp then
				damage = damage * fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			else
				damage = damage * fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP
			end
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.boss) then
				damage = damage * self.boss_damage_modifier
			end
			damage = math.floor(damage)
			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = fo
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.damage = damage

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.rc_sub_system and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.RogueChessSummonerSpellEvent) then
		self:on_summoner_spell_event(e)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_summoner_spell_event(e)
	local button_up = e.IsButtonUp
	local pos = e.TargetPos

	local pos_contained = rogue_chess_util.handle_summoner_spell_range(
			self.battle_zone, pos, self.attack_range, self.unavailable_range)

	if button_up then
		-- 포지션 배틀존 바운드 내에 있지 않으면 실행하지 않음
		if pos_contained then
			self:apply_effect(pos)
			rogue_chess_util.on_summoner_spell_use_result(true)
			self.attack_range:Hide()
		else
			rogue_chess_util.on_summoner_spell_use_result(false)
			self.unavailable_range:Hide()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:apply_effect(pos)
	local start_pos = pos + unity_class.vector3.up * self.fall_height
	local projectile_fx = self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('projectile', start_pos)
	local trail_fx = self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('trail', start_pos)
	local new_meteor = meteor_class:new(self, projectile_fx, trail_fx, start_pos, pos, self.fall_duration)
	table.insert(self.meteor_table, new_meteor)
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('cast')
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	for i = #self.meteor_table, 1, -1 do
		local meteor = self.meteor_table[i]
		if meteor ~= nil then
			meteor:update_frame(dt)
			if not meteor.is_active then
				meteor:dispose()
				table.remove(self.meteor_table, i)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:deactivate()
	if self.meteor_table then
		for _, meteor in ipairs(self.meteor_table) do
			meteor:dispose()
		end
	end

	self.meteor_table = {}
end

function local_class:force_stop()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:reset()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:deactivate()
	self.meteor_table = nil

	self.coop_class = {

		['Projectile'] = CS.Oak.CoopClass.Projectile,

	}

	self.damage_source_class = self.coop_class[damage_source_class_str]

function local_class:is_buff_applicable(fo)
	return CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsPlayer(fo.EntityGroup)
			and not fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and fo.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
end

function local_class:on_battle_start(_)
	-- 현재 서브 시스템 로그체스
	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()

	-- 로스터 캐릭터 속성 카운트
	local is_active = true
	local rosters = self.rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	local elemental_type = rosters[0].Character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ElementalType
	for i = 1, rosters.Count - 1 do
		local character = rosters[i].Character
		if elemental_type ~= character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ElementalType then
			is_active = false
			break
		end
	end

	self.is_active = is_active
	if is_active then
		self.base_obj = self.rc_sub_system.EndCondition.BaseObject
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local sender = e.Info.sender
	if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsPlayer(sender.EntityGroup) then
		return false
	end

	if sender.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.CoopClass ~= self.damage_source_class then
		return false
	end

	if self.base_obj == nil or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.base_obj, sender) then
		return false
	end

	local damage_info = e.Info
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(sender, damage_info.target) then
		return false
	end

	local rosters = self.rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do repeat
		local roster = rosters[i]
		if not roster.IsPlaying or roster.IsDead then
			break
		end

		local character = roster.Character
		if not self:is_buff_applicable(character) then
			break
		end

		buff_util.add_drain_shield(sender, character, damage_info:GetTotalDamage(),
				self.shield_amount_multiplier, self.is_shield_visible)
	until true end

	return false

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
end

	self:deactivate()

end

	self:deactivate()
	self.rc_sub_system = nil

end

	--		CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'DamageAdd', 1000) * cs_battle_add_on.Level
	self.damage_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "DamageRateBase", 0.1) +

	self.boss_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "BossDamageModifier", 0.1)

	self.swamp_info_table = {}
	self.contained_fos = {}

	self.aoe_loop_key = "aoe_loop"

	local fail_color = CS.Oak.RogueChessSummonerSpellSystem.UnavailableRangeColor
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero,
			self.radius, color, color, color, color, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.unavailable_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero,
			self.radius, fail_color, fail_color, fail_color, fail_color,
			CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()
	self.unavailable_range:Hide()

end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

-- 전투 시작 되었는 지
function local_class:is_battle_started()
	return self.battle_zone ~= nil
end

-- 공격 가능 대상인 지
function local_class:is_hittable(fo)
	return CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player1, fo.EntityGroup)
			and not fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and fo.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
end

function local_class:on_battle_start(_)
	-- 현재 서브 시스템 로그체스
	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()
	self.battle_zone = field:GetZone(self.rc_sub_system.Control.CurrentBattleZoneName)
	self.boss = self.rc_sub_system.Wave:GetCurrentBossMonster()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(_)
	-- 버프 종료
	self:deactivate()
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.battle_zone = nil
	self.boss = nil
end

function local_class:on_battle_enter_event(e)
	self:check_area_contains_fo(e.FieldObject)
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	self:check_area_contains_fo(e.FieldObject)
end

function local_class:check_area_contains_fo(fo)
	if not self:is_battle_started() then
		return
	end

	if not self:is_hittable(fo) then
		return
	end

	local was_contained = self.contained_fos[fo] ~= nil
	if was_contained then
		if not self:is_in_range(fo.Position) then
			self.contained_fos[fo] = nil
		end
	else
		if self:is_in_range(fo.Position) then
			self.contained_fos[fo] = self.time_passed
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_in_range(pos)
	local sqr_radius = self.radius * self.radius
	for _, area_info in ipairs(self.swamp_info_table) do
		local area_center = area_info.pos
		if vector_util.sqr_magnitude(pos - area_center) <= sqr_radius then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.rc_sub_system and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.RogueChessSummonerSpellEvent) then
		self:on_summoner_spell_event(e)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 드래그 드랍 조작 이벤트
function local_class:on_summoner_spell_event(e)
	local button_up = e.IsButtonUp
	local pos = e.TargetPos

	local pos_contained = rogue_chess_util.handle_summoner_spell_range(
			self.battle_zone, pos, self.attack_range, self.unavailable_range)

	if button_up then
		-- 포지션 배틀존 바운드 내에 있지 않으면 실행하지 않음
		if pos_contained then
			self:apply_effect(pos)
			rogue_chess_util.on_summoner_spell_use_result(true)
			self.attack_range:Hide()
		else
			rogue_chess_util.on_summoner_spell_use_result(false)
			self.unavailable_range:Hide()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:apply_effect(pos)
	-- 데미지 장판 포지션 저장
	local area_fx = self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect(self.aoe_loop_key, pos)
	local end_time = self.time_passed + self.duration
	table.insert(self.swamp_info_table, {fx = area_fx, pos = pos, end_time = end_time, fx_end_time = end_time - 0.5})
	self:on_area_added()
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('cast')
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self:is_battle_started() then
		return
	end

	local prev_time_passed = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	for i, info in ipairs(self.swamp_info_table) do
		-- 데미지 term 체크
		self:update_damage_term()

		if info.fx_end_time < self.time_passed and prev_time_passed < info.fx_end_time then
			self:play_end_effect(i)
		end

		if info.end_time < self.time_passed then
			local pos = info.pos
			self:remove_area(i)
			self:on_area_removed(pos)
		end
	end
end

-- contained_fos 안에 들어있는 fo 데미지
function local_class:update_damage_term()
	for fo, time in pairs(self.contained_fos) do repeat
		if time + self.damage_term >= self.time_passed then
			break
		end

		self.contained_fos[fo] = self.contained_fos[fo] + self.damage_term

		-- 데미지
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy) ~= CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None and not fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			local damage = fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_rate
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.boss) then
				damage = damage * self.boss_damage_modifier
			end
			damage = math.floor(damage)
			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = fo
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.damage = damage

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		end
	until true end
end

function local_class:on_area_added()
	local area_info = self.swamp_info_table[#self.swamp_info_table]
	local pos = area_info.pos
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.radius)
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		if self.contained_fos[fo] == nil and self:is_hittable(fo) then
			self.contained_fos[fo] = self.time_passed
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_area_removed(pos)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.radius)
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do repeat
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		if self.contained_fos[fo] == nil then
			break
		end

		local fo_pos = fo.Position
		local contained = false
		for _, area_info in ipairs(self.swamp_info_table) do
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(area_info.pos - fo_pos)
			local sqr_magnitude = vector_util.sqr_magnitude(diff)
			if sqr_magnitude <= self.radius * self.radius then
				contained = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not contained then
			self.contained_fos[fo] = nil
		end
	until true end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:remove_area(index)
	local area_info = self.swamp_info_table[index]
	if area_info == nil then
		return
	end

	-- fx 제거
	if not is_unity_null(area_info.fx) then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(area_info.fx)
	end

	-- end 이펙트
	self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect(self.aoe_end_key, self.swamp_info_table[index].pos)

	self.swamp_info_table[index].fx = nil
	self.swamp_info_table[index].pos = nil
	table.remove(self.swamp_info_table, index)
end

function local_class:play_end_effect(index)
	local area_info = self.swamp_info_table[index]
	if area_info == nil then
		return
	end

	-- fx 제거
	if not is_unity_null(area_info.fx) then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(area_info.fx)
		self.swamp_info_table[index].fx = nil
		-- end 이펙트
		self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect(self.aoe_end_key, self.swamp_info_table[index].pos)
	end
end

function local_class:deactivate(disposed)
	local set_new_table = not lua_helper.get_or_default(disposed, false)

	-- aoe 범위 리스트 제거
	for i = #self.swamp_info_table, 1, -1 do
		local info = self.swamp_info_table[i]
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(info.fx)
	end
	self.swamp_info_table = {}

	-- 범위내 fo 리스트 제거
	for fo,_ in pairs(self.contained_fos) do
		self.contained_fos[fo] = nil
	end

	if set_new_table then
		self.swamp_info_table = {}
		self.contained_fos = {}
	else
		self.swamp_info_table = nil
		self.contained_fos = nil
	end
end

function local_class:force_stop()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:reset()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEnterEvent))

	self:deactivate()
	self.battle_zone = nil

	self.owner:Dispose()
	self.owner = nil
	self.boss = nil

	if self.attack_range then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.attack_range = nil
	end
	if self.unavailable_range then
		self.unavailable_range:Hide()
		self.unavailable_range = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(cs_battle_add_on, param)
		return local_class(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	end
}

	end
	return false
end

function local_class:remove_buff(fo)
	if character_util.has_active_buff(fo, self.buff_id) then
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(fo, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, self.buff_id)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.rc_sub_system and lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.RogueChessSummonerSpellEvent) then
		self:on_summoner_spell_event(e)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_summoner_spell_event(e)
	local button_up = e.IsButtonUp
	local pos = e.TargetPos

	local pos_contained = rogue_chess_util.handle_summoner_spell_range(
			self.battle_zone, pos, self.attack_range, self.unavailable_range)

	if button_up then
		-- 포지션 배틀존 바운드 내에 있지 않으면 실행하지 않음
		if pos_contained then
			self:apply_effect(pos)
			rogue_chess_util.on_summoner_spell_use_result(true)
			self.attack_range:Hide()
		else
			rogue_chess_util.on_summoner_spell_use_result(false)
			self.unavailable_range:Hide()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:apply_effect(pos)
	local area_fx = self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect(self.area_fx_preset_name, pos)
	local end_time = self.time_passed + self.area_duration
	table.insert(self.area_table, {fx = area_fx, pos = pos, end_time = end_time, fx_end_time = end_time - 0.5})
	self:on_area_added()
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('cast')
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self:is_battle_started() then
		return
	end

	local prev_time_passed = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	for i, info in ipairs(self.area_table) do
		if info.fx_end_time < self.time_passed and prev_time_passed < info.fx_end_time then
			self:play_end_effect(i)
		end

		if info.end_time < self.time_passed then
			self:remove_area(i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_area_added()
	local area_info = self.area_table[#self.area_table]
	local pos = area_info.pos
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.radius)
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		if not self.contained_fos[fo] and self:is_buff_applicable(fo) then
			self:apply_buff(fo)
			self.contained_fos[fo] = true
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_area_removed()
	-- 일단 영역 수가 많지 않아서 field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius로 체크하기보다 전수조사
	self:recalculate_contained_fos()
end

-- contained_fos가 실제로 영역 내에 있는지 재계산
function local_class:recalculate_contained_fos()
	for fo, _ in pairs(self.contained_fos) do
		local fo_pos = fo.Position
		local contained = false
		for _, area_info in ipairs(self.area_table) do
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(area_info.pos - fo_pos)
			local sqr_magnitude = vector_util.sqr_magnitude(diff)
			if sqr_magnitude <= self.radius * self.radius then
				contained = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not contained then
			self:remove_buff(fo)
			self.contained_fos[fo] = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_area(index)
	local area_info = self.area_table[index]
	if area_info == nil then
		return
	end

	-- end fx
	self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect(self.area_end_fx_preset_name, area_info.pos)

	-- fx 제거
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(area_info.fx)
	self.area_table[index].fx = nil
	self.area_table[index].pos = nil
	table.remove(self.area_table, index)

	self:on_area_removed()
end

function local_class:play_end_effect(index)
	local area_info = self.area_table[index]
	if area_info == nil then
		return
	end

	-- fx 제거
	if not is_unity_null(area_info.fx) then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(area_info.fx)
		self.area_table[index].fx = nil
		-- end 이펙트
		self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect(self.area_end_fx_preset_name, self.area_table[index].pos)
	end
end


function local_class:deactivate(disposed)
	local set_new_table = not lua_helper.get_or_default(disposed, false)

	for i = #self.area_table, 1, -1 do
		local info = self.area_table[i]
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(info.fx)
	end
	self.area_table = {}

	if self.contained_fos then
		for fo,_ in pairs(self.contained_fos) do
			if not is_unity_null(fo) then
				self:remove_buff(fo)
			end
			self.contained_fos[fo] = nil
		end
		self.contained_fos = nil
	end

	if set_new_table then
		self.area_table = {}
		self.contained_fos = {}
	else
		self.area_table = nil
		self.contained_fos = nil
	end

	self.battle_zone = nil
end

function local_class:force_stop()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:reset()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_fo_event')

	self:deactivate(true)
	self.battle_zone = nil

	if self.attack_range then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.attack_range = nil
	end
	if self.unavailable_range then
		self.unavailable_range:Hide()
		self.unavailable_range = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(cs_battle_add_on, param)
		return local_class(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	end
}
