local local_class = newclass('RogueChessShooterBuffTeamBattleAddOn')

function local_class:init(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	self.cs_battle_add_on = cs_battle_add_on

	self.level = cs_battle_add_on.Level

	self.owner = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
	self.owner.Owner = CS.Oak.Player.Local
	self.owner.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player0

	--self.supporter_substitute_buff_level_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'NoRecoverySupportLevelModifier', 0.5)

	self.buff_table = {}
	self.buff_table[CS.Oak.CoopClass.Tanker] = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'TankerBuffId', 800093)
	self.buff_table[CS.Oak.CoopClass.Supporter] = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'SupporterBuffId', 800094)
	self.buff_table[CS.Oak.CoopClass.Melee] = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'MeleeBuffId', 800092)
	self.buff_table[CS.Oak.CoopClass.Projectile] = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'ProjectileBuffId', 800092)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.RogueChessPlayCharacterEvent), 'on_play_rc_deck_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleLeaveEvent), 'on_battle_leave_event')
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_start(_)
	-- 현재 서브 시스템 로그체스
	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()
	self.base_obj = self.rc_sub_system.EndCondition.BaseObject
	self.battle_zone = field:GetZone(self.rc_sub_system.Control.CurrentBattleZoneName)
	self.applied_buff_target_table = {}
	self.projectile_count = 0
	self.is_active = true
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(_)
	-- 버프 종료
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:on_play_rc_deck_event(e)
	local fo = e.CardInfo.Character

	if self.projectile_count > 0 then
		-- 버프 적용중
		self:add_buff(fo)
	end

	local fo_class = fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.CoopClass
	if fo_class ~= CS.Oak.CoopClass.Projectile then
		return false
	end

	if self.projectile_count == 0 then
		-- 버프 적용 시작
		self:apply_effect()
	end

	self.projectile_count = self.projectile_count + 1

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_leave_event(e)
	if self.rc_sub_system == nil then
		return
	end

	local fo = e.FieldObject
	if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsFriendlyTo(CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Player, fo.EntityGroup) then
		return false
	end

	local count = 0
	local rosters = self.rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do repeat
		local roster = rosters[i]

		-- 필드 위에 있는지
		if not roster.IsPlaying or roster.IsDead then
			break
		end

		local character = roster.Character

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(character, fo) then
			break
		end

		local character_class = character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.CoopClass
		if character_class ~= CS.Oak.CoopClass.Projectile then
			break
		end

		count = count + 1

	until true end
	self.projectile_count = count
	if count == 0 then
		self:remove_buff()
	end
end

function local_class:apply_effect()
	local rosters = self.rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do repeat
		local roster = rosters[i]

		-- 필드 위에 있는지
		if not roster.IsPlaying or roster.IsDead then
			break
		end

		self:add_buff(roster.Character)

	until true end
end

-- remove는 여기서 안함, persistent인 버프 없는 게 스펙
function local_class:add_buff(fo)
	if not self.is_active then
		return false
	end

	local fo_class = fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.CoopClass
	if self.buff_table[fo_class] == nil or self.applied_buff_target_table == nil then
		return
	end

	local buff_id = self.buff_table[fo_class]
	if fo_class == CS.Oak.CoopClass.Supporter then
		local heal_stat = character_util.get_recovery(fo)
		if heal_stat == 0 then
			--local level = math.floor(self.level * self.supporter_substitute_buff_level_modifier)
			buff_id = self.buff_table[CS.Oak.CoopClass.Melee]
			buff_manager:AddBuff(fo, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, buff_id, self.level, false, false)
			table.insert(self.applied_buff_target_table, {fo = fo, buff_id = buff_id})
		else
			buff_manager:AddBuff(fo, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, buff_id, self.level, false, false)
			table.insert(self.applied_buff_target_table, {fo = fo, buff_id = buff_id})
		end
	else
		buff_manager:AddBuff(fo, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, buff_id, self.level, false, false)
		table.insert(self.applied_buff_target_table, {fo = fo, buff_id = buff_id})
	end
end

function local_class:remove_buff()
	if self.applied_buff_target_table == nil then
		 return
	end

	local count = #self.applied_buff_target_table
	for i = 1, count do
		local info = self.applied_buff_target_table[i]
		if character_util.has_active_buff(info.fo, info.buff_id) then
			buff_manager:RemoveBuff(info.fo, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, info.fo, info.buff_id)
		end
	end

	self.applied_buff_target_table = {}
end

function local_class:deactivate()
	self:remove_buff()
	self.applied_buff_target_table = nil

	self.base_obj = nil
	self.battle_zone = nil
	self.rc_sub_system = nil
	self.is_active = false
end

function local_class:force_stop()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:reset()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:deactivate()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.RogueChessPlayCharacterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleLeaveEvent))

	self.buff_table = nil

	self.owner:Dispose()
	self.owner = nil

	self.cs_battle_add_on = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_battle_add_on, param)
		return local_class(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	end
}

	elseif target_class_str == 'Tanker' then
		self.target_class = CS.Oak.CoopClass.Tanker
	elseif target_class_str == 'Supporter' then

	end

	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()

	self.is_active = true
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_vanguard_index = -1
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(_)
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.is_active then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local max_x_pos = -9999999
	local vanguard_index = -1
	local rosters = self.rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do repeat
		local roster = rosters[i]
		if not roster.IsPlaying or roster.IsDead then
			break
		end
		local character = roster.Character
		if character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.CoopClass == self.target_class then
			local pos_x = character.Position.x
			if max_x_pos < pos_x then
				max_x_pos = pos_x
				vanguard_index = i
			end
		end
	until true end

	if vanguard_index ~= self.current_vanguard_index then
		self:update_buff_target(vanguard_index)
	end
end

function local_class:update_buff_target(new_vanguard_index)
	local prev_index = self.current_vanguard_index

	local rosters = self.rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	if prev_index >= 0 then
		local prev_target = rosters[prev_index].Character
		if character_util.has_active_buff(prev_target, self.vanguard_buff_id) then
			buff_manager:RemoveBuff(prev_target, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, prev_target, self.vanguard_buff_id)
		end
	end

	if new_vanguard_index >= 0 and new_vanguard_index < rosters.Count then
		local new_target = rosters[new_vanguard_index].Character
		buff_manager:AddBuff(new_target, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, new_target, self.vanguard_buff_id, self.level, true, false)
	end

	self.current_vanguard_index = new_vanguard_index
end

end

	self:deactivate()
end

end

	self:deactivate()

	self.rc_sub_system = nil

	self.cs_battle_add_on = nil
end

return {

		return local_class(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	end

local local_class = newclass('RogueChessVanguardBuffAuraBattleAddOn')

function local_class:init(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	self.cs_battle_add_on = cs_battle_add_on

	local level = cs_battle_add_on.Level

	local buff_level_list = CS.Utils.GetIntListFromDictionary(param, 'BuffLevels')
	local buff_id_list = CS.Utils.GetIntListFromDictionary(param, 'BuffIds')

	self.buff_table = {}
	if buff_id_list then
		if buff_level_list then
			local min_count = math.min(buff_id_list.Count, buff_level_list.Count)
			for i = 0, min_count - 1 do
				table.insert(self.buff_table, {id = buff_id_list[i], level = buff_level_list[i]})
			end
		else
			for i = 0, buff_id_list.Count - 1 do
				table.insert(self.buff_table, {id = buff_id_list[i], level = level})
			end
		end
	else
		local idx = 0
		while(true) do
			idx = idx + 1
			local buff_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'BuffId_' .. idx, -1)
			if buff_id < 0 then
				break
			else
				table.insert(self.buff_table, {id = buff_id, level = level})
			end
		end
	end

	local buff_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "BuffRadius", 3)
	self.buff_radius_squared = buff_radius * buff_radius

	self.vanguard_buff_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'VanguardBuffId', -1)

	--- 버프 추가 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_buff_add_event_func = function(e) self:on_buff_add_event(e) end
	--- 버프 만료 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_buff_expired_event_func = function(e) self:on_buff_expired_event(e) end

	--- 버프 추가 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.buff_add, self.on_buff_add_event_func)
	--- 버프 만료 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.buff_expired, self.on_buff_expired_event_func)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_start(_)
	-- 현재 서브 시스템 로그체스
	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()

	self.current_vanguard_captain = nil
	self.buff_targets = {}
	self.is_active = true
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(_)
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:on_buff_add_event(e)
	if e.Buff.BuffSpec.Id ~= self.vanguard_buff_id then
		return false
	end

	self.current_vanguard_captain = e.Buff.Target

	return false
end

function local_class:on_buff_expired_event(e)
	if is_unity_null(self.current_vanguard_captain) == nil then
		self.current_vanguard_captain = nil
		return false
	end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.current_vanguard_captain, e.Target) then
		return false
	end

	local buff_ids = e.BuffIds
	for i = 0, buff_ids.Count - 1 do
		if buff_ids[i] == self.vanguard_buff_id then
			self.current_vanguard_captain = nil
			return false
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:update_frame(_)
	if not self.is_active then
		return
	end

	if self.current_vanguard_captain == nil then
		return
	end

	local pos = self.current_vanguard_captain.Position
	local rosters = self.rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do repeat
		local roster = rosters[i]

		-- 필드 위에 있는지
		if not roster.IsPlaying or roster.IsDead then
			break
		end

		local character = roster.Character
		local target_pos = character.Position
		local sqrDist = vector_util.sqr_magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - pos))
		if sqrDist > self.buff_radius_squared then
			self:remove_buff(character)
			break
		end

		self:add_buff(character)

	until true end
end

function local_class:add_buff(character)
	if self.buff_targets[character] then
		return
	end

	for _,v in pairs(self.buff_table) do
		buff_manager:AddBuff(character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, character, v.id, v.level, false, false)
	end
	self.buff_targets[character] = true
end

function local_class:remove_buff(character)
	if not self.buff_targets[character] then
		return
	end

	for _,v in pairs(self.buff_table) do
		if character_util.has_active_buff(character, v.id) then
			buff_manager:RemoveBuff(character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, character, v.id)
		end
	end
	self.buff_targets[character] = nil
end

function local_class:deactivate()
	if self.buff_targets then
		for target,_ in pairs(self.buff_targets) do
			for _,v in pairs(self.buff_table) do
				if character_util.has_active_buff(target, v.id) then

function local_class:init(cs_battle_add_on, param)

	self.boss_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "BossDamageModifier", 0.2)

	-- aoe knock back
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "KnockBackForce", 1.2) * CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce
	self.knock_back_factor = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, "KnockBackFactor",
			CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong)

	local ignore_defense = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(param, 'IgnoreDefense', true)
	self.damage_type = ignore_defense and
			CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense or CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile

	--- 버프 추가 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_buff_add_event_func = function(e) self:on_buff_add_event(e) end
	--- 버프 만료 이벤트 처리 함수

	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.buff_expired, self.on_buff_expired_event_func)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_start(e)
	-- 현재 서브 시스템 로그체스
	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_battle = e.StartedBattle
	self.current_vanguard_captain = nil
	self.battle_zone = field:GetZone(self.rc_sub_system.Control.CurrentBattleZoneName)
	self.boss = self.rc_sub_system.Wave:GetCurrentBossMonster()
	self.is_active = true
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(_)
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:on_buff_add_event(e)
	if e.Buff.BuffSpec.Id ~= self.vanguard_buff_id then
		return false
	end

	self.current_vanguard_captain = e.Buff.Target

	return false
end

function local_class:on_buff_expired_event(e)
	if is_unity_null(self.current_vanguard_captain) == nil then
		self.current_vanguard_captain = nil
		return false
	end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.current_vanguard_captain, e.Target) then
		return false
	end

	local buff_ids = e.BuffIds
	for i = 0, buff_ids.Count - 1 do
		if buff_ids[i] == self.vanguard_buff_id then
			self.current_vanguard_captain = nil
			return false
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.is_active then
		return
	end

	if self.current_vanguard_captain == nil then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.attack_term then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.attack_term
		self:attack()
	end
end

function local_class:attack()
	for enemy_index = 0, self.current_battle.Enemies.Count - 1 do repeat
		local status = self.current_battle.Enemies[enemy_index]
		if not status.IsActive then
			break
		end

		local fo = status.Character
		local in_zone = self.battle_zone.IntersectsFieldObjects:Contains(fo)
		if not in_zone then
			break
		end

		local current_hp = fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP
		local damage = current_hp * self.damage_rate
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.boss) then
			damage = damage * self.boss_damage_modifier
		end
		damage = math.floor(damage)

		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
		damage_info.sender = fo
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.damage = damage

		damage_info.knock_back_force = self.knock_back_force
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = unity_class.vector3.right
		damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.knock_back_factor

		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	until true end

	--- explosion
	self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('attack', self.current_vanguard_captain.Position)
	--- sfx
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('attack')
end

function local_class:deactivate()
	self.current_battle = nil
	self.battle_zone = nil
	self.boss = nil
	self.is_active = false
end

function local_class:force_stop()
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:reset()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:deactivate()

	--- 버프 추가 이벤트 구독 해지
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.buff_add, self.on_buff_add_event_func)
	--- 버프 추가 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_buff_add_event_func = nil

	--- 버프 만료 이벤트 구독 해지
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.buff_expired, self.on_buff_expired_event_func)
	--- 버프 만료 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_buff_expired_event_func = nil

	self.damage_type = nil

	self.current_battle = nil
	self.rc_sub_system = nil

	self.cs_battle_add_on = nil
end

return {

		return local_class(cs_battle_add_on, param)

--- 싱글레이드용 지원 포격
local local_class = newclass('SRRArtilleryFireBattleAddOn')

local bomb_class = {
	parent = nil,
	owner = nil,
	cs_battle_add_on = nil,

	range = nil,
	calculator = nil,
	damage_ratio = nil,
	elemental_type = nil,

	start_pos = nil,
	target_pos = nil,
	fall_duration = nil,

	time_passed = nil,
	is_active = nil
}
bomb_class.mt = { __index = bomb_class }

function bomb_class:new(parent, calculator, range, start_pos, target_pos)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.parent = parent
	obj.owner = parent.owner
	obj.cs_battle_add_on = parent.cs_battle_add_on

	obj.range = range
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, target_pos)
	range:Show(parent.fall_duration);
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(parent.owner, range))

	obj.calculator = calculator
	obj.damage_ratio = parent.damage_ratio
	obj.elemental_type = parent.elemental_type

	obj.start_pos = start_pos
	obj.target_pos = target_pos
	obj.fall_duration = parent.fall_duration
	obj.position = start_pos

	obj.time_passed = 0
	obj.is_active = true

	local projectile = obj.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('projectile', start_pos)
	obj.projectile = projectile

	return obj
end

function bomb_class:update_position(dt)
	if self.is_active == false then
		return false
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
		self.projectile.transform.position = self.target_pos
		self:process_damage(self.target_pos)
		self:play_explosion_fx()
		self.range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.owner, self.range))
		self:dispose()
		return true
	end

	self.projectile.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(
			self.start_pos, self.target_pos,
			unity_class.mathf.Pow(self.time_passed / self.fall_duration, 2))
end

function bomb_class:play_explosion_fx()
	self.explosion = self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('explosion', self.target_pos)
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('explosion', self.target_pos)
end

function bomb_class:process_damage(pos)
	local calculator = self.calculator
	area_collision_util.start(calculator)
	area_collision_util.set_position(calculator, pos)

	local targets = area_collision_util.update(calculator, 0)
	for _, target in pairs(targets) do
		if target ~= nil then
			local knockback_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - pos).normalized
			local damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_ratio)

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = self.owner
			damage_info.target = target
			damage_info.direction = knockback_dir
			damage_info.damage = damage

			if self.elemental_type ~= nil then
				damage_info.convertAttackTo = self.elemental_type
			end

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	targets:Dispose()
	area_collision_util.calc_end(calculator)
end

function bomb_class:dispose()
	self.owner = nil
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.is_active = false
	self.range = nil
	self.calculator = nil

	if self.projectile ~= nil then
		self.projectile:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:init(cs_battle_add_on, param)

	self.cs_battle_add_on = cs_battle_add_on

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		init_delay = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		shoot = 3
	}
	self.current_state = self.state.none
	self.activated = false

	self.owner = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
	self.owner.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0

	self.damage_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'DamageRatio', 0.05)
	self.shoot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'ShootInterval', 0.2)

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration', 2)
	self.barrage_num = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'ShootAtOnce', 4)
	self.start_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'StartDelay', 2)
	self.fall_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'FallDuration', 2)
	self.target_manual = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(param, 'TargetManual', true)
	self.explosion_sfx_handle_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(param, 'ExplosionSfx', '02_explosion_01')
	self.explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'ExplosionRadius', 1)
	self.scatter = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'Scatter', 1.5)
	self.elemental_type = nil

	local elemental_type_string = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(param, 'Elemental')
	if elemental_type_string ~= nil and elemental_type_string ~= '' then
		self.elemental_type = CS.Oak.ElementalTypeExtensions.GetFromString(elemental_type_string)
	end

	self.fall_height = 20

	self.bombs = {}

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.shoot_count = 0
	self.theta = 0.0
	self.target_pos_cache = vector_util.zero

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent), 'on_global_timer_alarm')

	self.light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(121, 43, 244, 76)
	self.dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(101, 65, 253, 153)
	self.overlay_light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(101, 65, 253, 128)
	self.overlay_dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 53, 53, 0)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_battle_start(_)
	self.activated = true
	self:change_state(self.state.init_delay)
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(_)
	self:reset()
end

function local_class:on_global_timer_alarm(e)
	--- 타이머 알림은 두번온다. 타임아웃에 의한 만료일때만 중단시켜준다.
	if e.IsComplete == true then
		self:deactivate()
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.shoot_count = 0
		self.theta = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, math.pi - 2)

		local target
		if self.target_manual == false and
				lua_helper.type_compare(self.owner.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.IBattleAIState) then

			target = self.owner.FieldObjectController.CurrentState.Target
		else
			target = user_party.Leader
		end
		self.target_pos_cache = target.Position
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_bombs(dt)

	if self.activated == false then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.shoot_count < self.barrage_num then
			if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_count * self.shoot_interval then
				self:shoot()
			end
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.init_delay then
		if self.time_passed > self.start_delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	else
	end
end

function local_class:update_bombs(dt)
	for index = #self.bombs, 1, -1 do
		if self.bombs[index]:update_position(dt) == true then
			table.remove(self.bombs, index)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot()
	self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1

	-- 처음에만 발사음 출력
	if self.shoot_count == 1 then
		self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('prepare')
	end

	local offset = vector_util.zero
	if self.shoot_count > 1 then
		local rot = 2 * math.pi / (self.barrage_num - 1)
		local rand = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-rot, rot) * 0.3
		local value = self.theta + rand + rot * self.shoot_count
		offset = vector(math.cos(value), 0, math.sin(value) * self.scatter)
	end

	self:shoot_bomb(self.target_pos_cache + offset)
end

function local_class:shoot_bomb(target_pos)
	--투사체 공격 계산기 생성
	local collision_info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	collision_info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	collision_info.DamageTerm = 1
	collision_info.Radius = self.explosion_radius
	collision_info.Duration = 1
	collision_info.Height = 1.5

	local calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.owner, collision_info)

	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(
			target_pos,
			self.explosion_radius,
			self.light_color,
			self.dark_color,
			self.overlay_light_color,
			self.overlay_dark_color,
			CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

	attack_range:Hide()

--- 싱글레이드용 배틀존 전체에 넉백/버프/데미지 옵션
local local_class = newclass('SRRBattleZoneEffectBattleAddOn')

function local_class:init(cs_battle_add_on, param)

	self.cs_battle_add_on = cs_battle_add_on

	self.owner = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
	self.owner.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0

	self.initial_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'InitialDelay', 2)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'DamageModifier', 0)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'KnockbackForce', 0)
	self.debuff_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'DebuffId', 0)
	self.debuff_level = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'DebuffLevel', 0)
	self.interval = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Interval')
	self.action_apply_delay = 0.25

	self.activated = false
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.count = 0
	self.battle = nil

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent), 'on_global_timer_alarm')

end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_start(e)
	local battle = e.StartedBattle
	if not battle.IsPlayerBattle then
		return
	end

	self.activated = true
	self.next_shoot_time = self.initial_delay

	self.zone = battle_util.get_zone(user_party.Leader.Position)
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(_)
	self.activated = false
	self.zone = nil
end

function local_class:on_global_timer_alarm(e)
	--- 타임아웃과 10초남았을 떄 알림이 두번온다. 타임아웃만 체크한다.
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent) and e.IsComplete == true then
		self.activated = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.activated then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.next_shoot_time then
		self:shoot()

		-- 시전자가 죽었어도 작동하도록 만들었다. 이부분 주의해야한다.
	elseif self.next_hit_time and self.time_passed >= self.next_hit_time then
		local targets = user_party

		if not targets or targets.Count == 0 then
			return
		end

		for i = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
			local fo = targets[i]
			if fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead == false then
				if CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.owner.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) == true then
					local dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, fo)

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

					if self.knockback_force > 0 then
						damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
						damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
						damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
					end

					if self.knockback_force > 0 or self.damage_modifier > 0 then
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
						damage_info.sender = self.owner
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
						damage_info.direction = dir
						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					end

					if self.debuff_id > 0 then
						buff_manager:AddBuff(self.owner, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, self.debuff_id, self.debuff_level, true, false)
					end
					self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('damage_hit')
				end
			end
		end
		self.next_hit_time = nil
	end
end

function local_class:shoot()
	if self.zone == nil then
		return
	end

	local pos = self.zone.Bounds.center
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('impact1')
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('impact2')

	if self.fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
	end
	self.fx = self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('action', pos)
	self.fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(1.3, 1.3, 1.3)

	self.next_hit_time = self.next_shoot_time + self.action_apply_delay
	self.count = self.count + 1
	self.next_shoot_time = self.count * self.interval + self.initial_delay
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
	end
	self.fx = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.option = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))

	self.game_timer = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.zone = nil
	self.battle = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_battle_add_on, param)
		return local_class(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	end,
}

--- 싱글레이드용 넉백 지원 포격
local local_class = newclass('SRRKnockBackFireBattleAddOn')

local bomb_class = {
	parent = nil,
	owner = nil,
	cs_battle_add_on = nil,

	range = nil,
	calculator = nil,
	damage_ratio = nil,
	knockback_force = nil,
	elemental_type = nil,

	start_pos = nil,
	target_pos = nil,
	fall_duration = nil,

	time_passed = nil,
	is_active = nil,
	shoot_sfx_dealy_timepassed = nil,
	is_start_attack_range = nil
}
bomb_class.mt = { __index = bomb_class }

function bomb_class:new(parent, calculator, range, start_pos, target_pos)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.parent = parent
	obj.owner = parent.owner
	obj.cs_battle_add_on = parent.cs_battle_add_on

	obj.range = range
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, target_pos)
	range:Show(parent.fall_duration);
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(parent.owner, range))
	obj.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('prepare')

	obj.calculator = calculator
	obj.damage_ratio = parent.damage_ratio
	obj.knockback_force = parent.knockback_force
	obj.elemental_type = parent.elemental_type
	obj.camera_shake_magnitude = parent.camera_shake_magnitude
	obj.camera_shake_duration = parent.camera_shake_duration

	obj.start_pos = start_pos + vector(0, 1, 0)
	obj.target_pos = target_pos + vector(0, 1, 0)
	obj.fall_duration = parent.fall_duration
	obj.position = start_pos

	obj.time_passed = 0
	obj.is_active = true
	obj.shoot_sfx_dealy_timepassed = 0
	obj.is_start_attack_range = true

	local projectile = obj.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('projectile', start_pos)
	obj.projectile = projectile
	local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, -90)
	obj.projectile.transform.localRotation = rotation

	return obj
end

function bomb_class:update_position(dt)
	if self.is_active == false then
		return false
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
		self.projectile.transform.position = self.target_pos
		self:process_damage(self.target_pos)
		self:play_explosion_fx()
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
		self.range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.owner, self.range))
		self:dispose()
		return true
	end

	if self.is_start_attack_range then
		if self.shoot_sfx_dealy_timepassed < self.parent.shoot_sfx_delay then
			self.shoot_sfx_dealy_timepassed = self.shoot_sfx_dealy_timepassed + dt
		else
			self.is_start_attack_range = false
			self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('shoot2')
		end
	end

	self.projectile.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(
			self.start_pos, self.target_pos,
			unity_class.mathf.Pow(self.time_passed / self.fall_duration, 2))
end

function bomb_class:play_explosion_fx()
	self.explosion = self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('explosion', self.target_pos)
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('explosion', self.target_pos)
end

function bomb_class:process_damage(pos)
	local calculator = self.calculator
	area_collision_util.start(calculator)
	area_collision_util.set_position(calculator, pos)

	local targets = area_collision_util.update(calculator, 0)
	for _, target in pairs(targets) do
		if target ~= nil then
			local knockback_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - pos).normalized

			if knockback_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				knockback_dir = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(target))
			end

			local damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_ratio)

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = self.owner
			damage_info.target = target
			damage_info.direction = knockback_dir
			damage_info.damage = damage
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			if self.elemental_type ~= nil then
				damage_info.convertAttackTo = self.elemental_type
			end

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	targets:Dispose()
	area_collision_util.calc_end(calculator)
end

function bomb_class:dispose()
	self.owner = nil
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.is_active = false
	self.range = nil
	self.calculator = nil

	if self.projectile ~= nil then
		self.projectile:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:init(cs_battle_add_on, param)

	self.cs_battle_add_on = cs_battle_add_on

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		init_delay = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		shoot = 3
	}
	self.current_state = self.state.none
	self.activated = false

	self.owner = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
	self.owner.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0

	self.damage_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'DamageRatio', 0.05)
	self.shoot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'ShootInterval', 0.2)

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration', 2)
	self.barrage_num = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(param, 'ShootAtOnce', 4)
	self.start_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'StartDelay', 2)
	self.fall_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'FallDuration', 2)
	self.target_manual = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(param, 'TargetManual', true)
	self.explosion_sfx_handle_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(param, 'ExplosionSfx', '02_explosion_01')
	self.explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'ExplosionRadius', 1)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, 'KnockBackForce', 1.1)
	self.camera_shake_magnitude = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "CameraShakeMagnitude", 0.08)
	self.camera_shake_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "CameraShakeDuration", 0.3)
	self.shoot_sfx_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "ShootSfxDelay", 2)

	self.elemental_type = nil

	local elemental_type_string = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(param, 'Elemental')
	if elemental_type_string ~= nil and elemental_type_string ~= '' then
		self.elemental_type = CS.Oak.ElementalTypeExtensions.GetFromString(elemental_type_string)
	end

	self.fall_height = 20

	self.bombs = {}

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.shoot_count = 0
	self.theta = 0.0
	self.target_pos_cache = vector_util.zero

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent), 'on_global_timer_alarm')

	self.light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(121, 43, 244, 76)
	self.dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(101, 65, 253, 153)
	self.overlay_light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(101, 65, 253, 128)
	self.overlay_dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 53, 53, 0)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_battle_start(_)
	self.activated = true
	self.shoot_sfx_dealy_timepassed = 0
	self.is_start_attack_range = false
	self:change_state(self.state.init_delay)
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(_)
	self:reset()
end

function local_class:on_global_timer_alarm(e)
	--- 타이머 알림은 두번온다. 타임아웃에 의한 만료일때만 중단시켜준다.
	if e.IsComplete == true then
		self:deactivate()
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.shoot_count = 0
		self.theta = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, math.pi - 2)

		local target
		if self.target_manual == false and
				lua_helper.type_compare(self.owner.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.IBattleAIState) then

			target = self.owner.FieldObjectController.CurrentState.Target
		else
			target = user_party.Leader
		end
		self.target_pos_cache = target.Position
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_bombs(dt)

	if self.activated == false then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.shoot_count < self.barrage_num then
			if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_count * self.shoot_interval then
				self:shoot()
			end
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.init_delay then
		if self.time_passed > self.start_delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	else
	end
end

function local_class:update_bombs(dt)
	for index = #self.bombs, 1, -1 do
		if self.bombs[index]:update_position(dt) == true then
			table.remove(self.bombs, index)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot()
	self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1

	self:shoot_bomb(self.target_pos_cache)
end

function local_class:shoot_bomb(target_pos)
	--투사체 공격 계산기 생성
	local collision_info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	collision_info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	collision_info.DamageTerm = 1
	collision_info.Radius = self.explosion_radius
	collision_info.Duration = 1
	collision_info.Height = 1.5

	local calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.owner, collision_info)

	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(
			target_pos,
			self.explosion_radius,
			self.light_color,
			self.dark_color,
			self.overlay_light_color,
			self.overlay_dark_color,
			CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

	attack_range:Hide()

	--발사음
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('shoot', target_pos)

	local start_pos = self.target_pos_cache + vector_util.up * self.fall_height
	local bomb = bomb_class:new(self, calculator, attack_range, start_pos, target_pos)

	table.insert(self.bombs, bomb)
end

function local_class:deactivate()
	self.activated = false
	self.shoot_count = 0
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:reset()
	self.activated = false
	self.shoot_count = 0
	self.time_passed = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:deactivate()

	if self.fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
	end
	self.fx = nil

	self.owner = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.cs_battle_add_on = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))
end

return {
	create = function(cs_battle_add_on, param)
		return local_class(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('SRRProtectDroneBattleAddOn')

function local_class:init(cs_battle_add_on, param)

	self.current_gauge_value = 1 --게이지 만땅으로 시작

	self.damage_delay_time_passed = 0
	self.drone_animation_time_passed = 0
	self.is_drone_animation = false
	self.drone_ani_interval = 0.1

	for i = 1, self.area_count do
		local pos = field:GetMarker(self.marker_name_list[i])
		table.insert(self.marker_pos_list, pos)
	end
	self.drone_info_list = {}

		empty = 1,
		blue = 2
	}
	self.current_gauge_state = self.gauge_state.blue

	self.gauge_time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_battle_start(_)
	self.activated = true
	self:change_state(self.state.start_area)
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(_)

end

function local_class:on_global_timer_alarm(e)
	--- 타이머 알림은 두번온다. 타임아웃에 의한 만료일때만 중단시켜준다.
	if e.IsComplete == true then
		self:deactivate()
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if next_state == self.state.start_area then
		--에어리어 생성
		self:start_area()
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:load_gauge_ui()
	-- 캐스팅 상태 표시 UI
	local ui_dic = stage.FieldUIManager:SetUI(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ImmuneGauge)
	self.gauge_ui = ui_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ImmuneGauge]

	if self:is_has_defence_down() then
		self.gauge_ui.transform.localPosition = self.gauge_ui.transform.localPosition + vector(0, 0.45, 0)
	else
		self.gauge_ui.transform.localPosition = self.gauge_ui.transform.localPosition + vector(0, 0.25, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:is_has_defence_down()
	local rule_specs = stage.RuleSpecs

	for _,v in pairs(rule_specs) do
		if v.Id == 14 then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_area()
	for i = 1, self.area_count do
		local drone = self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('drone', self.marker_pos_list[i].position + vector(0, 2, 0))
		local shadow_obj = drone.transform:Find('shadow')
		shadow_obj.transform.position = shadow_obj.transform.position + vector(0, -1.9, 0)

		local area = self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('safe_area', self.marker_pos_list[i].position)
		--
		table.insert(self.drone_info_list, {
			drone = drone,
			area_effect = area,
			pos = self.marker_pos_list[i].position,
			is_ani = false
		})
	end

	self.drone_sfx_loop = self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('drone_loop')
	self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('drone')
	self.is_drone_animation = true
	self:load_gauge_ui()
end

function local_class:end_area()
	for _,v in pairs(self.drone_info_list) do
		if v.drone ~= nil then
			v.drone:Dispose()
			v.drone = nil
		end
		if v.area_effect ~= nil then
			v.area_effect:Dispose()
			v.area_effect = nil
		end
	end

	if self.drone_sfx_loop ~= nil then
		self.drone_sfx_loop:Stop()
		self.drone_sfx_loop = nil
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.activated == false then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.start_area then
		if self.time_passed >= self.start_area_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.update_area)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.update_area then
		self:update_gauge(dt)
		if self.is_drone_animation then
			self:update_drone_ani(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.end_area then
	end
end

function local_class:update_drone_ani(dt)
	for i = 1, #self.drone_info_list do
		local drone_info = self.drone_info_list[i]
		if not drone_info.is_ani then
			if (i - 1) * self.drone_ani_interval <= self.drone_animation_time_passed then
				local drone_spine = drone_info.drone.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
				drone_spine:SetAnimation(1, "drop", false, 1, nil, nil, "idle")

				drone_info.is_ani = true

				if i >= #self.drone_info_list then
					self.is_drone_animation = false
				end
			end
		end
	end

	self.drone_animation_time_passed = self.drone_animation_time_passed + dt
end

function local_class:update_gauge(dt)
	if not self:check_safe_zone() then
		--세이프존 영역 밖이면 게이지 감소
		self.current_gauge_value = self.current_gauge_value - dt * self.gauge_drop_rate
		if self.current_gauge_value < 0 then
			if self.current_gauge_state == self.gauge_state.blue then
				self.current_gauge_state = self.gauge_state.empty
				self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('gauge')
			end
			self.current_gauge_value = 0
		end
	else
		--세이프존 영역 안이면 게이지 증가
		self.current_gauge_value = self.current_gauge_value + dt * self.gauge_charge_rate

		if self.current_gauge_state == self.gauge_state.empty then
			if self.current_gauge_value > 0.3 then
				self.current_gauge_state = self.gauge_state.blue
				self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('gauge')
			end
		end

		if self.current_gauge_value > 1 then
			self.current_gauge_value = 1
		end
	end

	if self.current_gauge_value > 0 then
	else
		--게이지가 0이면 데미지
		if not self.is_damage_delay then
				self:update_damage(dt)
				self.is_damage_delay = true
		else
			if self.damage_delay_time_passed > self.damage_term then
				self.is_damage_delay = false
				self.damage_delay_time_passed = 0
			else
				self.damage_delay_time_passed = self.damage_delay_time_passed + dt
			end
		end
	end
	self.gauge_ui:SetValue(self.current_gauge_value)
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	if user_party_leader ~= nil then
		local damage = math.floor(user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_ratio)

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = self.owner
		damage_info.target = user_party_leader
		damage_info.damage = damage

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
end

function local_class:check_safe_zone()
	for _,v in pairs(self.marker_pos_list) do
		local dist = v.position - user_party_leader.Position
		if math.abs(dist.magnitude) < self.charge_area_radius then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:deactivate()
	self.activated = false
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:reset()
	self:end_area()
	self.activated = false
	self.time_passed = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:deactivate()

	if self.fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
	end
	self.fx = nil

	self.owner = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.cs_battle_add_on = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))
end

return {
	create = function(cs_battle_add_on, param)
		return local_class(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	end,
}

--- 싱글레이드용 위성 빔 (히오스 아르타니스 정화광선같은 것)
local local_class = newclass('SRRSatelliteBeamBattleAddOn')

function local_class:init(cs_battle_add_on, param)

	self.cs_battle_add_on = cs_battle_add_on

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		wait = 2,
		prepare = 3,
		shoot = 4
	}

	local damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "DamageTerm", 1)
	self.laser_radius = math.max(0.1, CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "LaserRadius", 1))
	self.damage_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "DamageRatio", 0.10)
	self.laser_min_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "LaserMinSpeed", 1)
	self.laser_max_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "LaserMaxSpeed", 5)
	self.range_min_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "AttackRangeMinSpeed", self.laser_min_speed)
	self.range_max_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "AttackRangeMaxSpeed", self.laser_max_speed)
	self.laser_accel = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "LaserAcceleration", 7);
	self.deceleration_power = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "Deceleration", 8);
	self.laser_rotation = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "LaserRotationSpeed", 2)
	self.start_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "StartDelay", 2);
	self.shoot_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "ShootDuration", -1)
	self.shoot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "ShootInterval", -1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "PrepareDuration", 4)
	self.prepare_move_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "PrepareMoveDuration", 2)
	self.shoot_move_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "ShootMoveDuration", 2)
	self.max_speed_dist = math.max(self.laser_radius, CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(param, "MaxSpeedDistance", 5))

	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = damage_term
	info.Duration = self.shoot_duration
	info.Radius = self.laser_radius
	info.Height = 3
	info.IsCenterToBottom = true
	self.owner = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
	self.owner.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0

	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.owner, info)

	local range_light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 70, 255, 76)
	local range_dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 70, 255, 153)
	local range_overlay_light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 70, 255, 76)
	local range_overlay_dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 70, 255, 153)
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.laser_radius, range_light_color, range_dark_color,
			range_overlay_light_color, range_overlay_dark_color, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	self.activated = false
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.move_time_left = 0
	self.count = 0

	self:change_state(self.state.none);

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent), 'on_global_timer_alarm')

end

function local_class:on_battle_start(e)
	self.activated = true
	self.next_shoot_time = self.initial_delay
	self.current_laser_position = user_party.Leader.Position
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:on_battle_end(e)
	self.activated = false
	self:deactivate()
end

function local_class:on_global_timer_alarm(e)
	--- 타임아웃과 10초남았을 떄 알림이 두번온다. 타임아웃만 체크한다.
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent) and e.IsComplete == true then
		self.activated = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.wait then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.owner, self.attack_range))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		if self.laser_loop_sfx then
			self.laser_loop_sfx:FadeOut(0.5)
		end
		self.laser_loop_sfx = nil
		if not is_unity_null(self.laser_fx) then
			self.laser_fx:Dispose()
		end
		self.laser_fx = nil

		self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('end', self.current_laser_position)
		self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('end')
	end

	if next_state == self.state.wait then
		self.triggered = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.current_laser_position = user_party.Leader.Position
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.current_laser_position)
		self.attack_range:Show(math.max(0, self.prepare_duration))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.owner, self.attack_range))
		self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('prepare')

		if self.prepare_move_duration > 0 then
			self.current_laser_direction = unity_class.vector3.zero
			self.current_laser_speed = 0
			self.move_time_left = self.prepare_move_duration
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		self.laser_fx = self.cs_battle_add_on:InstantiateEffect('loop', self.current_laser_position)
		self.laser_loop_sfx = self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('loop')

		self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('shoot')

		if self.prepare_move_duration <= 0 then
			local diff = user_party.Leader
			self.current_laser_direction = diff.normalized
			self.current_laser_speed = 0
		end

		if self.shoot_move_duration then
			self.move_time_left = self.shoot_move_duration
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.activated then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		if self.time_passed > self.start_delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.wait)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		if self.time_passed > self.shoot_interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		elseif self.prepare_move_duration > 0 then
			self:process_laser_movement(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.time_passed > self.shoot_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.wait)
		else
			self:process_damage_calculator(dt)
			if self.shoot_move_duration > 0 then
				self:process_laser_movement(dt)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:process_damage_calculator(dt)
	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.current_laser_position
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, fo) then
			local direction = (fo.Position - self.current_laser_position).normalized
			local damage_ratio = self.damage_ratio
			local damage = math.floor(fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHpWoMod * damage_ratio)

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = self.owner
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.damage = damage
			damage_info.direction = direction

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:process_laser_movement(dt)
	self.move_time_left = self.move_time_left - dt
	local is_shoot_state = self.current_state == self.state.shoot

	if self.move_time_left > 0 then
		local diff = user_party.Leader.Position - self.current_laser_position
		local dir = diff.normalized
		local dist = diff.magnitude

		local min_speed = self.range_min_speed
		local max_speed = self.range_max_speed
		if is_shoot_state then
			min_speed = self.laser_min_speed
			max_speed = self.laser_max_speed
		end
		min_speed = dist > self.laser_radius and min_speed or 0

		if self.current_laser_direction == unity_class.vector3.zero and not vector_util.is_almost_zero(diff) then
			self.current_laser_direction = dir
		end

		local theta = math.acos(math.min(1, math.max(-1, vector_util.dot(self.current_laser_direction, dir))))
		if self.laser_rotation <= 0 or float_util.is_almost_zero(theta) then
			self.current_laser_direction = dir
			if self.laser_accel <= 0 then
				self.current_laser_speed = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Lerp(min_speed, max_speed, dist / self.max_speed_dist)
			else
				local momentum = 0.5 * self.current_laser_speed * self.current_laser_speed / self.laser_accel
				local decelerate = momentum > dist
				local reqAccel = decelerate and -(momentum + 1) * self.deceleration_power or
						CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Lerp(self.laser_accel * 0.6, self.laser_accel, dist / self.max_speed_dist)
				self.current_laser_speed = self.current_laser_speed + reqAccel * dt
				self.current_laser_speed = math.min(max_speed, math.max(min_speed, self.current_laser_speed))
			end
		else
			local cross = self.current_laser_direction.x * dir.z - self.current_laser_direction.z * dir.x
			local is_left = cross > 0
			local rad = math.min(self.laser_rotation * dt, theta) * (is_left and 1 or -1)
			self.current_laser_direction = self:rotate_direction(self.current_laser_direction, rad)

			local chord = 0
			local radius = self.current_laser_speed / self.laser_rotation
			local decelerate = theta > math.pi * 0.5
			if radius > 0 and not decelerate then
				local center = self:rotate_direction(unity_class.vector3(0, 0, radius), 0.5 * math.pi - theta)
				chord = math.abs(center.z * 2)
			end

			if self.laser_accel <= 0 then
				self.current_laser_speed = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Lerp(min_speed, max_speed, dist / self.max_speed_dist)
			else
				local momentum = 0.5 * self.current_laser_speed * self.current_laser_speed / self.laser_accel
				decelerate = decelerate or dist < chord or dist < momentum
				local reqAccel = decelerate and -(momentum + 1) * self.deceleration_power or
						CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Lerp(self.laser_accel * 0.6, self.laser_accel, dist / self.max_speed_dist)
				self.current_laser_speed = self.current_laser_speed + reqAccel * dt
				self.current_laser_speed = math.min(max_speed, math.max(min_speed, self.current_laser_speed))
			end
		end
	else
		self.current_laser_speed = math.max(0, self.current_laser_speed - self.deceleration_power * dt)
	end

	self.current_laser_position = self.current_laser_position + self.current_laser_speed * dt * self.current_laser_direction

	if is_shoot_state then
		object_pool_extensions.UpdateObject(self.laser_fx, self.current_laser_position)
		if not self.laser_loop_sfx.IsUsing then

			self.laser_loop_sfx = self.cs_battle_add_on:PlaySfx('loop')
		end
		if self.laser_loop_sfx then
			self.laser_loop_sfx:SetPosition(self.current_laser_position)
		end
	else
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.current_laser_position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.owner, self.attack_range))
	end
end

function local_class:rotate_direction(dir, rad)
	local res = dir

	local sin = math.sin(rad)
	local cos = math.cos(rad)

	local tx = res.x
	local tz = res.z

	res.x = cos * tx - sin * tz
	res.z = sin * tx + cos * tz

	return res
end

function local_class:deactivate()
	self.activated = false
	self.attack_calculator:End()
	self.attack_range:Hide()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:reset()
	self.activated = false
	self.attack_calculator:End()
	self.attack_range:Hide()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()

	self:deactivate()

	if self.fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx)
	end
	self.fx = nil

	self.owner = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.cs_battle_add_on = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))
end

return {
	create = function(cs_battle_add_on, param)
		return local_class(cs_battle_add_on, param)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("AdmiralS3BattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	-- AI 스펙 로드 * 이 시점에서 파싱하고 딕셔너리 들고 있지 않도록
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 7.0)
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 1.0)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 1.5)

	self.circling_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingDistance", 3.5)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingSpeed", 0.5)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	local zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if zone_bound == nil then
		zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	-- 훅샷 풀링
	self.pulling_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "RoleHookTaunt:RaidAdmiral")
	-- 기존 액션들
	self.slash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossAdmiralSlash")
	self.stab_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossAdmiralStabDash")
	self.combo_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossAdmiralBladeCombo:Guild")
	-- 레이드용 강타
	self.strike_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossAdmiralStrike")

	self.combo_action:SetBattleZone(zone_bound)

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)

	end

			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					if self.picked_battle_action == self.pulling_action then
						-- 풀링 후 바로 슬래시 쓰도록 함
						self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count - 1
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						self.time_passed = 0

				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then

				end
			end
		end

	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or

		end

	end

function local_class:dispose()

	self.circling_speed_factor = nil
end

		self.battle_action_count = 2

		self.picked_battle_action = self.tornado_action
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
		self.reserve_tornado = false
		-- 토네이도 후 idx = 1 부터 진행해야 하므로 여기서 0으로.
		self.battle_action_count = 0
	elseif self.battle_action_count < 0 then
		-- 반복 패턴 진입 전 Intro 패턴 처리
		if self.battle_action_count < -1 then
			-- 최초 진입 시 훅샷+베기
			self.picked_battle_action = self.pulling_action
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchFarthestTarget(self.cs_state, true))

				self.picked_battle_action = self.stab_action
				self:change_target()
			else

				self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchFarthestTarget(self.cs_state, true))

	-- 2타일 이내에 적이 2명 이상 있을 경우
	local counter = 0
	local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if targets ~= nil then
		for index = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
			if battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, targets[index]) <= 2 then
				counter = counter + 1
			end
		end
		targets:Dispose()
	end

	return counter >= 2

	-- 5타일 이상 떨어진 곳에 적이 있을 경우
	-- 1타일 이내에 적이 4명 이상 있을 때
	local result = false
	local counter = 0
	local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if targets ~= nil then
		for index = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
			local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, targets[index])
			if dist >= 5 then
				result = true
				break
			end
			if dist <= 1 then
				counter = counter + 1
			end
		end
		targets:Dispose()
	end

	if result == true then
		return true
	else
		return counter >= 4
	end

	-- 타이밍 문제인지 HideTargetUI 로 acitve false 되지 않아 아예 UI를 빼버림.

	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterIgnoreDamagedBehaviour.Create()
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.Disappear
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour.PlayDeathSfx = false
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
	self.character.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(nil)
	self.action_active = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.character.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
		return
	end

	-- 배틀액션 아직 쿨타임
	if self.time_passed < self.attack_interval then
		return
	end

	-- 배틀액션 사용중 체크
	if self.action_active then
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.battle_action) then
			self.time_passed = 0
			self.action_active = false
		end
	else
		-- 공격범위 안에 적이 있다면 촉수 공격 실행 & 커스텀 이벤트 퍼블리시
		local closest_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchClosestTarget(self.cs_state)
		if closest_target ~= nil then
			if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, closest_target) then
				self.target = closest_target
				local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
				command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
			end

			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.battle_action, closest_target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.battle_action) then
				self.action_active = true
			elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_action_wait then
				-- 일정시간 발동하지 못했으면 강제 트리거
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.battle_action) then
					self.action_active = true
				else
					self.time_passed = 0
					self.action_active = false
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.attack_interval = nil

	self.battle_action = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end

			if self.battle_action_triggered then

					self.battle_action_triggered = false
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if  CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
			end
		end
	end
end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
	self.battle_action_table = nil
end

		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

	end

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.random = CS.System.Random()
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.pattern_state_index = 0
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state, self.black_list, false)

		if new_target == nil then
			new_target = self.base_obj
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	if self.pattern_state_index == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
		self.pattern_state_index = 1
	elseif self.pattern_state_index == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.thunder_action
		self.pattern_state_index = 2
	elseif self.pattern_state_index == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
		self.pattern_state_index = 3
	elseif self.pattern_state_index == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.clash_action
		self.pattern_state_index = 4
	elseif self.pattern_state_index == 4 then
		if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < self.overload_action_hp_ratio then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.overload_action
			self.pattern_state_index = 0
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
			self.pattern_state_index = 1
		end
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		return
	end

	local new_target = nil
	if self.picked_battle_action == self.charge_action then
		new_target = battle_ai_util.search_closest_target(self.cs_state, false, self.black_list)
		if new_target == nil then
			-- 스킵
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			return
		end
	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.slash_action then
		new_target = battle_ai_util.search_closest_target(self.cs_state, false, self.black_list)
		if new_target == nil then
			new_target = self.base_obj
		end
	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.thunder_action or self.picked_battle_action == self.clash_action then
		new_target = battle_ai_util.search_farthest_target(self.cs_state, false, self.black_list)
		if new_target == nil then
			new_target = self.base_obj
		end
	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.overload_action then
		new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state, self.black_list, false)
		if new_target == nil then
			-- 스킵
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			return
		end
	end
	self:change_target(new_target)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.slash_action = nil
	self.clash_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
	self.duel_action = nil

	self.random = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.black_list = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
							random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CharacterAilmentStartedEvent) then
		return false
	end

	if CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager:RemoveOwnerAoe(self.character, false)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_aoe_start(new_index)
	table.insert(self.aoe_table, new_index)
	self.aoe_count = self.aoe_count + 1

	if self.aoe_count > self.aoe_max_count then
		local old_index = self.aoe_table[1]
		CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.AreaOfEffectManager:RemoveOwnerAoeByIndex(self.character, old_index, false)
		return self.aoe_count
	end

	return self.aoe_count
end

function local_class:on_aoe_finish()
	table.remove(self.aoe_table, 1)
	self.aoe_count = self.aoe_count - 1
	return self.aoe_count
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.black_list = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil

	self.circling_distance = nil
	self.circling_speed_factor = nil

	self.aoe_table = nil

	self.on_aoe_finish_func = nil
	self.on_aoe_start_func = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	-- 자기자신이 파괴될때 촉수 및 탈곡기 파괴 필요함.
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.character) then

		-- 자신이 사용한 텐타클 정리
		local tentacle = get_character(self.tentacle_name)
		if not is_unity_null(tentacle) then
			tentacle.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(CS.Oak.DeathType.Disappear)
			tentacle.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = tentacle
			damage_info.damage = tentacle.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			tentacle.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
		end

			-- 탈곡기 정리
		if not self.is_sub_character then
			for i = 1, 10 do
				local thresher = get_field_object(self.thresher_name..i)
				if not is_unity_null(thresher) then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'thresher_self_destruct' }))
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'crash_by_thresher' then
			if e:GetParamAt(1) == self.character.Name then
				if self.current_remove_buff_count == 0 then
					return false
				end
				 self.current_remove_buff_count = self.current_remove_buff_count - 1
				--카운드 다 깎였으면 버프 제거
				self.thresher_charge_action.MetaTable:remove_buff(self.current_remove_buff_count)
				if self.current_remove_buff_count == 0 then
					self.is_buff_start = false
					self.current_buff_time = 0
					self.charge_action.MetaTable:force_groggy()
					self.charge_action_enhanced.MetaTable:force_groggy()
				end
			end
		end

		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'add_ailment_resistance_buff' then
			if e:GetParamAt(1) == self.character.Name then
				--버프들어오고 필요값 세팅됨
				self.current_remove_buff_count = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(2))
				self.buff_name = e:GetParamAt(3)
				local buff_param = game_data_service.GetData('BuffData'):GetBuffSpecFromName(self.buff_name).Data
				self.buff_duration =  CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(buff_param, 'Duration', 1)
				self.current_buff_time = 0
				self.is_buff_start = true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Info.target) then
		return false
	end

	if self.phase ~= nil and self.current_phase == self.phase.default then
		self:update_phase()
	end
end

function local_class:update_phase()
	-- 이번 이벤트 스테이지에서
	if stage.ChapterId == self.event_chapter_id and not stage.Spec.IsSubStageType then
		-- 서브스테이지 (챌린지 스테이지) 일 챌린지 스테이지 아닌 경우에는
		-- 페이즈 전환 되지 않고 default 유지 된다.
		self.current_phase = self.phase.default
	else
		-- 챌린지 스테이지 일 경우에도 여기 들어옴
		-- 다른곳(길드레이드등)에서 쓰이는 경우를 위해 2페이즈 로직 추가 해둠.
		if character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character) <= self.target_hp_ratio then
			if self.current_phase ~= self.phase.enhance then
				self.current_phase = self.phase.enhance
				--페이즈 바뀌는 순간 다음 액션은 영혼흡입 부터 시작한다.
				if not self.is_sub_character then
					self.phase_change_reserved = true
					self.battle_action_count = 1
					--혹시 돌진중 변경되어 이상동작 가능성이 있으므로 지난 배틀액션은 삭제
					self.last_battle_action = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

		if idx == 0 then
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
			self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action

		elseif idx == 1 or idx == 4 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.summon_tentacle_action

		elseif idx == 2 then
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
			self.picked_battle_action = self.shot_action

		elseif idx == 3 then
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
			self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action_enhanced

		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0

		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end


	if self.thresher_charge_action ~= nil then
		self.thresher_charge_action.MetaTable:remove_buff()
	end

	self.summon_tentacle_action = nil
	self.spirit_inhale_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
	self.thresher_charge_action = nil

	self.current_phase = nil
	self.phase = nil

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	if self.is_buff_start then
		self.current_buff_time = self.current_buff_time + dt
		if self.current_buff_time >= self.buff_duration then
			-- 버프 지속시간이 끝났다면 제거
			self.is_buff_start = false
			self.thresher_charge_action.MetaTable:clear_buff()
		end
	end
	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 cricling로 변경

				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					--탈곡기 액션 이후에는 바로 다음액션 (돌진) 으로 넘어갈수 있도록 한다.
					if self.last_battle_action == self.thresher_charge_action then
						self.current_rest_time = 0
						self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
						if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
							self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
						end
					else
						self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
						self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
					end

				end
			else
				--아직 배틀액션 시작되지 않았다면
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return
	end

	if  CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	-- return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil

	self.circling_distance = nil
	self.circling_speed_factor = nil
	self.target_hp_ratio = nil

	self.spirit_inhale_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
	self.thresher_charge_action = nil
	self.summon_tentacle_action = nil
	self.shot_action = nil
	self.phase_shift_action = nil
	self.charge_action_enhanced = nil

	self.phase = nil
	self.current_phase = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil

	self.current_remove_buff_count = nil
