local local_class = newclass("BossAmmiNightmareAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params_dict = params

	self.form_state = {
		none = 0,
		bipedalism = 1,
		quadrupedalism = 2
	}

	self.follow_2feet_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Follow2FeetDuration', 4.0)
	self.follow_4feet_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Follow4FeetDuration', 3.0)

	self.min_follow_2feet = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MinFollow2Feet', 3.0)
	self.min_follow_4feet = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MinFollow4Feet', 1.5)

	self.camera_size = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraSize', 5)
	self.camera_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraDuration', 2)

	self.speed_cap_buff_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'SpeedCapBuffName', 'speed_cap_nightmare_boss_ammi')

	self.current_rest_duration = 0.5
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.reserve_form = nil

	-- event sub
	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.shiled_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossAmmiShield')

	-- 2
	self.punch_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossAmmiPunch')
	self.stomp_2_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossAmmiShockStomp2Feet')
	self.railgun_2_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossAmmiRailGun2Feet')

	-- 4
	self.slash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossAmmiSlash')
	self.stomp_4_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossAmmiShockStomp4Feet')
	self.railgun_4_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossAmmiRailGun4Feet')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'init_boss_ammi_emp_controller', self.character.Name }))
	stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.camera_size, self.camera_duration)

	self:change_form(self.form_state.bipedalism, false)
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == nil and self.reserve_form ~= nil then
		self:change_default_ani()
		self.reserve_form = nil
		self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
	end

	if not (self.current_rest_duration < self.time_passed or self:update_check_closer(dt)) then
		return
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		self.prev_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
	end

	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.battle_action_triggered = false

			if self.reserve_form == nil then
				self.current_rest_duration = self.current_form == self.form_state.bipedalism
						and self.follow_2feet_duration
						or self.follow_4feet_duration
			end

			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.time_passed = 0
		end
	else
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.battle_action_triggered = true
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_check_closer(dt)
	if self.target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local dist = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if self.current_form == self.bipedalism then
		return dist <= self.min_follow_2feet
	end

	return dist <= self.min_follow_4feet
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	if self.target == nil then
		self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true)
	end

	-- 첫 패턴 검사
	if self.prev_battle_action == nil then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.shiled_action
		return
	end

	-- 2
	if self.current_form == self.form_state.bipedalism then
		if self.prev_battle_action == self.shiled_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.punch_action

		elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.punch_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.stomp_2_action

		elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.stomp_2_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.railgun_2_action

		elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.railgun_2_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.punch_action
		end

		-- 4
	elseif self.current_form == self.form_state.quadrupedalism then
		if self.prev_battle_action == self.shiled_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action

		elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.slash_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.stomp_4_action

		elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.stomp_4_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.railgun_4_action

		elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.railgun_4_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
		end
	end
end

-- play_ani -> BossAmmiShield로 감 1회성으로 ani 재생 막음
function local_class:change_form(new_form, play_ani)
	if self.current_form == new_form then
		return
	end

	if new_form == self.form_state.bipedalism then
		buff_util.apply_buff(self.character, self.character, self.speed_cap_buff_name, 0)
	else
		buff_util.remove_buff(self.character, self.character, self.speed_cap_buff_name)
	end

	-- form 변환 모션은 shiled_action 에서 담당
	self.prev_battle_action = nil
	self.current_form = new_form
	self.reserve_form = new_form
	self.current_rest_duration = 0

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_ammi_form_change', new_form, tostring(play_ani) }))
end

function local_class:change_default_ani()
	if self.current_form == self.form_state.bipedalism then
		self.character.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'idle'
		self.character.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'walk'
		self.character.CustomRunAnimationName = 'walk'
		self.character.CustomDamagedAnimationName = 'damaged'

	elseif self.current_form == self.form_state.quadrupedalism then
		self.character.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'idle_4legs'
		self.character.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'walk_4legs'
		self.character.CustomRunAnimationName = 'walk_4legs'
		self.character.CustomDamagedAnimationName = 'damaged_4legs'
	end
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'gimmick_emp_active' then
		self.current_rest_duration = 0
		if self.current_form == self.form_state.bipedalism then
			self:change_form(self.form_state.quadrupedalism, true)
		else
			self:change_form(self.form_state.bipedalism, true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_ammi_ai_exit' }))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'done_boss_ammi_emp_controller' }))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("BossAndroidMafiaBattleAIState")

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	-- 기본 구현
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	-- AI 스펙 로드 * 이 시점에서 파싱하고 딕셔너리 굳이 들고 있지 않도록
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 7.0)
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 6.0)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 6.5)

	self.support_call_hp_list = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(params, "SupportCallHpPercent")
	self.retreat_action_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RetreatFireDistance", 4)

	self.circling_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingDistance", 3.5)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingSpeed", 7)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	-- 배틀 액션 데이터
	self.revolver_shot = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossAndroidMafiaRevolverShot")
	self.gatling_shot = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossAndroidMafiaGatlingShot")
	self.support_call = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossAndroidMafiaSupportCall")
	self.retreat_fire = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossAndroidMafiaRetreatFire")

	self.retreat_fire.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)

	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	end

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.prev_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0
	self.support_call_count = 0

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self.character:SetEmotion(CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('broken_eye', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true))
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	if self.use_support_call and self.prev_battle_action ~= self.support_call then
		self:set_battle_action(self.support_call)
		self.support_call_count = self.support_call_count + 1
		self.use_support_call = false
	elseif self.prev_battle_action == nil then
		self:set_battle_action(self.revolver_shot)
	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.revolver_shot then
		if self:check_battle_zone_by_wall() then
			self:set_battle_action(self.retreat_fire)
		else
			self:set_battle_action(self.gatling_shot)
		end
	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.gatling_shot then
		self:set_battle_action(self.revolver_shot)
	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.retreat_fire then
		self:set_battle_action(self.gatling_shot)
	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.support_call then
		self:set_battle_action(self.revolver_shot)
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_action(action)
	self.picked_battle_action = action

	if action == self.revolver_shot or action == self.retreat_fire then
		self:change_target()
	elseif action == self.retreat_fire then
	elseif action == self.gatling_shot then
		self:get_far_target()
	end
end

--강화패턴용 가장 멀리 있는 타겟을 찾는다.
function local_class:get_far_target()
	local target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if target_list == nil then
		return
	end

	local dist = 0
	for _, v in pairs(target_list) do
		if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			if dist < vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, v.Position) then
				self.target = v
				dist = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, v.Position)
			end
		end
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	self.revolver_shot = nil
	self.gatling_shot = nil
	self.support_call = nil
	self.retreat_fire = nil

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
				self.time_passed = 0
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.prev_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
							random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.prev_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
						random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
			end
		else
		end

		return
	end
end

--벽 근처인지 체크
function local_class:check_battle_zone_by_wall()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.retreat_action_distance)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Info.target) then
		return false
	end

	if self.use_support_call or self.support_call_count == nil then return end

	if self.support_call_count < self.support_call_hp_list.Count then
		if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100 < self.support_call_hp_list[self.support_call_count] then
			self.use_support_call = true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.prev_battle_action = nil
end

return {

	self.bead_absorb_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.circle_attack_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.squre_attack_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.remain_cooltime > 0 then
		self.remain_cooltime = self.remain_cooltime - dt
	end

	self:update_bead(dt)

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.current_rest_duration > self.time_passed then
		return
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		self.prev_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
	end

	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.battle_action_triggered = false

			if self.picked_battle_action == self.bead_absorb_action then
				self.current_rest_duration = 0
			else
				self.current_rest_duration = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_duration, self.max_rest_duration)
			end

			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.time_passed = 0

			self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, 5, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, 1))
		end
	else
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.battle_action_triggered = true

			if self.picked_battle_action == self.mind_control_action then
				self.remain_cooltime = self.mind_control_cooltime
			end

		else
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	local curr_ratio = character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character)
	if curr_ratio <= self.phase_hp_ratio then
		self:change_phase(self.phase_state.two)
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true)
	end

	-- 첫 패턴 검사
	if self.prev_battle_action == nil then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.mind_control_action
		return
	end

	-- >> local func
	local function pick_action_by_condition()
		if self.bead_count >= self.bead_limit then
			return self.bead_absorb_action
		end

		if (self.character.Position - self.target.Position).magnitude <= self.swing_distance_limit then
			return self.wand_swing_action
		end

		if self.deactive_count >= self.deactive_summon_limit and self.remain_cooltime <= 0 then
			return self.mind_control_action
		end

		return self.missile_breath_action
	end
	-- << local func

	if self.prev_battle_action == self.mind_control_action then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.bead_spawn_action

	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.bead_spawn_action then
		if self.reserved_battle_action ~= nil then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.reserved_battle_action
			self.reserved_battle_action = nil
			return
		end

		self.picked_battle_action = pick_action_by_condition()

	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.wand_swing_action then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.bead_spawn_action

	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.bead_absorb_action then
		if self.is_bead_absorb then
			local r_num = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
			if self.current_phsae == self.phase_state.two and r_num % 2 == 1 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.squre_attack_action
				return
			end

			self.picked_battle_action = self.circle_attack_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.bead_spawn_action
		end

	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.circle_attack_action then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.bead_spawn_action
		self.reserved_battle_action = self.missile_breath_action

	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.squre_attack_action then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.bead_spawn_action
		self.reserved_battle_action = self.missile_breath_action

	elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.missile_breath_action then
		self.picked_battle_action = pick_action_by_condition()
	end
end

function local_class:change_phase(new_phase)
	if self.current_phsae == new_phase then
		return
	end

	self.current_phsae = new_phase
end

function local_class:change_bead_state(data, new_state)
	if data.state == nil or data.state == new_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if data.state == self.bead_state.idle then
	elseif data.state == self.bead_state.spawn then
	elseif data.state == self.bead_state.move then
	end

	-- enter
	if new_state == self.bead_state.spawn then
		data.fx = self.fx_bead_pool:Instantiate(data.spawn_pos)
		data.calc.Position = data.spawn_pos
		data.calc:Start()
		self.bead_count = self.bead_count + 1

	elseif new_state == self.bead_state.idle then
	elseif new_state == self.bead_state.move then

	else
		data.spawn_pos = nil
		data.target_pos = nil
		data.position = nil
		data.calc:End()

		if data.fx ~= nil then
			data.fx:Dispose()
			data.fx = nil
		end

		self.bead_count = self.bead_count - 1
	end

	data.state = new_state
	data.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_bead(dt)
	for i = #self.bead_list, 1, -1 do
		local data = self.bead_list[i]
		data.time_passed = data.time_passed + dt

		if data.state == self.bead_state.spawn then
			self:publish_bead_damage(data, dt)

			local progress = data.time_passed / 0.5
			local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * 1
			local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(data.spawn_pos, data.target_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3(0, y, 0)
			data.position = new_pos
			CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(data.fx, new_pos, vector_util.zero)

			if progress >= 1 then
				self:change_bead_state(data, self.bead_state.idle)
			end

		elseif data.state == self.bead_state.idle then
			self:publish_bead_damage(data, dt)

		elseif data.state == self.bead_state.move then
			-- bead return to pool
			if (self.character.Position - data.position).magnitude <= 0.5 then
				self.fx_bead_end_pool:Instantiate(data.position)
				self:change_bead_state(data, self.bead_state.none)
				table.insert(self.bead_pool, table.remove(self.bead_list, i))

				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_light_06')

			else
				self:publish_bead_damage(data, dt)

				local dir = (self.character.Position - data.position).normalized
				local new_pos = data.position + dir * self.bead_speed * dt
				data.position = new_pos
				CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(data.fx, new_pos, vector_util.zero)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:publish_bead_damage(bead_data, dt)
	local calc = bead_data.calc
	bead_data.calc.Position = bead_data.position

	local objects = calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for _, fo in pairs(objects) do
		local knockback_dir = (fo.Position - bead_data.position).normalized
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.bead_damage_modifier
		damage_info.direction = knockback_dir
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_dir
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.bead_knockback_force
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:create_bead_data()
	local info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(self.bead_radius, 1000, self.bead_damage_term)
	local calc = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)

	local bead_data =
	{
		spawn_pos = nil,
		target_pos = nil,
		position = nil,
		fx = nil,
		calc = calc,
		state = self.bead_state.none,
		time_passed = 0
	}

	return bead_data
end

function local_class:bead_spawn()
	local bead_data = nil

	if #self.bead_pool > 0 then
		bead_data = table.remove(self.bead_pool)
	else
		bead_data = self:create_bead_data()
	end

	bead_data.spawn_pos = self.character.Position
	bead_data.target_pos = self:get_bead_position(self.character.Position)
	bead_data.position = self.character.Position
	self:change_bead_state(bead_data, self.bead_state.spawn)
	table.insert(self.bead_list, bead_data)
end

function local_class:bead_absorb()
	for _, data in pairs(self.bead_list) do
		self:change_bead_state(data, self.bead_state.move)
	end
end

function local_class:bead_clear()
	for i = #self.bead_list, 1, -1 do
		local data = self.bead_list[i]
		self:change_bead_state(data, self.bead_state.none)
		table.insert(self.bead_pool, table.remove(self.bead_list, i))
	end
end

function local_class:summon_monster()
	for i, fo in pairs(self.monster_list) do
		local marker = field:GetMarker('boss_summon_' .. tostring(i))
		if not self.zone_bound:Contains(fo.Position) then
			fo.Position = marker.position
			fo.Direction = marker.direction

			self.fx_monster_spawn_pool:Instantiate(fo.Position)

		elseif fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
			heal_info.heal = fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.isRevive = true
			heal_info.skipEffect = true
			heal_info.sender = self.character
			heal_info.target = fo
			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

			self.fx_monster_spawn_pool:Instantiate(fo.Position)

			fo.Direction = marker.direction
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(fo, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
		message_system:Send(fo.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(
				fo, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
	end

	self.deactive_count = 0
end

function local_class:clear_monster()
	for _, fo in pairs(self.monster_list) do
		if not fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.damage = character_util.get_max_hp(fo) * 10
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			self.fx_monster_spawn_pool:Instantiate(fo.Position)
		end

		fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end
end

function local_class:get_bead_position(position)
	self.loop_count = self.loop_count + 1

	local new_position = position

	-- 들어온 위치가 기준이 되는 캐릭터 위치임.
	-- 캐릭터 주변 5타일 이내에 랜덤 드랍 (타일 위치기반으로 랜덤 계산하도록.. )
	-- 바로 충돌나서 없어지지 않도록 self.current_stage_info.collide_range 범위밖에 생성되도록 하야 함.
	local distance = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.bead_radius * 2, self.bead_create_range)
	local rand_angle = unity_class.random.Range(0.0, 359.9999)
	local rand_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rand_angle, unity_class.vector3.up) * unity_class.vector3.forward

	-- 랜덤 회전값 만큼 회전시켜서 해당 방향으로 랜덤 거리만큼 이동
	new_position = position + rand_dir.normalized * distance

	if false == self.zone:Contains(new_position) then
		-- 새로 결정된 포지션이 배틀존 안에 없으면
		new_position = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertPositionToInsideOfBounds(self.zone.Bounds, new_position, self.bead_create_range)

		-- 조정해준 애가 문제 있으면 처음으로 되돌아감
		if false == self:check_bead_position(new_position) then
			return self:get_bead_position(position)
		end

		return new_position

	elseif true == self:check_bead_position(new_position) then
		-- 문제 없는 경우
		return new_position

	else
		-- 문제가 있으면 다음 interpolate.
		return self:get_bead_interpolate_position(new_position, position)
	end
end

function local_class:check_bead_position(position)
	if #self.bead_list == 0 then
		return true
	end

	-- 기존 나와있는 구슬들 위치에서 create_range 범위안에 곂치는 위치인지 확인
	for _, v in pairs(self.bead_list) do
		if v.target_pos ~= nil then
			local dist = vector_util.distance(vector_util.get_x0z(position) , vector_util.get_x0z(v.target_pos))

			-- 1개라도 걸린다면 바로 false
			if dist <= self.bead_radius * 2 then
				return false
			end
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:get_bead_interpolate_position(prev, origin_position)
	self.loop_count = self.loop_count + 1

	local new_position = prev
	local add_create_range = 1
	local distance = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.bead_radius * 2, self.bead_radius * 2 + self.bead_radius * 2)
	local rand_angle = unity_class.random.Range(-60, 60)
	local polated_vec = prev - origin_position
	local rand_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rand_angle, vector_util.up) * polated_vec

	-- 최초 포지션인 origin_position 을 기준으로 prev 위치에서 바깥쪽 좌우 각도에서 랜덤하게 위치를 선택한다.
	new_position = prev + (rand_dir.normalized * distance)

	-- 일단 먼저 interpolate max 에 도달하였는지 체크.
	if false == self:is_interpolate_max(new_position, origin_position, self.loop_count, add_create_range) then
		return self:get_bead_position(origin_position)
	end

	if false == self.zone:Contains(new_position) then
		-- 새로 결정된 포지션이 배틀존 안에 없으면
		new_position = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertPositionToInsideOfBounds(self.zone_bound, new_position, self.bead_radius * 2)

		-- 조정해준 애가 문제 있으면 처음으로 되돌아감
		if false == self:check_bead_position(new_position) then
			return self:get_bead_position(origin_position)

		else
			return new_position
		end

	elseif true == self:check_bead_position(new_position) then
		-- 문제 없는 경우
		return new_position

	else
		-- 문제가 있으면 다음 interpolate.
		return self:get_bead_interpolate_position(new_position, origin_position)
	end
end

function local_class:is_interpolate_max(target, origin, bead_loop_count, add_create_range)
	local max = (self.bead_radius * 2) + add_create_range * (bead_loop_count / 4)
	return vector_util.distance(vector_util.get_x0z(target) , vector_util.get_x0z(origin)) <= max
end


function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_anubis_request_bead_spawn' then
		for _ = 1, self.bead_create_amount do
			self.loop_count = 0
			self:bead_spawn()
		end

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_anubis_request_bead_absorb' then
		self:bead_absorb()

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_anubis_bead_absorb_done' then
		self.is_bead_absorb = true
		self:bead_clear()

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_anubis_bead_absorb_force_cancel' then
		self.is_bead_absorb = false
		self:bead_clear()

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_anubis_request_summon_monster' then
		self:summon_monster()

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_anubis_request_bead_absorb_duration' then
		local time = 0
		for _, v in pairs(self.bead_list) do
			time = math.max(time, (self.character.Position - v.position).magnitude / self.bead_speed)
		end

		local param = { 'boss_anubis_bead_absorb_duration', tostring(time)}
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, param))
	end
end

function local_class:on_fieldobject_destroyed_event(e)
	local function is_monster_contain(fo)
		for _, v in pairs(self.monster_list) do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(v, fo) then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	if is_monster_contain(e.FieldObject) then
		self.deactive_count = self.deactive_count + 1
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.character) then
		self:clear_monster()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()

end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func)
		self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossArachneBattleAIState')

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		move_to_center = 1, --외곽에서 중앙으로 이동
		battle = 2, --배틀액션 사용 가능 상태
		groggy = 3, --그로기 상태
	}

	-- 추적하지 않고 일정 시간 대기 후 다음 패턴으로 감.
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 4)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 5)
	self.circling_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingDistance', 2.5)
	self.circling_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingSpeed', 2)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingSpeed", 1)
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxFlowTime", 1)
	self.phase2_hp = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Phase2HP", 0.9)
	self.use_strengthen_hp_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "UseStrengthenHpRatio", 0.7)
	self.smash_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SmashDistance", 4)
	self.groggy_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "GroggyDuration", 10)

	self.is_groggy = false
	self.groggy_anim = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('groggy', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false, 1, -1, nil, nil, 'groggy_loop')
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀액션
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
	end

	self.zone_bounds = battle_zone_bound

	self.smash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachneSmash")
	self.charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachneCharge")
	self.poison_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachnePoisonDrop")
	self.web_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachneSpiderWeb")
	self.phase2_stomp_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachneStomp:Phase2")
	self.phase2_charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachneCharge:Phase2")
	self.phase2_poison_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachnePoisonDrop:Phase2")
	self.phase2_smash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachneSmash:Phase2")
	self.chase_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachneChaseAttack")
	self.phase2_chase_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachneChaseAttack:Phase2")
	self.monster_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachneLoadMonster")

	self.poison_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.web_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.phase2_stomp_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.phase2_poison_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	local monster_list, gauge_monster_list = self.monster_action.MetaTable:get_monster()
	self.poison_action.MetaTable:set_monster_list(monster_list, gauge_monster_list)
	self.phase2_poison_action.MetaTable:set_monster_list(monster_list, gauge_monster_list)

	-- 진행시간
	self.time_passed = 0
	-- 선택된 배틀액션
	self.picked_battle_action = nil

	-- 배틀액션 실행중인지
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.battle_action_count = 0

	self.is_use_strengthen = false

	-- 구슬 컨트롤러 시작시킴
	local zone = battle_util.get_zone(self.character.Position)

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
			{'init_expedition_bead_controller', zone.Name}))

	-- 현재 체력에 따라 페이즈 적용해둠
	self.phase = {
		phase1 = 1,
		phase2 = 2
	}

	self.current_phase = self.phase.phase1
	if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100 < self.phase2_hp then
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
	end

	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)

	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)

	CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.phase2_stomp_action)
	self.phase2_stomp_action.MetaTable:set_change_phase(false)
	self.current_state = self.state.none
	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if  e:GetParamAt(0) == 'debuff_groggy' then
			--버프 3중첩으로 그로기
			--진행중인 배틀액션을 취소하고 그로기 상태
			if self.current_state ~= self.state.groggy then
				self.current_state = self.state.groggy
				self.time_passed = 0
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.is_groggy = true
				self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
				self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.groggy_anim)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	--test
	--self.web_action.MetaTable:set_phase_change()
	--self.picked_battle_action = self.phase2_stomp_action

	--local idx = self.battle_action_count % 2
	--
	--if idx == 0 then
	--	self.picked_battle_action = self.phase2_stomp_action
	--elseif idx == 1 then
	--	self.picked_battle_action = self.web_action
	--end

	if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase2 then
		self:phase2_pick_battle_action()
	else
		self:phase1_pick_battle_action()
	end

	self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))

	self.current_state = self.state.battle
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:phase1_pick_battle_action()
	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 4

	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.poison_action
	elseif idx == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.chase_action
	elseif idx == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
	elseif idx == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.smash_action
	end
end

function local_class:phase2_pick_battle_action()
	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 8

	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.phase2_poison_action
	elseif idx == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.phase2_charge_action
	elseif idx == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.phase2_stomp_action
	elseif idx == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.phase2_chase_action
	elseif idx == 4 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.phase2_poison_action
	elseif idx == 5 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.phase2_smash_action
	elseif idx == 6 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.phase2_stomp_action
	elseif idx == 7 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.web_action
	end
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:is_smash_action_distance()
	--스매쉬액션 범위 이내면 true 아니면 스톰프액션 범위
	if is_unity_null(self.target) or self.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		self:change_target()
	end
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if math.abs(diff) < self.smash_distance then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		if self.is_groggy then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
			self.is_groggy = false
		end
		return
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
	end

	--TOOD:메뉴얼캐릭 또는 존외곽과의 거리에 따른 행동 결정정
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 거리 파악해서 다음행동 이행
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
				--self.current_state = self.state.check_position
				self.current_state = self.state.none
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
			end
		else
			-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
			-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
				-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self.current_state = self.state.none
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
			self.is_groggy = false
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.phase ~= nil and self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
			if character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character) < self.phase2_hp then
				self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
				self.battle_action_triggered = false

				self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:SendSync(character, CS.Oak.CharacterAilmentResetEvent.Instance)
				buff_util.cure_all_debuffs(self.character, self.character)

				self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
				self.picked_battle_action = self.web_action
				self.web_action.MetaTable:set_phase_change()
				self.phase2_stomp_action.MetaTable:set_change_phase(true)

				self.current_state = self.state.battle
				self.battle_action_count = 0
				self.time_passed = 0
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_come_close_target()
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if math.abs(diff) < self.battle_distance then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:check_battle_zone_for_runaway()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.wall_distance)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
			return true
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
		self.time_passed = 0
		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	else
		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 거리 파악해서 다음행동 이행
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
				--self.current_state = self.state.check_position
				self.current_state = self.state.none
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
			end
		else
			-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
			-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
				-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)

	}

	-- 추적하지 않고 일정 시간 대기 후 다음 패턴으로 감.
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 4)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 5)
	self.circling_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingDistance', 2.5)
	self.circling_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingSpeed', 2)

	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxFlowTime", 1)
	self.phase2_hp = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Phase2HP", 0.9)
	self.use_strengthen_hp_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "UseStrengthenHpRatio", 0.7)
	self.smash_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SmashDistance", 4)
	self.groggy_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "GroggyDuration", 10)

	self.is_groggy = false
	self.groggy_anim = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('groggy', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false, 1, -1, nil, nil, 'groggy_loop')
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀액션
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
	end

	self.zone_bounds = battle_zone_bound

	self.smash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachneSmash:SingleRaid")
	self.charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachneCharge:SingleRaid")
	self.poison_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachnePoisonDropSingleRaid")
	self.stomp_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachneStompSingleRaid")
	self.chase_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossArachneChaseAttack:SingleRaid")

	self.poison_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.stomp_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)

	-- 진행시간
	self.time_passed = 0
	-- 선택된 배틀액션
	self.picked_battle_action = nil

	-- 배틀액션 실행중인지
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0

	self.current_state = self.state.none
	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	--test
	self.picked_battle_action = self.poison_action

	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 5

	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.chase_action
	elseif idx == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.poison_action
	elseif idx == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.chase_action
	elseif idx == 3 then
		--거리에 따라 charge or smash
		if self:is_smash_action_distance() then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.smash_action
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
		end
	elseif idx == 4 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.stomp_action
	end

	self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))

	self.current_state = self.state.battle
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:is_smash_action_distance()
	--스매쉬액션 범위 이내면 true 아니면 스톰프액션 범위
	if is_unity_null(self.target) or self.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		self:change_target()
	end
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if math.abs(diff) < self.smash_distance then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
	end

	--TOOD:메뉴얼캐릭 또는 존외곽과의 거리에 따른 행동 결정정
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 거리 파악해서 다음행동 이행
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
				--self.current_state = self.state.check_position
				self.current_state = self.state.none
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
			end
		else
			-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
			-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
				-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self.current_state = self.state.none
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
			self.is_groggy = false
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
end

function local_class:is_come_close_target()
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if math.abs(diff) < self.battle_distance then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:check_battle_zone_for_runaway()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.wall_distance)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)

	end
	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then

		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {

		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)

local local_class = newclass("BossAuraBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params_dict = params

	self.total_minion_count = 0
	self.dead_minion_count = 0
	self.not_enhanced_minion_count = 0

	self.current_action = nil

	self.minion_initialized = false

	self.destroying = false
end

function local_class:can_trigger_revive()
	return self.dead_minion_count > 0
end

function local_class:can_insert_power()
	return self.not_enhanced_minion_count > 0
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'initialize_aura_ai' then
		self.minion_initialized = true
		self.total_minion_count = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		self.dead_minion_count = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(2))
		self.not_enhanced_minion_count = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(3))

		if self.total_minion_count == self.dead_minion_count then
			self:on_destroyed_all_minion()
		end

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'update_minion_info' then
		self.dead_minion_count = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		self.not_enhanced_minion_count = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(2))

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'destroyed_all_minion' then
		self:on_destroyed_all_minion()

	end
end

function local_class:on_destroyed_all_minion()
	if self.destroying then
		return
	end

	self.destroying = true

	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(stage.Spec.IsRiftStageType and CS.Oak.DeathType.BossExplosion or CS.Oak.DeathType.None)
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = self.character
	damage_info.damage = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true

	self:revive_all_party_member()
	self:set_immortal_to_all_party_members()
end

function local_class:revive_all_party_member()
	for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
		if v ~= user_party.Leader then
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.sender = v
			heal_info.target = v
			heal_info.heal = v.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.isRevive = true

			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:remove_immortal_from_party_members()

	self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible

	local summon_action_handle_name = 'BossAuraReviveSummon'
	if self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions[0].HandleName:sub(1, #summon_action_handle_name) == summon_action_handle_name then
		self.revive_action = self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions[0]
		self.enhance_action = self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions[1]
	else
		self.revive_action = self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions[1]
		self.enhance_action = self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions[0]
	end

	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)

	self.total_minion_count = 0
	self.dead_minion_count = 0
	self.not_enhanced_minion_count = 0

	self.current_action = nil

	self.minion_initialized = false

	self.character.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'unique/scales_loop'
	message_system:Send(self.character.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Create(self.character)))
end

function local_class:remove_immortal_from_party_members()
	for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
		if v ~= user_party.Leader then
			v.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Immortal = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_immortal_to_all_party_members()
	for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
		if v ~= user_party.Leader then
			v.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Immortal = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	-- return bool
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	if not self.minion_initialized then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'request_initialize_aura_ai' }))
		return
	end

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'request_update_minion_info' }))

	if self.current_action == nil or not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.current_action) then
		self:pick_battle_action()
		if self.current_action == nil then
			return
		end

		CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.current_action)
	end

end

function local_class:pick_battle_action()
	if self:can_trigger_revive() then
		self.current_action = self.revive_action
	elseif self:can_insert_power() then
		self.current_action = self.enhance_action
	else
		self.current_action = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

	self.lava_bomb_max_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'LavaBombMaxCount', 3)
	-- 페이즈 2만 사용 하도록
	self.use_phase2_only = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'UsePhase2Only', true)
	-- 발화상태 해제 되어 그로기 되는 시간.
	self.groggy_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'GroggyDuration', 5)
	-- 복귀돌진 쿨타임
	self.return_charge_cool_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ReturnChargeCoolTime', 30)
	-- 그로기 애니메이션 이름
	self.groggy_ani_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'GroggyAnimationName', 'groggy')

	self.anim_req_groggy =  CS.Oak.AnimationRequest(self.groggy_ani_name, CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true, 1, -1, nil, nil, nil)

	-- 용암투척 쿨타임
	self.lava_bomb_cool_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'LavaBombCoolTime', 10)

end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	-- 내부 바운드에 캐릭터 존재하면 일반 액션.
	if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ (self.inner_zone_bound, self.character.Position) then
		if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
			self:pick_phase1_battle_action()
		else
			self:pick_phase2_battle_action()
		end
	else --내부 바운드 밖에 캐릭터 존재 하면
		-- 캐릭터 외곽에 있을때도 메테오를 1순위로 한다.
		if self.is_meteor_ready and self.is_meteor_time_over then
			-- 시간초과에 의해 메테오가 준비 되었다면 쿨타임 상관 없이 사용 가능
			self.meteor_cool_time_passed = 0
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
			self.picked_battle_action = self.meteor_action
			self.is_meteor_ready = false
			self.is_meteor_time_over = false
		else
			-- 복귀돌진 쿨타임
			if self.is_return_charge_ready then
				if self.phase_change_reserved then
					-- 외곽에 있어서 복귀돌진 가능해야 하지만 페이즈 전환 가능한 경우 이쪽을 우선한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = self.phase_shift_action
					self.phase_change_reserved = false
				else
					-- 맵의 외곽에 있다면 가운데로 이동 해야 함.
					-- 가운데로 이동 후 이전 액션을 다시 해야 하므로 카운트 감소
					self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count - 1
					self.return_charge_cool_time_passed = self.return_charge_cool_time
				end
				-- 해당 시점에 페이즈 전환 액션 우선 작동 해도 다음 동작은 위치 검사 다시 하도록 한다.
				self.is_return_charge_ready = false
			else
				--복귀돌진 쿨타임이 되지 않아 다른 액션 선택해야 한다면 다시 픽
				if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
					self:pick_phase1_battle_action()
				else
					self:pick_phase2_battle_action()
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self.time_passed = 0
end

-- 디버그용

	if self.picked_battle_action == self.slash_action then
		print('pick slash action', self.battle_action_count)
	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.erupted_lava_action then
		print('pick erupted lava action', self.battle_action_count)
	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.phase_shift_action then
		print('pick phase shift action', self.battle_action_count)
	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.prison_charge_action then
		print('pick prison charge action', self.battle_action_count)
	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.lava_bomb_action then
		print('pick lava bomb action', self.battle_action_count)
	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.charge_action then
		print('pick charge action', self.battle_action_count)
	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.meteor_action then
		print('pick meteor action', self.battle_action_count)
