end

function local_class:set_action_phase(phase)
	self.slash_action.MetaTable:set_phase(phase)
	self.lava_bomb_action.MetaTable:set_phase(phase)
	self.prison_charge_action.MetaTable:set_phase(phase)
	self.erupted_lava_action.MetaTable:set_phase(phase)
end
function local_class:pick_phase1_battle_action()
	if self.phase_change_reserved then
		-- 페이즈 변경 예약 되었다면 다음 액션은 페이즈시프트로 확정.
		self.picked_battle_action = self.phase_shift_action
		self.phase_change_reserved = false
		self.current_phase = self.phase.two
		-- 이시점에 배틀액션들 2페이즈 들어가는것 확정
		self:set_action_phase(self.current_phase)
	else
		if self.target_distance >= self.battle_distance and self.current_lava_bomb_count < self.lava_bomb_max_count then
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
			self.picked_battle_action = self.lava_bomb_action
			self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count - 1
			self.current_lava_bomb_count = self.current_lava_bomb_count + 1
			-- 쿨타임 존재하기 시작함.
			self.lava_bomb_time_passed = 0
		else
			local idx = self.battle_action_count % 4
			-- 라바 봄 연속 발사 횟수 초기화
			self.current_lava_bomb_count = 0
			if idx == 0 then
				self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
				self.picked_battle_action = self.erupted_lava_action
			elseif idx == 1 or idx == 3 then
				self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
				self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
			elseif idx == 2 then
				-- 가장 먼 타겟
				self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchFarthestTarget(self.cs_state, true))
				self.picked_battle_action = self.prison_charge_action
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pick_phase2_battle_action()
	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 5
	-- 페이즈 전환 예약 되었더라도 메테오가 순서라면 메테오를 우선하여 동작한다.
	if self.phase_change_reserved then
		if idx == 1 and self.is_meteor_ready then
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
			self.picked_battle_action = self.meteor_action
		else
			-- 페이즈 변경 예약 되었다면 다음 액션은 페이즈시프트로 확정.
			self.picked_battle_action = self.phase_shift_action
			self.phase_change_reserved = false
		end

	else
		-- 1순위가 거리 오버 및 시간초과에 의한 메테오를 우선시함.
		if self.is_meteor_ready and self.is_meteor_time_over then
			-- 시간초과에 의해 메테오가 준비 되었다면 쿨타임 상관 없이 사용 가능
			self.meteor_cool_time_passed = 0
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
			self.picked_battle_action = self.meteor_action
			self.is_meteor_ready = false
			self.is_meteor_time_over = false
		else
			if self.target_distance >= self.battle_distance and  self.current_lava_bomb_count < self.lava_bomb_max_count
			and self.lava_bomb_ready then
				self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
				self.picked_battle_action = self.lava_bomb_action
				-- 용암투척 이후 용암분출로 이행할수 있도록 카운트 수정
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count - 1
				self.current_lava_bomb_count = self.current_lava_bomb_count + 1
			else
				-- 라바 봄 연속 발사 횟수 초기화
				if self.current_lava_bomb_count ~= 0 then
					-- 이전에 용암투척 사용한적이 있는데, 다른 액션으로 변경된 경우 쿨타임 체크 할수 있도록 한다.
					self.current_lava_bomb_count = 0
					self.lava_bomb_ready = false
				end
				-- 앞발 -> 속박돌진 -> 앞발 -> 화염폭격 -> 유성 (쿨타임 존재)
				if idx == 2 or idx == 4 then
					self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
					self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
				elseif idx == 3 then
					-- 가장 먼 타겟
					self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchFarthestTarget(self.cs_state, true))
					self.picked_battle_action = self.prison_charge_action
				elseif idx == 0 then
					self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
					self.picked_battle_action = self.erupted_lava_action
				elseif idx == 1 then
					-- 해당 순서가 왔을때 메테오 쿨타임이 완료되었다면
					if self.is_meteor_ready then
						self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
						self.picked_battle_action = self.meteor_action
					else
						-- 쿨타임 아직 끝나지 않았다면 다음 액션을 픽할수 있도록 함.
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
						self:pick_phase2_battle_action()
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_target_distance(dt)
	-- 타겟 없으면 타겟을 일단 찾아
	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target()
	end

	self.target_distance = vector_util.distance(self.target.Position, self.character.Position)
	--
	if not self.is_meteor_time_over then
		if self.target_distance >= self.battle_distance then
			-- 거리 벗어나있는동안 타임 누적됨
			self.over_distance_time_passed = self.over_distance_time_passed + dt
		else
			-- 거리 내로 들어오면 누적 시간값 초기화
			self.over_distance_time_passed = 0
		end

		-- 메테오 실행가능한 시간 이후까지 누적되었다면 메테오 발사 준비함.
		if self.over_distance_time_passed >= self.meteor_over_time then
			self.is_meteor_ready = true
			self.is_meteor_time_over = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀액션
	self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end
	local inner_zone_size = self.zone_bound.size
	inner_zone_size.x = inner_zone_size.x - 2
	inner_zone_size.z = inner_zone_size.z - 2
	-- 보스 중앙으로 이동 하는 것에 대한 체크를 하기 위한 내부 바운드
	self.inner_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.zone_bound.center, inner_zone_size)

	self.slash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossBalockSlash')
	self.lava_bomb_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossBalockLavaBomb')
	self.prison_charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossBalockPrisonCharge')
	self.erupted_lava_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossBalockEruptedLava')
	self.phase_shift_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossBalockPhaseShift')
	self.meteor_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossBalockMeteor')
	-- 보스 외곽에 위치해 있는 경우 중앙으로 이동할수 있도록 하는 돌격 액션
	self.charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossBalockCharge')

	-- 배틀액션에 배틀존 설정
	self.slash_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.lava_bomb_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.prison_charge_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.erupted_lava_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.phase_shift_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.meteor_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.charge_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

	self.current_state = self.state.none

	-- 페이즈 2만 사용하도록 한다.
	if self.use_phase2_only then
		self.current_phase = self.phase.two
	else
		self.current_phase = self.phase.one
	end

	-- 배틀액션에 현재 페이즈 설정
	self:set_action_phase(self.current_phase)

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	-- 타겟과 보스의 거리
	self.target_distance = 0
	-- 현재 배틀액션 카운트
	self.battle_action_count = 0
	-- 공격범위 벗어난 경우에 지난 시간
	self.over_distance_time_passed = 0
	-- 메테오액션 사용 가능한 쿨타임 얼마나 지났는지
	self.meteor_cool_time_passed = 0
	-- 메테오 액션 사용 가능한가?
	self.is_meteor_ready = true
	-- 먼거리 시간초과에 의해 메테오가 사용가능해진 상태인가
	self.is_meteor_time_over = false
	-- 진행시간
	self.time_passed = 0
	-- 선택된 배틀액션
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	-- 지난번 실행된 배틀액션
	self.last_battle_action = nil
	-- 복귀 돌진 사용 쿨타임
	self.return_charge_cool_time_passed = 0
	-- 복귀돌진 사용 가능한가?
	self.is_return_charge_ready = true
	-- 배틀액션 실행중인지
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	-- 상태이상게이지 최대치 (Constants에 정의된것은 obscured 라 그냥 여기서 정의해서 씀)
	self.max_ailment_gauge = 100

	-- 그로기 시간지남 체크
	self.groggy_time_passed = 0
	-- 그로기 타임 체크 할것인가.
	self.is_groggy_time_check = false
	-- 다음액션까지의 대기
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time

	self.on_battle_end_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_battle_end_event(e)
	end
	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end
	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), self.on_battle_end_event_func)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)

	-- 구슬 컨트롤러 시작시킴
	local zone = battle_util.get_zone(self.character.Position)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'init_expedition_bead_controller', zone.Name}))

	-- 용암투척 연속해서 사용한 횟수
	self.current_lava_bomb_count = 0
	-- 용암투척 쿨타임 지난 시간
	self.lava_bomb_time_passed = 0
	-- 용암투척 사용 가능한가
	self.lava_bomb_ready = true

	-- 그로기 상태 진행된 시간
	self.groggy_time_passed = 0
	-- 그로기 시간 체크하기 시작
	self.is_groggy_time_check = false
	-- 발화상태 시작 안함 (페이즈2온리 용)
	self.is_ignition_start = false

	if is_unity_null(self.target) then
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	else
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
				random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed))
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	-- 배틀 자체가 종료 되었을 경우 발화상태 취소 되어야 한다.
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'end_ignition'}))
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'dispose_expedition_bead_controller'}))

	self.is_ignition_start = nil
	self.slash_action = nil
	self.lava_bomb_action = nil
	self.prison_charge_action = nil
	self.erupted_lava_action = nil
	self.phase_shift_action = nil
	self.meteor_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
end


function local_class:on_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
		return
	end

	if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
		-- 1페이즈에서는 다음페이즈 진입 체크만 하면 됨.
		self:update_phase()
	elseif self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
		-- 2페이즈에서 발화상태 체크
		if self.use_phase2_only then
			self:update_phase()
		end
		--연계기 액션 데미지 보낼때 forceAilment == true 이고 해당하는 상태이상치 값 100 으로 보내지므로
		-- 두가지 조건을 만족하는 데미지 정보가 오면 연계기 맞았다고 판단함.
		if e.Info.forceAilment then
			if e.Info[CS.Oak.Ailment.Down] == self.max_ailment_gauge
					or e.Info[CS.Oak.Ailment.Poison] == self.max_ailment_gauge
					or e.Info[CS.Oak.Ailment.Aerial] == self.max_ailment_gauge then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'hit_support_action'}))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if self.current_phase ~= self.phase.two then
		return
	end

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_balock_groggy' then
		self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
		self.current_state = self.state.groggy
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_req_groggy)
		self.is_groggy_time_check = true
		-- 그로기 모션 side 만존재 하므로
		self.locked_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		character_util.set_locked_dir(self.character, direction_util.to_str(self.locked_dir))
		self.groggy_time_passed = 0
		self.time_passed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if not self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			-- 그로기중에 배틀 종료 되었을때 그로기 모션인채로 미끄러져 이동 되는것 방지
			character_util.set_locked_dir(self.character, 'none')
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_phase()
	if character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character) <= self.phase_hp_ratio
			and not self.phase_change_reserved and not self.is_ignition_start then

		if not (self.picked_battle_action == self.meteor_action) then
			-- 현재 진행중인 액션이 메테오가 아닐경우 현재 배틀액션 취소하고 페이즈 시프트 들어감
			self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
		end
		-- 디버프 및 상태이상 해제
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:SendSync(character, CS.Oak.CharacterAilmentResetEvent.Instance)
		buff_util.cure_all_debuffs(self.character, self.character)
		self.phase_change_reserved = true
		self.battle_action_count = 0
		-- 상태이상 면역 추가
		self:set_ailment_resist()
		self.last_battle_action = nil
		self.is_ignition_start = true
		self.current_state = self.state.action_wait
		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	end
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	--거리 벗어난 시간을 추가로 측정함.
	self:check_target_distance(dt)
	-- 그로기 시간체크
	if self.is_groggy_time_check then
		self.groggy_time_passed = self.groggy_time_passed + dt
	end
	-- 쿨타임 체크하는 부분 - 연산에서 + 연산으로 변경
	-- 메테오 쿨타임 체크
	if not self.is_meteor_ready then
		self.meteor_cool_time_passed = self.meteor_cool_time_passed + dt
		if self.meteor_cool_time_passed >= self.meteor_cool_time then
			self.is_meteor_ready = true
		end
	end

	-- 복귀돌진 쿨타임 체크
	if not self.is_return_charge_ready then
		self.return_charge_cool_time_passed = self.return_charge_cool_time_passed + dt
		if self.return_charge_cool_time_passed >= self.return_charge_cool_time then
			self.is_return_charge_ready = true
		end
	end

	-- 용암투척 쿨타임 체크
	if not self.lava_bomb_ready then
		self.lava_bomb_time_passed = self.lava_bomb_time_passed + dt
		if self.lava_bomb_time_passed >= self.lava_bomb_cool_time then
			self.lava_bomb_ready = true
		end
	end

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	-- 액션 대기
	if self.current_state == self.state.action_wait then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					--배틀액션 끝났으면 서클링으로 변경.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.time_passed = 0
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)

					-- 페이즈시프트 액션이 끝났다면 상태이상 면역 해제
					if self.last_battle_action == self.phase_shift_action then
						self:reset_ailment()
					elseif self.last_battle_action == self.lava_bomb_action then
						-- 이 시점부터 쿨타임 초기화
						self.lava_bomb_time_passed = 0
					end

					-- 지난 액션이 화염 폭격이라면
					if self.last_battle_action == self.erupted_lava_action and self.is_meteor_ready then
						self.current_state = self.state.action_wait
						-- 메테오 액션 바로 이어서 사용 할 수 있도록
						self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
					else
						self.current_state = self.state.none
						self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
								random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed))
					end
				end
			else
				-- 배틀액션 시작되지 않음.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 발동시킨후 배틀액션 발동된 배틀액션 저장
					self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					-- 배틀액션 실행 되었을때 해당 액션이 메테오 액션이라면
					if self.picked_battle_action == self.meteor_action then
						-- 쿨타임 설정
						self.is_meteor_ready = false
						self.meteor_cool_time_passed = 0
					elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.charge_action then
						-- 배틀액션 시작되었을때 쿨타임 초기화
						self.is_return_charge_ready = false
						self.return_charge_cool_time_passed = 0
					elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.phase_shift_action then
						self.battle_action_count = 2
					end

				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_rest_time then
					-- 시간 초과시 강제 트리거
					self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
					-- 시간내 발동 실패시 다음액션으로 넘김
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_state = self.state.none
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.none then
		-- 서클링 중인 상황
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
				if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
					-- Following 하지 않고 상태 변경으로 처리 한다.
					self.current_state = self.state.action_wait
					self.time_passed = 0
				end
			end

		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		-- 상태이상 상태 빠져나오면서 방향 해제 되기 때문에 그로기중 캐릭터 방향 전환 되는 경우가 있어 여기서 세팅함.
		if character_util.get_look_direction(self.character) ~= self.locked_dir then
			character_util.set_locked_dir(self.character, direction_util.to_str(self.locked_dir))
		end
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
			-- idle 상태를 그로기 상태로 사용함.
			if self.groggy_time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
				self.current_state = self.state.action_wait
				self.time_passed = 0
				self.groggy_time_passed = 0
				self.is_groggy_time_check = false
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				-- 유성패턴으로 시작할수 있도록
				self.battle_action_count = 1
				-- 쿨타임 무시하도록 함.
				self.is_meteor_ready = true
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
				-- 방향 설정 해제
				character_util.set_locked_dir(self.character, 'none')
				self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state, options)

end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state)
end

function local_class:dispose()

	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	if self.on_battle_end_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), self.on_battle_end_event_func)
		self.on_battle_end_event_func = nil
	end
	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossBalockSingleRaidBattleAIState')

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()

	self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
	self:check_target_distance()

	-- 최초 슬래시, 페이즈 시프트 최우선 사용
	if self.is_play_pre_action == false then
		if self.last_battle_action == nil then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action

		elseif self.last_battle_action == self.slash_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.phase_shift_action
			self.is_play_pre_action = true
		end

		self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
		self.time_passed = 0
		return
	end

	-- 위 이후 거리체크해서 복귀돌진 체크 우선
	if self.target_distance > self.battle_distance and self.is_return_charge_ready and self.last_battle_action ~= self.erupted_lava_action then
		if self.save_action == nil and self.last_battle_action ~= self.charge_action then
			self.save_action = self.last_battle_action
		end

		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action

		self.time_passed = 0
		self.is_return_charge_ready = false

	if self.last_battle_action == self.charge_action and self.save_action ~= nil then
		self.last_battle_action = self.save_action
		self.save_action = nil
	end

	-- 정상 사이클
	if self.last_battle_action == self.slash_action then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchFarthestTarget(self.cs_state, true))
		self.picked_battle_action = self.prison_charge_action

	elseif self.last_battle_action == self.prison_charge_action then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.lava_bomb_action

	elseif self.last_battle_action == self.lava_bomb_action then
		-- 화염 폭격 1회 제한(유성도 이로 인해 제한됨)
		--if self.is_use_erupted_lava then
		--	self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
		--else
		--	self.picked_battle_action = self.erupted_lava_action
		--	self.is_use_erupted_lava = true
		--end
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action


	--elseif self.last_battle_action == self.erupted_lava_action then
	--	self.picked_battle_action = self.meteor_action
	--
	--elseif self.last_battle_action == self.meteor_action then
	--	self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action

	else
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
	end

	self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:check_target_distance()
	-- 타겟 없으면 타겟을 일단 찾아
	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target()
	end

	self.target_distance = vector_util.distance(self.target.Position, self.character.Position)

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	-- 배틀 자체가 종료 되었을 경우 발화상태 취소 되어야 한다.
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'end_ignition'}))

	self.is_ignition_start = nil
	self.slash_action = nil
	self.lava_bomb_action = nil
	self.prison_charge_action = nil
	self.erupted_lava_action = nil
	self.phase_shift_action = nil
	self.meteor_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
end


function local_class:on_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
		return
	end

	--연계기 액션 데미지 보낼때 forceAilment == true 이고 해당하는 상태이상치 값 100 으로 보내지므로
	-- 두가지 조건을 만족하는 데미지 정보가 오면 연계기 맞았다고 판단함.
	if e.Info.forceAilment then
		if e.Info[CS.Oak.Ailment.Down] == self.max_ailment_gauge
				or e.Info[CS.Oak.Ailment.Poison] == self.max_ailment_gauge
				or e.Info[CS.Oak.Ailment.Aerial] == self.max_ailment_gauge then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'hit_support_action' }))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_balock_groggy' then
		self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
		self.current_state = self.state.groggy
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_req_groggy)
		self.is_groggy_time_check = true
		-- 그로기 모션 side 만존재 하므로
		self.locked_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target))
		character_util.set_locked_dir(self.character, direction_util.to_str(self.locked_dir))
		self.groggy_time_passed = 0
		self.time_passed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if not self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			-- 그로기중에 배틀 종료 되었을때 그로기 모션인채로 미끄러져 이동 되는것 방지
			character_util.set_locked_dir(self.character, 'none')
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_phase()
	-- 디버프 및 상태이상 해제
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:SendSync(character, CS.Oak.CharacterAilmentResetEvent.Instance)
	buff_util.cure_all_debuffs(self.character, self.character)
	self.phase_change_reserved = true
	self.battle_action_count = 0
	-- 상태이상 면역 추가
	self:set_ailment_resist()
	self.last_battle_action = nil
	self.is_ignition_start = true
	self.current_state = self.state.action_wait
	self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 그로기 시간체크
	if self.is_groggy_time_check then
		self.groggy_time_passed = self.groggy_time_passed + dt
	end

	-- 복귀돌진 쿨타임 체크
	if not self.is_return_charge_ready then
		self.return_charge_cool_time_passed = self.return_charge_cool_time_passed + dt
		if self.return_charge_cool_time_passed >= self.return_charge_cool_time then
			self.is_return_charge_ready = true
		end
	end

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	-- 액션 대기
	if self.current_state == self.state.action_wait then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.time_passed = 0
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)

					-- 페이즈시프트 액션이 끝났다면 상태이상 면역 해제
					if self.last_battle_action == self.phase_shift_action then
						self:reset_ailment()
					end

					self.current_state = self.state.none
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
							random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed))
				end
			else
				-- 배틀액션 시작되지 않음.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.battle_action_triggered = true

				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_rest_time then
					-- 시간내 발동 실패시 다음액션으로 넘김
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_state = self.state.none
				end
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.none then
		-- 서클링 중인 상황
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
				if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
					-- Following 하지 않고 상태 변경으로 처리 한다.
					self.current_state = self.state.action_wait
					self.time_passed = 0
				end
			end

		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		-- 상태이상 상태 빠져나오면서 방향 해제 되기 때문에 그로기중 캐릭터 방향 전환 되는 경우가 있어 여기서 세팅함.
		if character_util.get_look_direction(self.character) ~= self.locked_dir then
			character_util.set_locked_dir(self.character, direction_util.to_str(self.locked_dir))
		end
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
			-- idle 상태를 그로기 상태로 사용함.
			if self.groggy_time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
				self.current_state = self.state.action_wait
				self.time_passed = 0
				self.groggy_time_passed = 0
				self.is_groggy_time_check = false
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				-- 유성패턴으로 시작할수 있도록
				self.battle_action_count = 1
				-- 쿨타임 무시하도록 함.
				self.is_meteor_ready = true
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
				-- 방향 설정 해제
				character_util.set_locked_dir(self.character, 'none')
				self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state, options)

end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state)
end

function local_class:dispose()

	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	if self.on_battle_end_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), self.on_battle_end_event_func)
		self.on_battle_end_event_func = nil
	end
	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("BossBgeneralBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params_dict = params

	self.follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 3)
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 5)
	self.rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RestTime", 1)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinFollowTime", 1)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxFollowTime", 3)

	self.marker_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "MarkerName", 'event_lw_bgeneral_')
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
	end

	self.battle_zone = battle_zone_bound

	-- 배틀액션
	self.hook_move_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossBgeneralHookMove")
	self.hook_dash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossBgeneralHookDash")
	self.hook_sentence_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossBgeneralHookSentence")

	self.hook_move_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.hook_dash_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.hook_sentence_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.current_rest_time = 0
	self.battle_action_index = 0

	local markers = {}
	local i = 0
	while true do
		i = i + 1
		local marker = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetMarker(self.marker_name .. i)
		local is_null = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(marker, typeof(CS.Oak.NullMarkerInfo))
		if is_null then break end
		table.insert(markers, marker.position)
	end

	self.hook_move_action.MetaTable:set_marker_list(markers)
	self.hook_sentence_action.MetaTable:set_marker_list(markers)

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()
	self.hook_move_action = nil
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self:change_target(user_party.Leader)

	if self.battle_action_index == 0 then
		self.battle_action_index = 1
		self.picked_battle_action = self.hook_move_action
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 1 then
		self.battle_action_index = 2
		self.picked_battle_action = self.hook_dash_action
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 2 then
		local dist = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position))
		if dist <= 3 then
			self.battle_action_index = 3
			self.picked_battle_action = self.hook_move_action
		else
			self.battle_action_index = 0
			self.picked_battle_action = self.hook_sentence_action
		end
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 3 then
		self.battle_action_index = 0
		self.picked_battle_action = self.hook_sentence_action
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("BossBlackFlowerBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.rest_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RestDuration', 0.5)

	self.state = {
		rest = 1,
		battle = 2,
		groggy = 3,
		recover_groggy = 4,
	}

	self.next_groggy_hp_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(params, 'GroggyHPRatio')
	self.next_groggy_hp_ratio:Add(-1)
	self.groggy_count = 0
	self.groggy_ani_time = 1.5
	self.groggy_anim = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('groggy', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false, 1, -1, nil, nil, nil)
	self.groggy_loop_anim = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('groggy_loop', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true, 1, -1, nil, nil, nil)
	self.groggy_end_anim = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('groggy_end', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false, 1, -1, nil, nil, 'idle')
	self.groggy_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'GroggyTime', 10)
	self.groggy_recover_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'GroggyRecoverTime', 3.2)
	self.shoot_action_postfix = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "BossBlackFlowerTrackingShotPostfix", '')

	self.current_state = self.state.rest
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 액션 데이터
	self.thorn_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossBlackFlowerPainThorns")
	self.smash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossBlackFlowerSmash")

	local shoot_action_name = ''

	if self.shoot_action_postfix == '' then
		shoot_action_name = "BossBlackFlowerTrackingShot"
	else
		shoot_action_name = "BossBlackFlowerTrackingShot:"..self.shoot_action_postfix
	end

	self.shoot_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, shoot_action_name)
	self.stem_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossBlackFlowerSummonStem")

	self.shoot_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position))
	self.stem_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position))

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.picked_battle_action_table = nil
	self.current_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.battle_action_index_map = {
		[0] = { self.shoot_action },
		[1] = { self.thorn_action },
		[2] = { self.smash_action, self.shoot_action },
		[3] = { self.smash_action },
		[4] = { self.shoot_action },
		[5] = { self.smash_action },
	}

	self.groggy_after_battle_action_index_map = {
		[1] = { self.stem_action },
		[2] = { self.smash_action },
		[3] = { self.shoot_action },
		[4] = { self.thorn_action },
		[5] = { self.smash_action },
		[6] = { self.shoot_action },
		[7] = { self.smash_action, self.shoot_action },
	}

	self:set_groggy_count()
	self.current_battle_action_index_map = self.groggy_count == 0 and self.battle_action_index_map or self.groggy_after_battle_action_index_map
	self.battle_action_index = self.groggy_count == 0 and -1 or 0

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	self:change_state(self.state.rest)
	self:pick_battle_action_candidate()
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(nil)

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
	self:remove_all_battle_action_objects()
	self.stomp_action = nil
	self.rush_action = nil

	self.picked_battle_action_table = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_index = nil
	self.battle_action_index_map = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Info.target) then
		return self:handle_damage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CharacterAilmentStartedEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Character) then
		-- [KYU] 한, 영, 일, 중 모든 보이스에 대응되었기 때문에 조건문이 필요없다 판단, 제외한다.
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self:get_sfx_name('04_dialogue_morian_06'))

		if self.current_state == self.state.recover_groggy then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_sfx_name(origin_name)
	if music_player.CurrentVoiceLanguage ~= 'ko' then
		return origin_name .. '_' .. music_player.CurrentVoiceLanguage
	end

	return origin_name
end

function local_class:set_groggy_count()
	while self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < self.next_groggy_hp_ratio[self.groggy_count] do
		self.groggy_count = self.groggy_count + 1
	end
end

function local_class:handle_damage_event(e)
	if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < self.next_groggy_hp_ratio[self.groggy_count] then
		self.groggy_count = self.groggy_count + 1
		self.current_battle_action_index_map = self.groggy_after_battle_action_index_map
		self.battle_action_index = 0
		self:pick_battle_action_candidate()
		self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_candidate()
	self.battle_action_index = self.battle_action_index < 0
			and self.battle_action_index + 1
			or self.battle_action_index % #self.current_battle_action_index_map + 1
	self.picked_battle_action_table = self.current_battle_action_index_map[self.battle_action_index]
	self:change_target_with_picked_action()
end

function local_class:change_target_with_picked_action()
	self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state)
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	if not can_control then
		return
	end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then
		if self.time_passed > self.rest_duration then
			for i = 1, #self.picked_battle_action_table do
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action_table[i], self.target) then
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action_table[i])
					self.current_action = self.picked_battle_action_table[i]
					self:change_state(self.state.battle)
					return
				end
			end
			self:pick_battle_action_candidate()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.current_action == nil or not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.current_action) then
			self:pick_battle_action_candidate()
			self:change_state(self.state.rest)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed > self.groggy_ani_time and self.time_passed - dt < self.groggy_ani_time then
			self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.groggy_loop_anim)
		elseif self.time_passed > self.groggy_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.recover_groggy)
		end


	elseif self.current_state == self.state.recover_groggy then
		if self.time_passed > self.groggy_recover_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.rest)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.recover_groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0

	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self:get_sfx_name('04_dialogue_morian_07'))
		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.groggy_anim)
		self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
		self:remove_all_battle_action_objects()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.recover_groggy then
		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.groggy_end_anim)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self:get_sfx_name('04_dialogue_morian_04'))
	end
end

function local_class:remove_all_battle_action_objects()
	self.stem_action.MetaTable:destruct_stem()
	self.thorn_action.MetaTable:kill_all_monsters()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

--가장 가까운 위치를 제외한 랜덤 포지션
function local_class:get_teleport_random_pos()
	local most_close_index = 0
	local most_diff = 0
	local index_list = {}
	for i,v in pairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
		local diff = (self.character.Position - v.center).magnitude
		if most_close_index	== 0 then
			most_diff = diff
			most_close_index = i
		else
			if most_diff > diff then
				most_diff = diff
				most_close_index = i
			end
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.sliced_zone_bounds - 1 do
		table.insert(index_list, i)
	end

	local final_index = random_util.get_values_in_array(index_list,  {count = 1})

	return self.sliced_zone_bounds[final_index[1]].center
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StunEvent) or lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.AerialEvent) or
			lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DownEvent) or lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.PoisonEvent) then
		self.is_combo_end = true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.phase == nil or self.current_phase == self.phase.phase2 then
		return
	end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
		return
	end

	if character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character) < self.phase2_hp and not self.is_chain_action and self.current_phase ~= self.phase.phase2 then
		if self.picked_battle_action ~= self.aqua_chain_action and self.next_battle_action ~= self.aqua_chain_action then
			self.is_chain_action = true
			self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
			self.battle_action_triggered = false

			self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:SendSync(character, CS.Oak.CharacterAilmentResetEvent.Instance)
			buff_util.cure_all_debuffs(self.character, self.character)

			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))

			self.picked_battle_action = self.aqua_mad_action
			self.next_battle_action = self.aqua_chain_action

			self.current_combo_index = 1
			self.battle_action_count = 0
			self.is_combo_end = false
			self.phase_change_action = false
			self.time_passed = 0
		end
	end

		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

	if self.is_combo_end then
		if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
			self.current_combo_index = self.current_combo_index < self.max_combo_index and self.current_combo_index + 1 or 1
		else
			self.current_combo_index = self.current_combo_index < self.max_mad_combo_index and self.current_combo_index + 1 or 1
		end

		self.battle_action_count = 0
		self.is_combo_end = false
	end

		self:set_battle_action_combo1()
	elseif self.current_combo_index == 2 then
		self:set_battle_action_combo2()
	elseif self.current_combo_index == 3 then

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					if self.picked_battle_action == self.teleport_action then
						self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state)
					end

					if self.next_battle_action ~= nil then
						if self.picked_battle_action == self.aqua_mad_action and self.next_battle_action == self.aqua_chain_action then
							local pos = field:GetMarker("ww_chain_boss").position
							self.teleport_action.MetaTable:set_destination(pos)
							self.picked_battle_action = self.teleport_action
							self.next_battle_action = self.aqua_chain_action
						else
							self.picked_battle_action = self.next_battle_action
							self.next_battle_action = nil
						end

						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count - 1
					else
						--페이즈전환이나 물의연쇄패턴쓰면 패턴순서도 초기화
						if self.picked_battle_action == self.aqua_mad_action or self.picked_battle_action == self.aqua_chain_action then
							self.battle_action_count = 0
						end

						-- rest time control
						if self.picked_battle_action == self.teleport_action
								or self.picked_battle_action == self.blue_proj_tuto_action
								or self.picked_battle_action == self.blue_proj_tuto_mad_action
								or self.picked_battle_action == self.aqua_mad_action then
							self.current_rest_time = 0
						else
							self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
						end

						self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))

						if self.picked_battle_action == self.aqua_chain_action then
							self.teleport_action.MetaTable:set_destination(self.battle_zone_bound.center)
							self.next_battle_action = self.teleport_action
						end

						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
					end
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1

					if self.picked_battle_action == self.teleport_action then

			end
		end

		return
	end
end

	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	-- 최초 진입 시의 처리
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:process_to_next_state()
		end

		return
	end

	-- 배틀 액션 사용 중 or 인터벌 구간
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then

		-- 중간에 쉬는 타임
		if self.idling == true then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:process_to_next_state()
			end
		else
			-- 배틀액션 사용 중
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 잠시 circling으로 휴식
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 텔레포트 이후엔 딜레이 없이 넘김
					if self.picked_battle_action == self.teleport_action then
						self:process_to_next_state()
					else
						self.idling = true
						self.current_rest_time = self.min_rest_time + math.random() * (self.max_rest_time - self.min_rest_time)
						self:change_state_to_circling()
					end
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					-- 텔레포트는 횟수에 포함하지 않음
					if self.picked_battle_action ~= self.teleport_action then
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					end
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- fan call 예외처리
					if self.picked_battle_action == self.fan_call_action or self.picked_battle_action == self.fan_call_action_enhanced then
						-- hittable 무시하고 trigger 시킨다.
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action)
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리
						-- 맞출 수 없는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 하나 넘기고 재시도
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
						self:process_to_next_state()
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
		return false
	end

	if self.phase ~= nil and self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then

		end
	end

	if self.on_damage_event_func then

		self.on_damage_event_func = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
	self.phase2_hp = nil
	self.circling_distance = nil
	self.circling_speed_factor = nil
end

local local_class = newclass("BossChancellorBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	-- AI 스펙 로드 * 이 시점에서 파싱하고 딕셔너리 굳이 들고 있지 않도록
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'InitialRestTime', 0.5)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MinRestTime', 0.5)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaxRestTime', 1)

	self.standard_player_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'PatternDeterminantPlayerCount', 3)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	local zone_bound
	local zone_name = self.character.FieldObjectController.Zone
	if zone_name then
		zone_bound = field:GetZone(zone_name).Bounds
	else
		zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	end

	if zone_bound == nil then
		zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	self.rc_sub_system = CS.Oak.RogueChessSystem.Instance
	self.base_obj = self.rc_sub_system ~= nil and self.rc_sub_system.EndCondition.BaseObject or nil
	if self.base_obj ~= nil then
		self.black_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.IFieldObject)
		self.black_list:Add(self.base_obj)
	end

	self.cannon_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossChancellorCannon")
	self.tick_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossChancellorTargetTick")
	self.push_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossChancellorFullAttack")
	self.flame_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossChancellorBasicAttack")
	self.slash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossChancellorSlash")

	if self.tick_action ~= nil then
		self.tick_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(zone_bound)
		self.tick_action.MetaTable:set_base_object(self.base_obj)
	end

	if self.push_action ~= nil then
		self.push_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(zone_bound)
	end

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.random = CS.System.Random()
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.pattern_state_index = 0
	self.rest_time = self.initial_rest_time

	self.character.Direction = direction_util.left
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.character, direction_util.left)

	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if not is_unity_null(self.character) then
		character_util.set_locked_dir(self.character, direction_util.none)
	end

	self:change_state()

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.random = nil

	self.cannon_action = nil
	self.tick_action = nil
	self.push_action = nil
	self.flame_action = nil
	self.slash_action = nil

	self.base_obj = nil
	self.black_list = nil
end

function local_class:count_enemies()
	if self.rc_sub_system == nil then
		local targets = battle_manager:GetTargets(self.character, true)
		local target_count = targets.Count - 1
		targets:Dispose()
		return target_count
	end

	local count = 0
	local rosters = self.rc_sub_system.Deck.Rosters
	for i = 0, rosters.Count - 1 do repeat
		local roster = rosters[i]

		-- 필드 위에 있는지
		if not roster.IsPlaying or roster.IsDead then
			break
		end

		count = count + 1
	until true end

	return count
end

function local_class:get_action_index()
	if self.pattern_state_index == 0 then
		self.pattern_state_index = 1
		return 0
	elseif self.pattern_state_index == 1 then
		local target_count = self:count_enemies()
		if target_count >= self.standard_player_count then
			self.pattern_state_index = 2
			return 1
		else
			self.pattern_state_index = 2
			return 2
		end
	elseif self.pattern_state_index == 2 then
		self.pattern_state_index = 3
		return 3
	elseif self.pattern_state_index == 3 then
		self.pattern_state_index = 4
		return 2
	elseif self.pattern_state_index == 4 then
		local target_count = self:count_enemies()
		if target_count <= self.standard_player_count then
			self.pattern_state_index = 1
			return 0
		else
			self.pattern_state_index = 0
			return 4
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action()
	local action_idx = self:get_action_index()

	if action_idx == 0 then
		-- 캐논
		self.picked_battle_action = self.cannon_action
	elseif action_idx == 1 then
		-- 슬래시
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
	elseif action_idx == 2 then
		-- 기본 공격 (화염 발사)
		self.picked_battle_action = self.flame_action
	elseif action_idx == 3 then
		-- 타겟 지속 공격
		self.picked_battle_action = self.tick_action
	elseif action_idx == 4 then
		-- 전체 넉백 공격
		self.picked_battle_action = self.push_action
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == self.cannon_action then
		self:change_target()
	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.slash_action or self.picked_battle_action == self.flame_action then
		local new_target = battle_ai_util.search_closest_target(self.cs_state, false, self.black_list)
		self:change_target(new_target)
	end
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state, self.black_list, false)

		if new_target == nil then
			new_target = self.base_obj
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.cs_state.CurrentState == nil then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- rest time
	if self.time_passed < self.rest_time then
		return
	end

	-- rest time 끝나면 바로 배틀액션 시작
	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		self:pick_battle_action()
		return
	end

	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 다음액션 진행
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
			if self.min_rest_time >= self.max_rest_time then
				self.rest_time = self.min_rest_time
			else
				self.rest_time = self.min_rest_time + math.random() * (self.max_rest_time - self.min_rest_time)
			end
		end
	else
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
			self.rest_time = 0
			self.time_passed = 0
			self.battle_action_triggered = true
		else
			if self.pattern_state_index == 2 and self.picked_battle_action == self.slash_action then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.flame_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

	elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.acid_shot_action then
		--target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchFarthestTarget(self.cs_state)
		target = CS.Oak.PartyManager.Instance.UserParty.Leader
	end

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	local player_dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, CS.Oak.PartyManager.Instance.UserParty.Leader)
	if player_dist > self.charge_dist and self.last_time_used_charge + self.charge_cool_time < unity_class.time.time then
		self.last_time_used_charge = unity_class.time.time
		self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action -- 돌진
		self:change_target_with_picked_action()
	else
		if self.battle_action_index == 0 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.acid_shot_action -- 산성액
			self.battle_action_index = 1
			self:change_target_with_picked_action()
		elseif self.battle_action_index == 1 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action -- 슬래시
			self.battle_action_index = 2
			self:change_target_with_picked_action()
		elseif self.battle_action_index == 2 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.volcano_action -- 폭발 공격
			self.battle_action_index = 3
			self:change_target_with_picked_action()
		elseif self.battle_action_index == 3 then
			self:change_target()
			local target_dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, self.target)
			if target_dist <= 4 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action -- 슬래시
				self.battle_action_index = 4
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.acid_shot_action -- 산성액
				self.battle_action_index = 5
			end
		elseif self.battle_action_index == 4 or self.battle_action_index == 5 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.medusa_action -- 메두사
			self.battle_action_index = 6
			self:change_target_with_picked_action()
		elseif self.battle_action_index == 6 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.volcano_action -- 폭발 공격
			self.battle_action_index = 0
			self:change_target_with_picked_action()
		end
	end

	self.current_state = self.state.action
end

function local_class:cancel_battle_action()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
			random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
	self.current_state = self.state.none
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			self.current_state = self.state.none
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.time_passed = 0
					self:cancel_battle_action()
				end
			else
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.follow_time then
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
					else
						self:cancel_battle_action()
					end
				end
			end
		end
	else
		if self.time_passed >= self.rest_time then
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		end
	end
end

	-- return bool

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)

		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 다음액션 진행

	CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonExtensions.SetPositionSkeletonSpace(self.eye_bone, vector(temp.x, temp.z))

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))

	-- first phase shift action
	if self.battle_action_count < 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.downfall_action
		self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
		return
	end

	-- basic flow
	--변경 ver: 화차 > 십자가 > 텔포 > 처형 > 십자가
	local action_idx = self:get_action_idx()
	if action_idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.fire_wheel_action

	elseif action_idx == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.cross_action

	elseif action_idx == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.teleport_action
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_clara_teleport', 'random' }))

	elseif action_idx == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.excution_action

	elseif action_idx == 4 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.cross_action

	elseif action_idx == 5 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.teleport_action

		local can_judge = self:check_judgement()
		if can_judge == true then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_clara_teleport', 'center' }))
		else
			self.battle_action_count = -1
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_clara_teleport', 'random' }))
		end

	elseif action_idx == 6 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.judgement_action
		self.judgement_time_passed = 0
	end

	self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state, nil, true)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:get_action_idx()
	return self.battle_action_count % self.divide_num
end

function local_class:check_judgement()
	if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < self.judgement_hp_ratio then
		return self:check_cooltime()
	end

	local down = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:GetAilmentGauge(CS.Oak.Ailment.Down) / self.ailment_max
	if down >= self.judgement_ailment_ratio then
		return self:check_cooltime()
	end

	local poison = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:GetAilmentGauge(CS.Oak.Ailment.Poison) / self.ailment_max
	if poison >= self.judgement_ailment_ratio then
		return self:check_cooltime()
	end

	local aerial = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:GetAilmentGauge(CS.Oak.Ailment.Aerial) / self.ailment_max
	if aerial >= self.judgement_ailment_ratio then
		return self:check_cooltime()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:check_cooltime()
	return self.judgement_time_passed >= self.judgement_cooltime
end

function local_class:exit()

end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("BossClaraBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c

	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MinRestTime', 0.5)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaxRestTime', 1)

	self.eye_bone = self.character.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation.Skeleton:FindBone('eye_tracking')
	self.eye_tracking_strength = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'EyeTrackingStrength', 1)
	self.max_eye_dir_magnitude = 9
	self.eye_z_offset = 2.5
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return CS.Oak.PartyManager.Instance[0].Leader
end

function local_class:enter()
	local zone_name = self.character.FieldObjectController.Zone
	if zone_name then
		self.zone_bound = field:GetZone(zone_name).Bounds
	else
		self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	end

	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	-- 배틀액션
	self.laser_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossClaraLaser")
	self.chain_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossClaraChain")
	self.stone_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossClaraStone")

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.pattern_state = 0
	self.pattern_flag = nil
	self.rest_time = 0

	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	local action_idx = self:get_action_index()

	if action_idx == 0 then
		-- 정화의 빛
		self.picked_battle_action = self.laser_action
	elseif action_idx == 1 then
		-- 사슬 굴레
		self.picked_battle_action = self.chain_action
	elseif action_idx == 2 then
		-- 염력
		self.picked_battle_action = self.stone_action
	end
end

function local_class:get_action_index()
	if self.pattern_state == 0 then
		self.pattern_state = 1
		return 0
	elseif self.pattern_state == 1 then
		self.pattern_state = 0
		if not self.pattern_flag then
			self.pattern_flag = random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5 and 1 or 2
			return self.pattern_flag
		else
			local next_pattern = self.pattern_flag == 1 and 2 or 1
			self.pattern_flag = nil
			return next_pattern
		end
	end
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self:update_eye_tracking()

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.rest_time > 0 then
		self.rest_time = self.rest_time - dt
		return
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		return
	end

	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 다음액션 진행
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
			if self.min_rest_time >= self.max_rest_time then
				self.rest_time = self.min_rest_time
			else
				self.rest_time = self.min_rest_time + math.random() * (self.max_rest_time - self.min_rest_time)
			end
		end
	else
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, CS.Oak.PartyManager.Instance[0].Leader) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
			self.battle_action_triggered = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_eye_tracking()
	if self.eye_bone == nil then
		return
	end

	local tracking_pos = (CS.Oak.PartyManager.Instance[0].Leader.Position
			- self.character.Position
			- unity_class.vector3.up * self.eye_z_offset) * self.eye_tracking_strength
	local magnitude = tracking_pos.magnitude
	if magnitude > self.max_eye_dir_magnitude then
		tracking_pos = tracking_pos.normalized * self.max_eye_dir_magnitude
	end
	CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonExtensions.SetPositionSkeletonSpace(self.eye_bone, vector(tracking_pos.x, tracking_pos.z))
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()
end

function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
	self.eye_bone = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}
