local local_class = newclass("BossClaymanBattleAIState")

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.rest_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RestDuration', 0.5)
	self.circling_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingDistance', 5)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingSpeedFactor', 1)

	self.phase2_hp_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PhaseHpRatio', 0.6)
	self.blaster_hp_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(params, 'BlasterHpRatio')

	self.demon_blow_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DemonBlowDistance', 3)

	self.state = {
		rest = 1,
		battle = 2,
	}

	self.current_state = self.state.rest
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	local zone = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	self.trick_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossClaymanDemonTrick')
	self.trick_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(zone)

	self.strike_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossClaymanDemonStrike')
	self.strike_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(zone)

	self.blow_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossClaymanDemonBlow')
	self.blow_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(zone)

	self.blaster_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossClaymanDemonBlaster')
	self.blaster_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(zone)

	self.current_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.pattern_idx = {
		blaster = 1,
		strike = 2,
		blow = 3,
		trick = 4,
		distance_condition = 11,
		trick_condition = 12,
		ailment_condition = 13,
	}

	self.battle_action_index_map = {
		[self.pattern_idx.trick] = { action = self.trick_action, get_next_index = self:get_move_target_index_function(self.pattern_idx.strike) },
		[self.pattern_idx.strike] = { action = self.strike_action, get_next_index = self:get_move_target_index_function(self.pattern_idx.distance_condition) },
		[self.pattern_idx.blow] = { action = self.blow_action, get_next_index = self:get_move_target_index_function(self.pattern_idx.distance_condition) },

		[self.pattern_idx.distance_condition] = { get_next_index = self.get_next_idx_by_distance_condition },
		[self.pattern_idx.trick_condition] = { get_next_index = self.get_next_index_by_trick_condition }
	}


	self.battle_action_index_map_phase_2 = {
		[self.pattern_idx.blaster] = { action = self.blaster_action, get_next_index = self:get_move_target_index_function(self.pattern_idx.ailment_condition) },
		[self.pattern_idx.strike] = { action = self.strike_action, get_next_index = self:get_move_target_index_function(self.pattern_idx.blow) },
		[self.pattern_idx.blow] = { action = self.blow_action, get_next_index = self:get_move_target_index_function(self.pattern_idx.distance_condition) },
		[self.pattern_idx.trick] = { action = self.trick_action, get_next_index = self:get_move_target_index_function(self.pattern_idx.strike) },

		[self.pattern_idx.distance_condition] = { get_next_index = self.get_next_idx_by_distance_condition },
		[self.pattern_idx.ailment_condition] = { get_next_index = self.get_next_idx_by_ailment_condition},
		[self.pattern_idx.trick_condition] = { get_next_index = self.get_next_index_by_trick_condition }
	}

	self.phase = {
		one = 1,
		two = 2,
	}
	self:determine_phase()
	self.trick_action.MetaTable:reset_cool_time()

	self.hp_idx = 0
	while self.hp_idx < self.blaster_hp_ratio.Count and self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < self.blaster_hp_ratio[self.hp_idx] do
		self.hp_idx = self.hp_idx + 1
	end
	-- 스테이트 변경
	self:change_state(self.state.rest)
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:determine_phase()
	if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < self.phase2_hp_ratio then
		self.current_phase = self.phase.two
		self.current_index_map = self.battle_action_index_map_phase_2
		self.battle_action_index = self.pattern_idx.distance_condition
		self.current_action_table = self.battle_action_index_map_phase_2[self.battle_action_index]
		self:change_target_with_picked_action()
		self:pick_battle_action()
	else
		self.current_phase = self.phase.one
		self.current_index_map = self.battle_action_index_map
		self.battle_action_index = self.pattern_idx.distance_condition
		self.current_action_table = self.battle_action_index_map[self.battle_action_index]
		self:change_target_with_picked_action()
		self:pick_battle_action()
	end
end

--region next_idx_function
function local_class:get_next_idx_by_distance_condition()
	if vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, self.target.Position) <= self.demon_blow_distance then
		return self.pattern_idx.trick_condition
	else
		return self.pattern_idx.blow
	end
end

function local_class:get_next_idx_by_ailment_condition()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(self.target.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterDownState) then
		return self.pattern_idx.strike
	else
		self.trick_action.MetaTable:reset_cool_time()
		return self.pattern_idx.trick
	end
end

function local_class:get_next_index_by_trick_condition()
	if self:can_trigger_demon_trick() then
		return self.pattern_idx.trick
	else
		return self.pattern_idx.blow
	end
end

function local_class:can_trigger_demon_trick()
	return CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.trick_action, self.target)
end

function local_class:always_true()
	return true
end

function local_class:get_move_target_index_function(target_index)
	return function()
		return target_index
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Info.target) then
		self:handle_damage_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:handle_damage_event(e)
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
		if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < self.phase2_hp_ratio then

			if self.current_action_table ~= nil and self.current_action_table.action ~= nil and CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.current_action_table.action) then
				self.current_action_table.action.MetaTable:force_cancel()
			end

			self.current_phase = self.phase.two
			self.current_index_map = self.battle_action_index_map_phase_2
			self.battle_action_index = self.pattern_idx.blaster
			self.current_action_table = self.battle_action_index_map_phase_2[self.battle_action_index]
			self:change_state(self.state.rest)
			self.time_passed = self.rest_duration + 1
		end
	end

	if self.hp_idx < self.blaster_hp_ratio.Count and not self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < self.blaster_hp_ratio[self.hp_idx] then
			self.hp_idx = self.hp_idx + 1

			if self.current_action_table ~= nil and self.current_action_table.action ~= nil and CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.current_action_table.action) then
				self.current_action_table.action.MetaTable:force_cancel()
			end

			self.current_action_table = self.current_index_map[self.pattern_idx.blaster]
			self:change_state(self.state.rest)
			self.time_passed = self.rest_duration + 1
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(nil)

	self.trick_action = nil
	self.strike_action = nil
	self.blow_action = nil
	self.blaster_action = nil

	self.current_action = nil

	self.battle_action_index_map = nil
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action()

	self.battle_action_index = self.current_action_table.get_next_index(self)
	self.current_action_table = self.current_index_map[self.battle_action_index]

	while self.current_action_table.action == nil do
		self.battle_action_index = self.current_action_table.get_next_index(self)
		self.current_action_table = self.current_index_map[self.battle_action_index]
	end

	self:change_target_with_picked_action()
end

function local_class:change_target_with_picked_action()
	self.target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state)
end

-- 현재 컨트롤 가능 상태인지 여부 파라미터에 추가.
function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	if not can_control then
		return
	end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then
		if self.time_passed > self.rest_duration then
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.current_action_table.action, self.target) then
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.current_action_table.action)
				self:change_state(self.state.battle)
			else
				self:pick_battle_action()
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.current_action_table.action == nil or not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.current_action_table.action) then
			self:pick_battle_action()
			self:change_state(self.state.rest)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0

	if self.current_state == self.state.rest then
		self.cs_state:ChangeState(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
				random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.wave_action = nil
	self.rush_action = nil
	self.eruption_action = nil
	self.matter_action = nil
	self.current_action = nil

	self.battle_action_index_map = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)

	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.flee_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FleeRange', 3.0)
	self.flee_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FleeDuration', 3.0)
	self.rest_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RestDuration', 1.5)

	self.fx_orb_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_companion_light_orb')
	self.fx_orb_contrail_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_companion_light_orb_contrail')
	self.fx_orb_end_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_companion_light_orb_end')

	-- 중보는 몇몇 배틀액션을 스타트만 시킨다. orb의 주도권은 액션에서 따로 update 돌리는 곳에서 가짐
	self.fx_orb = nil
	self.fx_contrail = nil

	self.on_battle_end_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_battle_end_event(e) end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), self.on_battle_end_event_func)
end

function local_class:enter()
	local zone = field:GetZone('s20_boss_battle_1')
	self.zone_bound = zone ~= nil and zone.Bounds or battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)

	self.basic_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossCompanionBasicMissile')
	self.missile_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossCompanionLightMissile')
	self.explosion_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossCompanionLightExplosion')
	self.lightdash_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossCompanionLightDash')

	self.lightdash_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

	local pos = self.character.Position + vector_util.right * 1
	self.fx_orb = self.fx_orb_pool:Instantiate(pos)
	self.fx_contrail = self.fx_orb_contrail_pool:Instantiate(pos, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.fx_orb.transform)

	self.missile_action.MetaTable:set_orb(self.fx_orb, self.fx_contrail)
	self.lightdash_action.MetaTable:set_orb(self.fx_orb, self.fx_contrail)

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.prev_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.action_count = 0
	self.action_amount = 6

	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false

				local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
				if diff <= self.flee_range then
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.flee_range, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false))
				end
			end
			return
		end

		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.battle_action_triggered = true
		end
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.flee_duration then
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	--페이즈 전환중에는 사용하지 않는다.
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.changing then
		return
	end

	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	local phase_action_count = 0
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
		phase_action_count = 5
	else
		if self.is_hidden_boss then
			phase_action_count = 4
		else
			phase_action_count = 3
		end
	end


	if self.current_repeat_count > 0 then -- 특정 배틀 액션의 반복
		self:change_target()
		self.picked_battle_action = self.last_battle_action
		self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count - 1
	else
		local idx = self.battle_action_count % phase_action_count
		if idx == 0 then
			-- 0 번으로 첫 시작시에 판넬 사출
			self:change_target()

			if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase2 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.phase2_panel_action
			else
				if self.is_weakened_panel_action then
					self.picked_battle_action = self.panel_action
				else
					self.picked_battle_action = self.enhance_panel_action
				end
			end
		elseif idx == 1 then
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase2 then
				self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
				self.picked_battle_action = self.phase2_micro_missile_action
			else
				self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchFarthestTarget(self.cs_state, true))
				self.picked_battle_action = self.beam_saber_action
				self.current_repeat_count = self.beam_saber_repeat - 1
			end
		elseif idx == 2 then
			self:change_target()
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase2 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.projectile_action
			else
				if self.is_weakened_micro_missile_action then
					self.picked_battle_action = self.micro_missile_action
				else
					self.picked_battle_action = self.enhance_micro_missile_action
				end
			end

		elseif idx == 3 then
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))

			if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase2 then
				if self.is_hidden_boss then -- 히든보스일 경우에만 액션이 존재 한다
					self.picked_battle_action = self.cross_shot_action
				end
			else
				if self.is_weakened_bomb_painting_action then
					self.picked_battle_action = self.bomb_painting_action
				else
					self.picked_battle_action = self.enhance_bomb_painting_action
				end
			end
		else
			-- 메뉴얼 캐릭터를 대상으로 한다.
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
			if self.is_weakened_laser_action then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.laser_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.enhance_laser_action
			end
		end
	end
end

--지정 시간 도달시 폭격액션 세팅
-- 기존 발동중인 배틀액션 취소하고 넘어감.
function local_class:pick_bombing_action()
	-- 기존 배틀액션 취소
	self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.current_phase = self.phase.changing
	self.picked_battle_action = self.bombing_action
end

-- 페이즈 전환 액션
function local_class:pick_phase_shift_action()

	self.is_first_move_phase2 = true

	self:set_phase2_path()
	self.picked_battle_action = self.phase_shift_action
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.panel_action = nil
	self.enhance_panel_action = nil
	self.beam_saber_action = nil
	self.micro_missile_action = nil
	self.projectile_action = nil
	self.laser_action = nil
	self.bomb_painting_action = nil
	self.enhance_bomb_painting_action = nil

	self.current_phase = nil
	self.phase = nil

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil
	self.current_repeat_count = nil

	self.last_battle_action = nil
	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.real_time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self.real_time_passed = self.real_time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
		self:update_phase1(dt)
	elseif self.current_phase == self.phase.changing then
		self:update_changing(dt)
	elseif self.current_phase == self.phase.phase2 then
		self:update_phase2(dt)
	end

end

function local_class:update_phase1(dt)
	if self.real_time_passed >= self.time_for_phase2 then
		self:pick_bombing_action()
	end
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 cricling로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					if self.current_repeat_count <= 0 then
						self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					else
						self.current_rest_time = 0
					end

					-- 페이즈 1 일때 서클링
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor, true))
				end
			else
				-- 일단 following 중 에어본 걸린 캐릭터가 있다면 제로샷 으로 액션 변경 해준다.
				--아직 배틀액션 시작되지 않았다면
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					if self.current_repeat_count == 0 then
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					end

				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
						if self.current_repeat_count == 0 then
							self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
						end
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
						self.current_repeat_count = 0
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return
	end

	if  CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then

		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true, true, true))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_phase2(dt)
	--페이즈2로 넘어오자마자 위차 잡고 움직이기 전에 배틀액션이 발동하여 캐릭터가 안으로 이동한것으로 보임 Panel_Phase2 에서 이동 부분 확인해야 할것.
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 Idle 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					if self.current_repeat_count <= 0 then
						self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					else
						self.current_rest_time = 0
					end

					-- 페이즈 2 에서 공격 끝나면 추격상태로
					self:set_phase2_path()
					-- 3d 캐릭터가 아니므로 y 앵글은 항상 0 으로 유지한다.
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIOnThePathFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.select_path_queue, false, self.character.Direction, true, self.tracking_speed, 0))
				end
			else
				--첫 위치 이동 끝나지 않았다면 배틀액션 트리거 하지 않음.
				if self.is_first_move_phase2 then

					self.is_first_move_phase2 = false
					local newPos = unity_class.vector3(self.select_path_queue:Peek().x, self.character.Position.y, self.character.Position.z)
					-- 3d 캐릭터가 아니므로 y 앵글은 항상 0 으로 유지한다.
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIEtherealMovePositionSubState.Create(self.cs_state, newPos, self.tracking_speed, 0))
					return
				end
				--아직 배틀액션 시작되지 않았다면
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					if self.current_repeat_count == 0 then
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					end

				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
						if self.current_repeat_count == 0 then
							self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
						end
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
						self.current_repeat_count = 0
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return
	elseif CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIEtherealMovePositionSubState)) then
		if self.cs_state.CurrentState.Done then
			-- 3d 캐릭터가 아니므로 y 앵글은 항상 0 으로 유지한다.
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIOnThePathFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.select_path_queue, false, self.character.Direction, true, self.tracking_speed, 0))
		end
	end

	if  CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIOnThePathFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				--추격중 배틀액션 발통시킬려면 Idle 상태로 이동
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
			end
		end
	end
end

--사용될 패턴 두가지
-- 전멸기 (Bombing), 페이즈 체인지
function local_class:update_changing(dt)
	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_bombing_action()
		end
	else
		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 Idle 변경
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.last_battle_action = self.picked_battle_action
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.current_rest_time = 0

				if self.last_battle_action == self.bombing_action then
					-- 전멸기 사용 끝났으면 페이즈 전환
					self:pick_phase_shift_action()
					--페이즈시프트 액션이 끝났다면 다음 페이즈로
				elseif self.last_battle_action == self.phase_shift_action then
					self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
					self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
					self.battle_action_count = 0
				end

				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
			end
		else
			-- 아직 배틀액션 시작되지 않았다면
			-- 전멸기와 페이즈 전환액션은 발동 실패 없어야 함. hittable 조건도 필요 없으므로 바로 발동 시킴
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
				self.battle_action_count = 0
			end

		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_phase2_path()
	self.select_path_queue:Clear()
	local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir((self.zone_bound.center - self.character.Position))
	local convert_path = nil
	if side_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		for i = 0, self.move_path_right.Count - 1 do
			convert_path = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertToZoneRelativeToWorldToLua(self.zone_bound, self.move_path_right[i])
			self.select_path_queue:Enqueue(convert_path)
		end
	elseif side_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		for i = 0, self.move_path_left.Count - 1 do
			convert_path = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertToZoneRelativeToWorldToLua(self.zone_bound, self.move_path_left[i])
			self.select_path_queue:Enqueue(convert_path)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil

	self.target_hp_ratio = nil
	self.beam_saber_repeat = nil

	self.circling_distance = nil
	self.circling_speed_factor = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass("BossDarkMagicianAIState")

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	-- 배틀 액션 데이터
	self.dark_hand_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianDarkHand")
	self.tomb_shot_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianTombShot")
	self.down_fall_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianDownFall")
	self.hell_ball_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianHellBall")
	self.enhance_dark_hand_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianDarkHand:Enhanced")
	self.enhance_tomb_shot_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianTombShot:Enhanced")
	self.enhance_down_fall_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianDownFall:Enhanced")
	self.phase_shift_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "CommonPhaseShift:DarkMagician")

	--zone 분할해서 teleport할 수 있도록 만들어 줘야됨
	self.teleport_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "CustomTeleport:DarkMagician")

	self.dark_hand_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.down_fall_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.enhance_dark_hand_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.enhance_down_fall_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.tomb_shot_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.enhance_tomb_shot_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)

	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	end

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.random = CS.System.Random()
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0
	self.ready_teleport = false

	-- 순간 이동 위치 결정을 위해 존 미리 9분할 해둠
	local center = battle_zone_bound.center
	local modX = battle_zone_bound.size.x / 3
	local modZ = battle_zone_bound.size.z / 3
	local size = unity_class.vector3(modX, battle_zone_bound.size.y, modZ)

	self.sliced_zone_bounds = {}
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, 0), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, 0), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, -modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, -modZ), size))

	-- 현재 체력에 따라 페이즈 적용해둠
	self.phase = {
		phase1 = 1,
		phase2 = 2
	}

	self.current_phase = self.phase.phase1
	if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100 < self.phase2_hp then
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
	end

	-- 시작 전 스포닝 풀 액션 한번 켜줌 (update caching)
	local spawing_pool = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianSpawningPool")
	CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, spawing_pool)

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:decide_teleport_destination()
	-- 순간이동 위치 결정
	local available_points = {}

	for _, bound in ipairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
		-- 현재 캐릭터의 바운드와 겹치지 않는 곳만 추가
		if not CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(self.character.Bounds, bound) and CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(self.target.Bounds, bound) then
			table.insert(available_points, bound.center)
		end
	end

	local points = random_util.get_values_in_array(available_points, {count = 1})

	if #points > 0 then
		return points[1]
	else
		return self.sliced_zone_bounds[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.sliced_zone_bounds)].center
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	if self.phase_change_reserved == true then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.phase_shift_action
		self:change_target()
		self.phase_change_reserved = false
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
		self.battle_action_count = 0
	elseif self.ready_teleport == true then
		self.teleport_action.MetaTable:set_destination(self:decide_teleport_destination())
		self.picked_battle_action = self.teleport_action
		self:change_target()
	else
		local idx = self.battle_action_count % 6
		if idx == 0 or idx == 3 then
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.tomb_shot_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.enhance_tomb_shot_action
			end
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		elseif idx == 2 then
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.dark_hand_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.enhance_dark_hand_action
			end
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		elseif idx == 1 or idx == 4 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.hell_ball_action
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		elseif idx == 5 then
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.down_fall_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.enhance_down_fall_action
			end

			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil

	self.tomb_shot_action = nil
	self.hell_ball_action = nil
	self.down_fall_action = nil
	self.enhance_dark_hand_action = nil
	self.enhance_tomb_shot_action = nil
	self.enhance_down_fall_action = nil
	self.teleport_action = nil
	self.phase_shift_action = nil

	self.picked_battle_action = nil

	self.time_passed = nil

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
				self.time_passed = 0
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
							random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true

					-- 텔레포트와 페이즈 전환은 카운트 안함.
					if self.picked_battle_action == self.teleport_action then
						self.ready_teleport = false
					elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.phase_shift_action then
						-- 페이즈 전환 이후 카운트 초기화
						self.battle_action_count = 0
						self.ready_teleport = true
					else
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
						-- 헬 볼 이후 (몰락의 시 사용 전)엔 텔레포트 안함.
						if self.picked_battle_action == self.hell_ball_action then
							self.ready_teleport = false
						else
							self.ready_teleport = true
						end

					end
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			end
		end

		return

local local_class = newclass("BossDarkMagicianSingleRaidBattleAIState")

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	-- 기본 구현
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	-- AI 스펙 로드 * 이 시점에서 파싱하고 딕셔너리 굳이 들고 있지 않도록
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 7.0)
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 6.0)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 6.5)
	self.phase2_hp = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Phase2HP", 70)

	self.circling_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingDistance", 3.5)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingSpeed", 0.5)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	-- 배틀 액션 데이터
	self.dark_hand_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianDarkHand:SingleRaid")
	self.tomb_shot_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianTombShot:SingleRaid")
	self.down_fall_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianDownFall:SingleRaid")
	self.hell_ball_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianHellBall:SingleRaid")
	self.enhance_dark_hand_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianDarkHand:SingleRaidEnhanced")
	self.enhance_tomb_shot_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianTombShot:SingleRaidEnhanced")
	self.enhance_down_fall_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianDownFall:SingleRaidEnhanced")
	self.phase_shift_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "CommonPhaseShift:SingleRaidDarkMagician")

	--zone 분할해서 teleport할 수 있도록 만들어 줘야됨
	self.teleport_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "CustomTeleport:SingleRaidDarkMagician")

	self.dark_hand_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.down_fall_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.enhance_dark_hand_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.enhance_down_fall_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.tomb_shot_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.enhance_tomb_shot_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)

	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	end

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.random = CS.System.Random()
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0
	self.ready_teleport = false

	-- 순간 이동 위치 결정을 위해 존 미리 9분할 해둠
	local center = battle_zone_bound.center
	local modX = battle_zone_bound.size.x / 3
	local modZ = battle_zone_bound.size.z / 3
	local size = unity_class.vector3(modX, battle_zone_bound.size.y, modZ)

	self.sliced_zone_bounds = {}
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, 0), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, 0), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(-modX, 0, -modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -modZ), size))
	table.insert(self.sliced_zone_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center + unity_class.vector3(modX, 0, -modZ), size))

	-- 현재 체력에 따라 페이즈 적용해둠
	self.phase = {
		phase1 = 1,
		phase2 = 2
	}

	self.current_phase = self.phase.phase1
	if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100 < self.phase2_hp then
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
	end

	-- 시작 전 스포닝 풀 액션 한번 켜줌 (update caching)
	local spawing_pool = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossDarkMagicianSpawningPool:SingleRaid")
	CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, spawing_pool)

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:decide_teleport_destination()
	-- 순간이동 위치 결정
	local available_points = {}

	for _, bound in ipairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
		-- 현재 캐릭터의 바운드와 겹치지 않는 곳만 추가
		if not CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(self.character.Bounds, bound) and CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(self.target.Bounds, bound) then
			table.insert(available_points, bound.center)
		end
	end

	local points = random_util.get_values_in_array(available_points, {count = 1})

	if #points > 0 then
		return points[1]
	else
		return self.sliced_zone_bounds[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.sliced_zone_bounds)].center
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	if self.phase_change_reserved == true then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.phase_shift_action
		self:change_target()
		self.phase_change_reserved = false
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
		self.battle_action_count = 0
	elseif self.ready_teleport == true then
		self.teleport_action.MetaTable:set_destination(self:decide_teleport_destination())
		self.picked_battle_action = self.teleport_action
		self:change_target()
	else
		local idx = self.battle_action_count % 6
		if idx == 0 or idx == 3 then
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.tomb_shot_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.enhance_tomb_shot_action
			end
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		elseif idx == 2 then
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.dark_hand_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.enhance_dark_hand_action
			end
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		elseif idx == 1 or idx == 4 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.hell_ball_action
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		elseif idx == 5 then
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase1 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.down_fall_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.enhance_down_fall_action
			end

			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	self.sliced_zone_bounds = nil

	self.dark_hand_action = nil
	self.tomb_shot_action = nil
	self.hell_ball_action = nil
	self.down_fall_action = nil
	self.enhance_dark_hand_action = nil
	self.enhance_tomb_shot_action = nil
	self.enhance_down_fall_action = nil
	self.teleport_action = nil
	self.phase_shift_action = nil

	self.random = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
				self.time_passed = 0
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
							random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true

					-- 텔레포트와 페이즈 전환은 카운트 안함.
					if self.picked_battle_action == self.teleport_action then
						self.ready_teleport = false
					elseif self.picked_battle_action == self.phase_shift_action then
						-- 페이즈 전환 이후 카운트 초기화
						self.battle_action_count = 0
						self.ready_teleport = true
					else
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
						-- 헬 볼 이후 (몰락의 시 사용 전)엔 텔레포트 안함.
						if self.picked_battle_action == self.hell_ball_action then
							self.ready_teleport = false
						else
							self.ready_teleport = true
						end

					end
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
						random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
		return false
	end

	if self.phase == nil or self.current_phase ~= self.phase.phase1 then
		return false
	end

	if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100 < self.phase2_hp then
		self.phase_change_reserved = true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil

		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)

local local_class = newclass('BossDreamer1BattleAIState')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	-- near_distance 기준
	self.pattern_flow = {
		none = 1,
		-- 가까울때
		one = 2,
		-- 멀때
		two = 3,
	}

	self.near_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'NearDistance', 3.0)
	self.camera_size = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraSize', 6.0)
	self.camera_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CameraDuration', 1.0)

	-- 드랍메니저에 드랍 안되게 등록
	stage.DropManager:AddToNoDrop(self.character)
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	self.spit_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossDreamerNightmareSpit')
	self.spit2_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossDreamerNightmareGatherSpit')
	self.scratch_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossDreamerTuskScratch')
	self.fog_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossDreamerDreamFog')
	self.falling_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossDreamerFallingStar')
	self.soul_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossDreamerSoulSpawn')
	self.sword_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossDreamerSwordSlash')

	self.scratch_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.fog_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.falling_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.soul_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.prev_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.camera_size, self.camera_duration)
	stage_camera:OverrideDefaultCameraSize(self.camera_size)

	self.time_passed = 0

	self.on_battle_end_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_battle_end_event(e) end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), self.on_battle_end_event_func)

	self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func = function(e)
		self:on_fieldobject_destroyed_event(e) end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func)
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
		self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		return
	end

	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			self.picked_battle_action = nil
			self.battle_action_triggered = false
		end
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
		self.battle_action_triggered = true
		return
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))

	if self.prev_battle_action == nil then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.falling_action
		self.prev_battle_action = self.falling_action
		return
	end

	if self.prev_battle_action == self.falling_action then
		if self:check_closer() then
			self:change_flow(self.pattern_flow.one)
		else
			self:change_flow(self.pattern_flow.two)
		end
	end

	if self.current_flow == self.pattern_flow.one then
		if self.prev_battle_action == self.falling_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.spit_action
		elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.spit_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.scratch_action
		elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.scratch_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.fog_action
		else
			print('### prev action else!!!' .. self.prev_battle_action.HandleName)
		end

	elseif self.current_flow == self.pattern_flow.two then
		if self.prev_battle_action == self.falling_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.spit2_action
		elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.spit2_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.sword_action
		elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.sword_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.fog_action
		else
			print('### prev action else!!!' .. self.prev_battle_action.HandleName)
		end

	else
		if self.prev_battle_action == self.fog_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.soul_action
		elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.soul_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.sword_action
		elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.sword_action then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.falling_action
		else
			print('### prev action else!!!' .. self.prev_battle_action.HandleName)
		end
	end

	-- 꿈 안개 사용시 pattern flow 초기화
	if self.picked_battle_action == self.fog_action then

	self.falling_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossDreamerFallingStar')
	-- 조령
	self.soul_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossDreamerSoulSpawn:Enhanced')
	-- 검 휘두르기
	self.sword_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossDreamerSwordSlash')

		return
	end

	if self.battle_action_triggered then
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then

			self.battle_action_triggered = false

		elseif self.prev_battle_action == self.soul_action then

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		-- 땅에 박히는 ani
		stuck = 2,
		-- 피격 가능
		idle = 3,
		-- 피격 불가
		rise_idle = 4,
		-- 피격 불가 -> 가능 변경 중(피격 불가)
		enter = 5,
		-- 피격 가능 -> 불가 변경 중(피격 가능)
		rise = 6
	}

	self.attackable_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackableDistance', 5.0)
	self.deactive_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DeactiveDuration', 4.0) - 0.05
	self.giant_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'GiantFactor', 0.2)

	self.stuck_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StuckDuration', 0.167)
	self.rise_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RiseDuration', 0.233)
	self.enter_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'EnterDuration', 0.267)

	self.character:SetGiantFactor('BossDreamerMoonstoneGiantFactor', self.giant_factor)

	self.anim_list = {
		['stuck'] = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('stuck', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false),
		['idle'] = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('idle', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true),
		['rise_idle'] = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('rise_idle', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true),
		['enter'] = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('enter', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false),
		['rise'] = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('rise', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, false)}

	self.fx_destroy = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_dreamer_fallingstar_destroy')
	self.fx_enter_end = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_dreamer_fallingstar_end')
	self.fx_rise_end = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_dreamer_fallingstar_end_hold')

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func = function(e)
		self:on_fieldobject_destroyed_event(e) end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func)

	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.deactive_time_passed = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.stuck)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.stuck then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.idle then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.rise_idle then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.enter then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.rise then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_state)

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.stuck then
		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_list['stuck'])
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance

	elseif next_state == self.state.idle then
		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_list['idle'])
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.FieldObjectConstantDamagedBehaviour()

	elseif next_state == self.state.rise_idle then
		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_list['rise_idle'])
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance

	elseif next_state == self.state.enter then
		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_list['enter'])

	elseif next_state == self.state.rise then
		self.character:SetAnimation(self.cs_state, self.anim_list['rise'])

	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none or not can_control then
		return
	end

	self.deactive_time_passed = self.deactive_time_passed + dt
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.deactive_time_passed >= self.deactive_duration then
		self:self_destruction()
		self:change_state(self.state.none)
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.stuck then
		if self.time_passed >= self.stuck_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.idle)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.idle then
		if not self:is_closer() then
			self:change_state(self.state.rise)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.rise_idle then
		if self:is_closer() then
			self:change_state(self.state.enter)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.enter then
		if self.time_passed >= self.enter_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.idle)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.rise then
		if self.time_passed >= self.rise_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.rise_idle)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_closer()
	for _, v in pairs(user_party) do
		local dist = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, v.Position)
		if not character_util.is_dead(v) and dist <= self.attackable_distance then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:self_destruction()
	if character_util.is_dead(self.character) then
		return
	end

	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(CS.Oak.DeathType.None)
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour.PlayDeathSfx = false

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = self.character
	damage_info.damage = 99999
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

	local pos = self.character.Position + vector_util.forward * 0.37
	if self.current_state == self.state.rise_idle or self.current_state == self.state.rise then
		self.fx_rise_end:Instantiate(pos)
	else
		self.fx_enter_end:Instantiate(pos)
	end
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_dreamer_end_01')
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:on_fieldobject_destroyed_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.character) then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Destroyer, self.character) then
		return
	end

	self.fx_destroy:Instantiate(self.character.Position)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_dreamer_destroy_01')
end

function local_class:exit()

end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	if self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func)
		self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_dreamer_clear_action' then
		self:self_destruction()
		self:change_state(self.state.none)
	end
end

	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,

	-- first phase shift action
	if self.battle_action_count < 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.downfall_action
		self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
		return
	end

	-- basic flow
	--변경 ver: 화차 > 십자가 > 텔포 > 처형 > 십자가
	local action_idx = self:get_action_idx()
	if action_idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.fire_wheel_action

	elseif action_idx == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.cross_action

	elseif action_idx == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.teleport_action
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_clara_teleport', 'random' }))

	elseif action_idx == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.excution_action

	elseif action_idx == 4 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.cross_action

	elseif action_idx == 5 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.teleport_action

		local can_judge = self:check_judgement()
		if can_judge == true then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_clara_teleport', 'center' }))
		else
			self.battle_action_count = -1
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'boss_clara_teleport', 'random' }))
		end

	elseif action_idx == 6 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.judgement_action
		self.judgement_time_passed = 0
	end

	self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state, nil, true)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:get_action_idx()
	return self.battle_action_count % self.divide_num
end

function local_class:check_judgement()
	if self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour.HpRatio < self.judgement_hp_ratio then
		return self:check_cooltime()
	end

	local down = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:GetAilmentGauge(CS.Oak.Ailment.Down) / self.ailment_max
	if down >= self.judgement_ailment_ratio then
		return self:check_cooltime()
	end

	local poison = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:GetAilmentGauge(CS.Oak.Ailment.Poison) / self.ailment_max
	if poison >= self.judgement_ailment_ratio then
		return self:check_cooltime()
	end

	local aerial = self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:GetAilmentGauge(CS.Oak.Ailment.Aerial) / self.ailment_max
	if aerial >= self.judgement_ailment_ratio then
		return self:check_cooltime()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:check_cooltime()
	return self.judgement_time_passed >= self.judgement_cooltime
end

function local_class:exit()

end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossFakeGuardianBowBattleAIState')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params_dict = params

	-- Action Spec
	self.max_action_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaxActionRestTime', 2)
	self.min_action_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MinActionRestTime', 1)
	self.max_target_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaxTargetDistance', 5)
	self.charge_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeTime', 2)
	self.base_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'PersistentActionRepeatCount', 3)
	local additional_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'AdditionalActionRepeatCount', 5)
	self.total_repeat_count = self.base_count + additional_count
	local is_penetrating = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsPenetrating', true)
	self.entity_group = is_penetrating and CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None or CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle

	-- Circling Spec
	self.circling_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingRadius', self.max_target_distance)
	self.is_circling_clock_wise = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsCirclingClockWise', true)
	self.circling_change_direction = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingChangeDirection', true)
	self.circling_change_direction_period = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingChangeDirectionPeriod', 3.0)
	self.is_dash_circling = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsDashCircling', true)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingSpeed', 1)
	self.circling_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingTime', 3)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_activate = false

	if self.repeat_count > 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.persistent_action
		self.repeat_count = self.repeat_count - 1
		self.is_persistent = true
		-- FIXME : 파티원 npc로 컨버팅시 배틀 매니저/인스턴스에 파티탈되하는 로직이 없음, 추후 기능 추가될 경우 복구 고려할 것
		self:change_target(true)
	else
		self.picked_battle_action = self.trigger_action
		self.repeat_count = self.total_repeat_count
		self.is_persistent = false
		self:change_target(true)
	end
end

function local_class:change_target(force_manual)
	local new_target = nil
	if force_manual ~= nil and force_manual then
		local manual_targets = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchManualCharacterTargets(self.cs_state)
		if manual_targets ~= nil and manual_targets.Count > 0 then
			new_target = manual_targets[0]
		end
		manual_targets:Dispose()

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end
	end

	if new_target == nil then
		new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchClosestTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end
	end

	if new_target ~= nil then
		self.target = new_target

		local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
		command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	local actions = self.character.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions

	local trigger_type = typeof(CS.Oak.ITriggerBattleAction)
	local persistent_type = typeof(CS.Oak.IPersistentBattleAction)

	for i = 0, actions.Count - 1 do
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(actions[i], trigger_type) then
			self.trigger_action = actions[i]
		elseif CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(actions[i], persistent_type) then
			self.persistent_action = actions[i]
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.repeat_count = self.base_count
	self:change_state_to_circling()
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.picked_battle_action ~= nil and self.is_persistent then
		-- persistent 액션 강제 종료
		self.character.CharacterBehaviour:EndBattleAction(self.picked_battle_action)
	end
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.is_persistent = nil

	self.time_passed = nil
	self.repeat_count = nil
	self.action_rest_time = nil

	self.trigger_action = nil
	self.persistent_action = nil
	self:change_state(nil)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_state_to_circling()
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_radius,
			self.is_circling_clock_wise, self.circling_change_direction,
			self.circling_change_direction_period, self.is_dash_circling, self.circling_speed_factor))
end

function local_class:change_state_to_threaten()
	self.action_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_action_rest_time, self.max_action_rest_time)
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIThreatenSubState.Create(self.cs_state))
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	-- Threaten, 일정시간동안 대기
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIThreatenSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed > self.action_rest_time then
			self:change_state_to_circling()
		end
		return
	end

	-- Circling, 배틀액션은 이 시점에서 사용시도
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		end

		if self.battle_action_activate then
			if self:end_battle_action() then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self:change_state_to_threaten()
			end
		else
			if self:begin_battle_action() then
				self.battle_action_activate = true
				self.time_passed = 0
			elseif self.time_passed > self.circling_time then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self:change_state_to_threaten()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:begin_battle_action()
	if self.is_persistent then
		-- 공격 가능한지 체크 후 지속형 배틀액션 시작
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target)
				and battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, self.target) < self.max_target_distance
				and not CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.IsProjectileBlockedBetween(self.character, self.target, self.entity_group) then
			self.character.CharacterBehaviour:BeginBattleAction(self.picked_battle_action)
			return true
		end
	else
		-- 공격 가능한지 체크 후 배틀액션 실행
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:end_battle_action()
	if self.is_persistent then
		-- 지속형 배틀액션 유지시간이 지난경우 액션 종료 및 선택된 액션 초기화
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			return true
		elseif self.time_passed > self.charge_time then
			self.character.CharacterBehaviour:EndBattleAction(self.picked_battle_action)
			return true
		end
	else
		-- 배틀액션이 끝났으면 선택된 액션 초기화
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Action Spec 해제
	self.max_action_rest_time = nil
	self.min_action_rest_time = nil
	self.max_target_distance = nil
	self.charge_time = nil
	self.base_count = nil
	self.total_repeat_count = nil
	self.entity_group = nil

	-- Circling Spec 해제
	self.circling_radius = nil
	self.is_circling_clock_wise = nil
	self.circling_change_direction = nil
	self.circling_change_direction_period = nil
	self.is_dash_circling = nil
	self.circling_speed_factor = nil
	self.circling_time = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	-- 기본 구현

function local_class:change_target(target)

		end

		self.target = target

		self.picked_battle_action = self.stinger_action
		--self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	elseif self.current_battle_index == 4 then
		--선더차지 : 타겟은 전제 플레이어 AI 및 매뉴얼 캐릭터 쪽으로 N 회차 돌진 하도록 한다.
		-- 낙뢰 2회 맞으면 에어본
		-- 돌진 맞으면 돌진방향으로 넉백
		-- 돌진하는 최종 위치에 낙뢰
		self.picked_battle_action = self.thunder_charge_action
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))

function local_class:exit()

	self.slash_action = nil
	self.back_slash_action = nil
	self.shield_bash_action = nil
	self.stinger_action = nil
	self.thunder_charge_action = nil

	self.random = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil
	self.combo_1 = nil
	self.combo_2 = nil

	self.current_battle_index = nil
	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					--콤보 액션 종료하고 다음 액션으로 넘어감
					if self.current_battle_index == self.combo_1 or self.current_battle_index >= self.combo_2 then
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
						self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
					else -- 지정된 콤보 액션 실행하기 위해 Circling으로 넘기지 않고 바로 다음 액션으로 넘어갈수 있도록 한다.
						self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
						if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
							self.battle_action_triggered = true
							self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
						end
					end
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
