local local_class = newclass("BossFakeGuardianTwohandBattleAIState")

function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	-- 기본 구현
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	-- AI 스펙 로드 * 이 시점에서 파싱하고 딕셔너리 굳이 들고 있지 않도록
	self.max_follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "FollowTime", 7.0)
	self.initial_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "InitialRestTime", 0.8)
	self.min_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MinRestTime", 6.0)
	self.max_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MaxRestTime", 6.5)

	self.circling_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingDistance", 3.5)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "CirclingSpeed", 7)

	self.runaway_chance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RunawayChance", 0.7)
	self.runaway_action_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RunawayActionRadius", 2)

	-- Twohand Combo 사용여부 바리에이션
	self.use_twohand_combo = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "UseTwohandCombo", true)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	-- 배틀 액션 데이터
	if self.use_twohand_combo == true then
		self.twohand_combo_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossFakeGuardianTwohandCombo")
		self.twohand_combo_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	end

	self.runaway_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "CommonRunaway:FakeGuardianTwohand")
	self.runaway_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)

	self.slash_combo_action_list = {
		CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "TwohandSlash:Knight"),
		CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "TwohandBackSlash:Knight"),
		CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "TwohandStomp:Knight"),
	}
	self.combo_max_count = 3
	self.slash_combo_count = 0
	self.is_combo_action = false
	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0

	self.is_runaway_action = false

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:decide_teleport_destination()
	-- 순간이동 위치 결정
	local available_points = {}

	for _, bound in ipairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
		-- 현재 캐릭터의 바운드와 겹치지 않는 곳만 추가
		if not CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(self.character.Bounds, bound) and CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(self.target.Bounds, bound) then
			table.insert(available_points, bound.center)
		end
	end

	local points = random_util.get_values_in_array(available_points, {count = 1})

	if #points > 0 then
		return points[1]
	else
		return self.sliced_zone_bounds[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.sliced_zone_bounds)].center
	end
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 2
	if idx == 0 or self.use_twohand_combo == false then
		self.slash_combo_count = 1
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_combo_action_list[self.slash_combo_count]
		self.is_combo_action = true
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
	elseif idx == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.twohand_combo_action
	end

	self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	self.is_runaway_action = false
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	self.slash_combo_action = nil
	self.stomp_action = nil
	self.dark_ball_action = nil
	self.charge_slash_action = nil
	self.enhanced_dark_ball_action = nil
	self.enhanced_charge_action = nil
	self.phase_shift_action = nil

	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState))
	or CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
				self.time_passed = 0
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					if self.is_combo_action then
						if self.slash_combo_count < self.combo_max_count then
							self.slash_combo_count = self.slash_combo_count + 1
							self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_combo_action_list[self.slash_combo_count]
							if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
								self.battle_action_triggered = true
							end
						else
							self:check_sub_state()
						end
					else
						self:check_sub_state()
					end
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				if self.is_combo_action then
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
				else
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
							random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
				end
			end
		else
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:check_sub_state()
	local chance = unity_class.random.value
	--반경2내에 wall이 있을경우 100% 발동
	if self:check_battle_zone_for_runaway() and not self.is_runaway_action then
		self:runaway_action_triggered()
	elseif chance < self.runaway_chance and not self.is_runaway_action then
		--확률로 회피
		self:runaway_action_triggered()
	else
		--아닐 경우 일반 서클링 스테이트
		self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
				random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
		self.is_combo_action = false
		self.picked_battle_action = nil
		self.battle_action_triggered = false
	end
end

function local_class:runaway_action_triggered()
	self.picked_battle_action = self.runaway_action
	-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
	CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action)
	self.battle_action_triggered = true
	self.is_runaway_action = true
end

function local_class:check_battle_zone_for_runaway()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.runaway_action_radius)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
			return true
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossFakeGuardianBowBattleAIState')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo
	self.params_dict = params

	if self.current_phase == nil then
		self.current_phase = 1
	end
	-- Action Spec
	self.max_action_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaxActionRestTime', 2)
	self.min_action_rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MinActionRestTime', 1)
	self.max_target_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MaxTargetDistance', 5)
	self.charge_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeTime', 2)
	self.base_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'PersistentActionRepeatCount', 3)
	local additional_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'AdditionalActionRepeatCount', 5)
	self.total_repeat_count = self.base_count + additional_count
	local is_penetrating = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsPenetrating', true)
	self.entity_group = is_penetrating and CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None or CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle

	-- Circling Spec
	self.circling_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingRadius', self.max_target_distance)
	self.is_circling_clock_wise = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsCirclingClockWise', true)
	self.circling_change_direction = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingChangeDirection', true)
	self.circling_change_direction_period = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingChangeDirectionPeriod', 3.0)
	self.is_dash_circling = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsDashCircling', true)
	self.circling_speed_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingSpeed', 1)
	self.circling_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CirclingTime', 3)

	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create()
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.None

	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_activate = false

	if self.repeat_count > 0 or self.current_phase == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.persistent_action
		self.repeat_count = self.repeat_count - 1
		self.is_persistent = true
		-- FIXME : 파티원 npc로 컨버팅시 배틀 매니저/인스턴스에 파티탈되하는 로직이 없음, 추후 기능 추가될 경우 복구 고려할 것
		self:change_target(true)
	else
		if self.current_phase == 2 then
			self.repeat_count = self.total_repeat_count
			self.picked_battle_action = self.cube_minor_action
			self.is_persistent = false
		elseif self.current_phase == 3 then
			if self.is_persistent then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.thunder_action
				self.is_persistent = false
			else
				self.repeat_count = self.total_repeat_count
				self.picked_battle_action = self.cube_action
				self.is_persistent = false
			end
		end

		self:change_target(true)
	end
end

function local_class:change_target(force_manual)
	local new_target = nil
	if force_manual ~= nil and force_manual then
		local manual_targets = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchManualCharacterTargets(self.cs_state)
		if manual_targets ~= nil and manual_targets.Count > 0 then
			new_target = manual_targets[0]
		end
		manual_targets:Dispose()

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end
	end

	if new_target == nil then
		new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchClosestTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end
	end

	if new_target ~= nil then
		self.target = new_target

		local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
		command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	end
end

function local_class:enter()

	local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if battle_zone_bound == nil then
		battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	self.persistent_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "ManualChargeBow")

	self.thunder_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossFakeKnightThunder")
	self.thunder_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.cube_minor_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossFakeGuardianLaserCube:FakeKnight")
	self.cube_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossFakeGuardianLaserCube")

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.repeat_count = self.base_count
	self:change_state_to_circling()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'phase_request'}))
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.picked_battle_action ~= nil and self.is_persistent then
		-- persistent 액션 강제 종료
		self.character.CharacterBehaviour:EndBattleAction(self.picked_battle_action)
	end
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.is_persistent = nil

	self.time_passed = nil
	self.repeat_count = nil
	self.action_rest_time = nil

	self.trigger_action = nil
	self.persistent_action = nil
	self:change_state(nil)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_state_to_circling()
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_radius,
		self.is_circling_clock_wise, self.circling_change_direction,
		self.circling_change_direction_period, self.is_dash_circling, self.circling_speed_factor))
end

function local_class:change_state_to_threaten()
	self.action_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_action_rest_time, self.max_action_rest_time)
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIThreatenSubState.Create(self.cs_state))
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	-- Threaten, 일정시간동안 대기
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIThreatenSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed > self.action_rest_time then
			self:change_state_to_circling()
		end
		return
	end

	-- Circling, 배틀액션은 이 시점에서 사용시도
	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		end

		if self.battle_action_activate then
			if self:end_battle_action() then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self:change_state_to_threaten()
			end
		else
			if self:begin_battle_action() then
				self.battle_action_activate = true
				self.time_passed = 0
			elseif self.time_passed > self.circling_time then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self:change_state_to_threaten()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:begin_battle_action()
	if self.is_persistent then
		-- 공격 가능한지 체크 후 지속형 배틀액션 시작
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target)
			and battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, self.target) < self.max_target_distance
			and not CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.IsProjectileBlockedBetween(self.character, self.target, self.entity_group) then
			self.character.CharacterBehaviour:BeginBattleAction(self.picked_battle_action)
			return true
		end
	else
		-- 공격 가능한지 체크 후 배틀액션 실행
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:end_battle_action()
	if self.is_persistent then
		-- 지속형 배틀액션 유지시간이 지난경우 액션 종료 및 선택된 액션 초기화
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			return true
		elseif self.time_passed > self.charge_time then
			self.character.CharacterBehaviour:EndBattleAction(self.picked_battle_action)
			return true
		end
	else
		-- 배틀액션이 끝났으면 선택된 액션 초기화
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'phase_increase' then
		self.current_phase = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
		self.character.CharacterBehaviour:EndBattleAction(self.persistent_action)

		if self.character.DamagedBehaviour ~= CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance then
			self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
		end
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(self.character))
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'phase_start' then
		self.current_phase = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))

		if self.current_phase == 3 then
			self.repeat_count = 0
			self.is_persistent = true
		else
			self.repeat_count = self.total_repeat_count
		end

		self.time_passed = 0
		self.picked_battle_action = nil
		self:change_state_to_circling()
	end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()

	self.current_battle_index = self.battle_action_count % self:get_max_battle_action_count()

	if self.current_battle_index == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action

		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	elseif self.current_battle_index == 3 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.stinger_action
	elseif self.current_battle_index == 4 then

		if self.current_phase == 2 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
		else

		end

	self.combo_2 = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					--콤보 액션 종료하고 다음 액션으로 넘어감
					if self.current_battle_index == self.combo_1 or self.current_battle_index >= self.combo_2 then
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
						self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
					else -- 지정된 콤보 액션 실행하기 위해 Circling으로 넘기지 않고 바로 다음 액션으로 넘어갈수 있도록 한다.
						self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
						if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
							self.battle_action_triggered = true
							self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
						end
					end
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
						self.battle_action_triggered = true
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					else
						-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
						self.picked_battle_action = nil
						self.battle_action_triggered = false
						-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'phase_increase' then
		self.current_phase = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

		if self.character.DamagedBehaviour ~= CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance then
			self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
		end

		self:change_state(CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(self.character))
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'phase_start' then
		self.current_phase = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		if self.current_phase == 3 then
			self.current_battle_index = 4
		else
			self.current_battle_index = 0
		end

		self.picked_battle_action = nil
		self.time_passed = 0
		self.battle_action_triggered = false
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil

	self.circling_distance = nil
	self.circling_speed_factor = nil

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
end

return {

		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,

							self.picked_battle_action = self.phase_data_group[self.current_phase].slash_combo_action_list[self.slash_combo_count]
							if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
								self.battle_action_triggered = true
							end
						else
							self:check_sub_state()
						end
					else
						self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
					end
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
						self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()

			if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
				if self.is_combo_action then
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
				else
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
							random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
				end
			end
		else
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:check_sub_state()
	--반경2내에 wall이 있을경우 100% 발동
	if self:check_battle_zone_for_runaway() and not self.is_runaway_action then
		self:runaway_action_triggered()
	elseif not self.is_runaway_action then
		self:runaway_action_triggered()
	else
		--아닐 경우 일반 서클링 스테이트
		self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
				random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
		self.is_combo_action = false
		self.picked_battle_action = nil
		self.battle_action_triggered = false
	end
end

function local_class:runaway_action_triggered()
	self.picked_battle_action = self.runaway_action
	-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
	CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action)
	self.battle_action_triggered = true
	self.is_runaway_action = true
end

function local_class:check_battle_zone_for_runaway()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.runaway_action_radius)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
			return true
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'phase_increase' then
		self.current_phase = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

		if self.character.DamagedBehaviour ~= CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance then
			self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
		end
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(self.character))
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'phase_start' then
		self.current_phase = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		if self.current_phase == 3 then
			self.battle_action_count = 1
		else
			self.battle_action_count = 0
		end

		self.picked_battle_action = nil
		self.battle_action_triggered = false
		self.is_combo_action = false
		self.time_passed = 0
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossFallenQueen2PhaseBattleAIState')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	self.cs_state = cs_state
	self.character = c
	self.target = fo

	self.control_state = {
		none = 1,
		rest = 2,
		follow = 3,
		position = 4,
		wait_action = 5
	}

	self.follow_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FollowTime', 6.0)
	self.rest_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RestTime', 1.0)
	self.positioning_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PositioningSpeed', 10)

	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	self.collision_mask = entity_group_extension.CollisionMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.character.EntityGroup)]
end

function local_class:get_target()
	return self.target
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 배틀 존 크기 가져 오기
	self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
	if self.zone_bound == nil then
		self.zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3(10, 5, 10))
	end

	-- 배틀액션
	self.orb_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossFallenQueenSpellBlade')
	self.blast_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossFallenQueenRadiantBlast')
	self.rush_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossFallenQueenRush')
	self.nova_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossFallenQueenSuperNova')
	self.wave_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossFallenQueenBladeWave')
	self.cleave_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'BossFallenQueenCleaveEnhanced')
	self.teleport_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, 'CustomTeleport:FallenQueen')

	self.orb_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.cleave_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.nova_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.wave_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)
	self.rush_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(self.zone_bound)

	local start_pos = self.zone_bound.center + self.orb_action.MetaTable:get_start_position_offset()
	start_pos.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(start_pos):GetHeightAt(start_pos)
	self.orb_action_start_position = start_pos
	start_pos = self.zone_bound.center
	start_pos.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(start_pos):GetHeightAt(start_pos)
	self.wave_action_start_position = start_pos
	self.cleave_action_start_position = start_pos

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_index = 0
	self.battle_action_flag = false
	self.is_active_resist = false

	local zone = battle_util.get_zone(self.character.Position)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {
		'init_bead_controller',
		self.character.Name,
		-- 존도 여기서 찾아서 세팅하도록 함.
		zone.Name,
		'phase2'
	}))

	self:change_control_state(self.control_state.rest)
end

function local_class:change_control_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_control_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_control_state == self.control_state.wait_action then
		self:reset_ailment()
	end

	if next_state == self.control_state.rest then
		self.picked_battle_action = nil

		if self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			character_util.set_direction(self.character, 'down')
		end
		self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
	elseif next_state == self.control_state.follow then
		if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, false))
		else
			self:change_control_state(self.control_state.rest)
			return
		end
	elseif next_state == self.control_state.position then
	elseif next_state == self.control_state.wait_action then
		local battle_action = self.next_battle_action and self.next_battle_action or self.picked_battle_action
		if battle_action == self.cleave_action or
				battle_action == self.orb_action or
				battle_action == self.nova_action then
			self:set_ailment_resist()
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_control_state = next_state
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_control_state()
	self:change_state()

	-- 소환되어있는 구슬 전체 해제 이벤트 보낼것.
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {
		'dispose_bead_controller'
	}))

	self.slash_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
	self.fireball_action = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil

	-- 배틀액션
	self.orb_action = nil
	self.blast_action = nil
	self.rush_action = nil
	self.nova_action = nil
	self.wave_action = nil
	self.cleave_action = nil
	self.teleport_action = nil
end

-- 상태이상 면역 추가
function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun | CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state, options)
	self.is_active_resist = true
end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	if not self.is_active_resist then
		return
	end
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_state)
	self.is_active_resist = false
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

-- 배틀 액션 베이스 타겟 전환
function local_class:change_target_with_picked_action()
	local target

	-- 매뉴얼 캐릭터 대상 배틀 액션
	if self.picked_battle_action == self.orb_action or self.picked_battle_action == self.rush_action or self.picked_battle_action == self.cleave_action or
			self.picked_battle_action == self.nova_action or self.picked_battle_action == self.blast_action then
		target = CS.Oak.PartyManager.Instance.UserParty.Leader
	end

	self:change_target(target)
end

-- 타겟 전환
function local_class:change_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:teleport_for_battle_action(battle_action, pos)
	if self.current_control_state == self.control_state.wait_action then
		return
	end

	self.teleport_action.MetaTable:set_destination(pos)
	CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.teleport_action)
	self:change_control_state(self.control_state.wait_action)
	self.picked_battle_action = self.teleport_action
	self.next_battle_action = battle_action
end

-- 배틀액션 선택 및 타겟 변경
function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target(index)
	if index then
		self.battle_action_index = index
	end

	local teleport_flag
	self.action_start_position = nil

	if self.battle_action_index == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.blast_action -- 징벌
		self.battle_action_index = 1
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 1 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.orb_action -- 칼날비
		self.action_start_position = self.orb_action_start_position
		teleport_flag = true
		self.battle_action_index = 2
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 2 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.nova_action -- 원기옥
		self.battle_action_index = 3
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 3 then
		self.battle_action_flag = not self.battle_action_flag
		if self.battle_action_flag then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.rush_action -- 영혼 돌진
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.wave_action -- 칼날 파도
			self.action_start_position = self.wave_action_start_position
			teleport_flag = true
		end
		self.battle_action_index = 4
	elseif self.battle_action_index == 4 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.cleave_action -- 전멸기
		self.action_start_position = self.cleave_action_start_position
		teleport_flag = true
		self.battle_action_index = 0
	end

	self:change_target_with_picked_action()

	if self.action_start_position then
		if teleport_flag then
			self:teleport_for_battle_action(self.picked_battle_action, self.action_start_position)
		else
			self:change_control_state(self.control_state.position)
		end
	else
		self:change_control_state(self.control_state.follow)
	end
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.current_control_state == self.control_state.rest then
		if self.time_passed >= self.rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		end
	elseif self.current_control_state == self.control_state.follow then
		if not self.picked_battle_action then
			self.time_passed = dt
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			return
		end

		-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
		-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
			-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
			self:change_control_state(self.control_state.wait_action)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.follow_time then
			-- 시간 초과 시 강제 트리거 시도
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				self:change_control_state(self.control_state.wait_action)
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_control_state == self.control_state.position then
		if not self.orb_action_start_position then
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				self:change_control_state(self.control_state.wait_action)
			else
				self:change_control_state(self.control_state.rest)
			end
		else
			local diff = (self.orb_action_start_position - self.character.Position):GetX0z()
			local dist = diff.magnitude
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(dist) then
				self.action_start_position = nil
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					self:change_control_state(self.control_state.wait_action)
				else
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self:change_control_state(self.control_state.follow)
				end
				return
			end
			local dir = diff.normalized
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = dir
			move_info.magnitude = math.min(dist, dt * self.positioning_speed)

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(dir),
					false, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.None, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
		end
	elseif self.current_control_state == self.control_state.wait_action then
		-- 사용한 배틀 액션 끝남
		if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
			if not self.next_battle_action then
				self:change_control_state(self.control_state.rest)
			else
				-- 바로 다음 배틀 액션 사용
				self.picked_battle_action = self.next_battle_action
				self.next_battle_action = nil
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
		if self.current_control_state == self.control_state.position then
			self:teleport_for_battle_action(self.picked_battle_action, self.orb_action_start_position)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'remove_fury' then
			self:reset_ailment()
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.collision_mask = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()

	--test
	--self.picked_battle_action = self.smash_action
	--local idx = self.battle_action_count % 2

	--	self.picked_battle_action = self.wave_action

	--elseif idx == 1 then
	--	self.picked_battle_action = self.cleave_action
	--	self:change_target()
	--end

	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 10

	if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.wheel_action
	elseif idx == 1 or idx == 6 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.meteor_action
		self:set_ailment_resist(self.picked_battle_action)
	elseif idx == 2 or idx == 7 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.shield_action
		self:set_ailment_resist(self.picked_battle_action)
	elseif idx == 3 or idx == 8 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.wave_action
	elseif idx == 4 or idx == 9 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.cleave_action
		self:set_ailment_resist(self.picked_battle_action)
	elseif idx == 5 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.smash_action
	end

	self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))

	self.time_passed = 0
end

-- 상태이상 면역 추가
function local_class:set_ailment_resist(action)
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun | CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(action, options)
	self.is_active_resist = true
end
-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment(action)
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(action)
	self.is_active_resist = false
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					if self.is_active_resist and self.picked_battle_action ~= nil and self.picked_battle_action ~= self.shield_action then
						self:reset_ailment(self.picked_battle_action)
					end

					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					if self.is_active_resist and self.picked_battle_action ~= nil and self.picked_battle_action ~= self.shield_action then
						self:reset_ailment(self.picked_battle_action)
					end
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

	if self.coop_expedition_season == 1 then

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	--페이즈 전환 우선
	if self.phase_change_reserved == true then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.phase_shift_action
		self:change_target()
		self.phase_change_reserved = false
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
		self.battle_action_count = 0
	else
		local idx = self.battle_action_count % 4

		if idx == 0 then
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase2 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.enhance_fireball_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.fireball_action
			end
			self:change_target()
		elseif idx == 1 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.slash_action
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))


		elseif idx == 2 then
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase2 and self.current_pattern_route == self.pattern_route.soul_bead then
				self.current_pattern_route = self.pattern_route.spirit
				self.picked_battle_action = self.soul_bead_action
			elseif self.current_phase == self.phase.phase2 then
				self.current_pattern_route = self.pattern_route.soul_bead
				self.picked_battle_action = self.spirit_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.spirit_action
			end
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		else
			--if idx == 3
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase2 then
				self.picked_battle_action = self.enhance_charge_action
			else
				self.picked_battle_action = self.charge_action
			end
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		end
	end

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	self.slash_action = nil
	self.bomb_action = nil
	self.charge_action = nil
	self.fireball_action = nil

	self.random = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
				end

				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then

			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:change_target(target)

		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	end

	for _,v in pairs(self.battle_action_list) do
		v = nil
	end
	self.battle_action_list = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
	end

	if self.target == nil then
		return
	end

	--TOOD:메뉴얼캐릭 또는 존외곽과의 거리에 따른 행동 결정정
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
				self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.check_position then
		self:update_state()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.battle then
		if self.battle_action_triggered then
			-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 거리 파악해서 다음행동 이행
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
				self.current_state = self.state.check_position
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance, random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, false, self.circling_speed_factor))
			end
		else
			-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
			-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
			if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
					CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
				-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
				self.battle_action_triggered = true
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
				-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
				self.picked_battle_action = nil
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
		if self.runaway_time_passed > self.run_max_time then
			self.current_state = self.state.none
			self.runaway_time_passed = 0
		else
			self.runaway_time_passed = self.runaway_time_passed + dt
		end

		--이동하면서 거리유지
		if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then
			if not self:is_come_close_target() then
				self:update_state()
			end
		else
			self:change_state(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, self.circling_distance,
					random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, false, 0, true, self.circling_speed))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_state()
	--타겟 거리에 따른 state설정
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if math.abs(diff) < self.battle_distance then
		self.current_state = self.state.move
	else
		self.current_state = self.state.none
	end

	if self.current_state ~= self.state.move then
		self.runaway_time_passed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:is_come_close_target()
	local diff = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).magnitude
	if math.abs(diff) < self.battle_distance then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:check_battle_zone_for_runaway()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.wall_distance)
	for _,fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not self.is_start_absolute_zero and self.current_action_flow == self.action_flow.type_a then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
			if character_util.get_hp_ratio(self.character) < self.absolute_zero_hp then
				self.battle_action_triggered = false
				self.character.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:SendSync(self.character, CS.Oak.CharacterAilmentResetEvent.Instance)
				buff_util.cure_all_debuffs(self.character, self.character)
				self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state, true))
				self.picked_battle_action = self.battle_action_list[self.action_type.absolute_zero]
				self.battle_action_count = 4
				self.current_state = self.state.battle
				self.is_start_absolute_zero = true
				self.time_passed = 0
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}

					if self.picked_battle_action == self.teleport_action then

						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1

					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					-- 못쓰는 액션 계속 반복 시도하는 상황 제거하기 위해 넘기기
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			end
		end

	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) or
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AICirclingSubState)) then

			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
			end
		end

		return
	end

	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
end

		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)

	-- 배틀 액션 데이터
	self.acid_shot_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossGraboidAcidShotEnhanced:SingleRaid")
	self.spin_spray_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossGraboidSpinSpray:SingleRaid")
	self.spin_charge_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossGraboidSpinChargeEnhanced:SingleRaid")
	self.sudden_attack_action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.character, "BossGraboidSuddenAttack:SingleRaid")

	self.acid_shot_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.spin_spray_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)
	self.spin_charge_action.MetaTable:set_battle_zone(battle_zone_bound)

	self.on_damage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)

	-- 내부 변수 초기화
	self.random = CS.System.Random()
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = false
	self.battle_action_count = 0

	local current_hp_percentage = self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP / self.character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 100
	if current_hp_percentage <= self.phase2_hp then
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase2
	else
		self.current_phase = self.phase.phase1
	end

	-- 스테이트 변경
	self.current_rest_time = self.initial_rest_time
	self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
end

-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cs_state:ChangeState(next_state)
end

function local_class:change_target(target)
	if target ~= nil then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = target
	else
		local new_target = CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchTarget(self.cs_state)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, new_target) then
			return
		end

		self.target = new_target
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.ChangeTargetCommand.Create(self.character, self.target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
end

function local_class:handle_request()
	if self.current_request == self.request.change_phase2 then
		if self.current_phase ~= self.phase.phase2 then
			self:change_phase(self.phase.phase2)
		end
	end
	self.current_request = nil
end

function local_class:pick_battle_action_and_target()
	self.battle_action_triggered = false

	local idx = self.battle_action_count % 6

	if idx == 1 or idx == 4 then
		self.rand = math.random(2)
		self.picked_battle_action = self.acid_shot_action
		self:change_target()
	elseif idx == 2 or idx == 3 or idx == 5 then
		if self.rand == 1 then
			self.picked_battle_action = self.spin_spray_action
			self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
		else
			self.picked_battle_action = self.spin_charge_action
			self:change_target()
		end
		self.rand = self.rand % 2 + 1
	else -- if idx == 0 then
		self.picked_battle_action = self.sudden_attack_action
		self:change_target(CS.Oak.IBattleAIStateExtensions.SearchRandomManualTarget(self.cs_state))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_state()

	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	self.acid_shot_action = nil
	self.spin_spray_action = nil
	self.spin_charge_action = nil
	self.sudden_attack_action = nil

	self.random = nil
	self.picked_battle_action = nil
	self.battle_action_triggered = nil
	self.battle_action_count = nil

	self.current_rest_time = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt, can_control)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not can_control then
		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIFollowingSubState)) then
		if self.picked_battle_action == nil then
			-- 배틀액션 선택 안 상태로 넘어오거나, 배틀액션 못쓰고 시간 초과했을때 처리
			self.time_passed = 0
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
		else
			if self.battle_action_triggered then
				-- 사용한 배틀액션 끝났다면 idle로 변경
				if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsActive(self.picked_battle_action) then
					if self.current_request ~= nil then
						self:handle_request()
					end
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.current_rest_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.min_rest_time, self.max_rest_time)
					self:change_state(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState.Instance)
				end
			else
				-- 공격 가능 체크를 먼저 한다. (상태이상 등으로 배틀액션 트리거 못하고 time_passed가 지났을 수도 있음)
				-- 이럴때 배틀액션 못쓰고 넘어가기보다 쓰고 넘어가는게 좋다.
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.BattleActionIsHittable(self.picked_battle_action, self.target) and
						CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TriggerBattleAction(self.character, self.picked_battle_action) then
					-- 배틀 액션 발동 처리
					self.battle_action_triggered = true
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				elseif self.time_passed >= self.max_follow_time then
					-- 시간 내에 배틀 액션 발동 실패 시 처리 - nil로 비우고 에러 핸들링 루틴 타게 한다.
					self.picked_battle_action = nil
					self.battle_action_triggered = false
					self.battle_action_count = self.battle_action_count + 1
				end
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(self.cs_state.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.AIIdleSubState)) then
		if self.time_passed >= self.current_rest_time then
			self:pick_battle_action_and_target()
			if self.target ~= nil then
				self:change_state(CS.Oak.AINormalFollowingSubState.Create(self.cs_state, true))
			end
		end

		return
	end
end

function local_class:change_phase(phase)
	self.battle_action_count = 0
	self.current_phase = phase
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_phase == self.phase.phase2 or self.current_request ~= nil then
		return false
	end

	local current_hp_percentage = e.Info.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100
	if current_hp_percentage > self.phase2_hp then
		return false
	end

	self:change_phase(self.phase.phase2)

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_damage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), self.on_damage_event_func)
		self.on_damage_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_state = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.max_follow_time = nil
	self.initial_rest_time = nil
	self.min_rest_time = nil
	self.max_rest_time = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, fo, params, cs_state)
		return local_class(c, fo, params, cs_state)
	end,
}
